sanskrit: mūrtirmāheśvarasyaikā sakalasya prakīrtitāḥananteśasya bījaṃ tu japākusumasuprabhamaṣṭamasya tṛtīyaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhena tu samanvitamsūkṣmasya ca tṛtīyaṃ tu caturbhujaṃ triṇetrakambindunādasamākrāntaṃ śivottamasya ca bījakamprathamasyaikādaśaṃ grāhyaṃ bindunādasamanvitampunarekādaśaṃ grāhyaṃ bindunādasamanvitamtrimūrtiṃ kuṅkumaprakhyaṃ triṇetraṃ ca caturbhujamcaturthasvarasaṃyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitamtriṇetraṃ caturbhujaṃ jñeyaṃ śūlaṃ paraśudhāriṇamśikhaṇḍibījamākhyātaṃ bhinnāñjanasamaprabham || 11amsarve vai vṛṣabhārūḍhā jaṭāmakuṭadhāriṇaḥśivasya saṃhitā vatsa sarve padmāsanasthitāḥśrīkaṇṭhanāthādhipatiriti nityaṃ prakīrtitamsūkṣmāṇḍaṃ śivottamāṇḍamekanetrarudrāṇḍakamprathamasya pañcamaṃ gṛhya bindunādasamanvitamtrivargaṃ prathamaṃ gṛhya bindunāda samanvitampañcamaṃ pañcavargasya bindunādasamanvitamṣaṣṭhasya pañcamaṃ gṛhyaṃ bindunādasamanvitamsaptamasya turīyaṃ tu prathamasya tu saptakamviṣṇukrāntisamaprakhyaṃ triṇetraṃ śūladhāriṇamnīlāñjanasamaprakhyaṃ gaṇeśasya svarūpakamlambodaraṃ māṇavakaṃ śvetapadmopari sthitambhṛṅgīṃ ruṭiṃ mahātmānaṃ ṣaṣṭhasya tu caturthakamaṣṭamasya tṛtīyaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhaṃ caiva vibhūṣitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mayūravāhanaṃ devaṃ śaktitomaradhāriṇamabhayaṃ copavītaṃ tu daśasaṃvatsarākṛtimbījaṃ caivāṣṭamūrtestu vakṣyāmi śṛṇu ṣaṇmukhaśaṅkhagokṣīradhavalaṃ triṇetraṃ tu caturbhujampūrvadiksthāpayedvatsa śvetapadmoparisthitamcaturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca mārtāṇḍodayasaprabhamīśānamīśaṃ digbhāge caturthe svarameva tatcaturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca śūlaṃ paraśudhāriṇamcaturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca yāmyabhāge vyavasthitamrudraṃ nir-ṛtidigbhāge dvinetraṃ tu caturbhujambinduśekharamārūḍhaṃ jaṭāmakuṭadhāriṇamcaturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitamcaturthaṃ ṣaṣṭhavargasya caturthasvarasaṃyutamcaturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca śūlaṃ paraśudhāriṇamcaturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca yāmyāyāṃ kalpayedguhasarve padmāsanāhyete sarvaśakti samanvitāḥmahādevo harorudraḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥkapālīśasya vijeyā rudrāstvekādaśa smṛtāḥsvanāmādyakṣaraṃ hyeṣāṃ bindunādasamanvitamjaṭāmakuṭadhāraṃ ca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitampuṣṭistuṣṭistathā * * lakṣmīścaiva sarasvatīekāścaikādaśāḥ śaktyo rudrāstvekā daśaśca vailokaprakāśakaścaiva lokasākṣī trivikramaḥete vai dvādaśādityāḥ pūjayetpīṭhavāhyataḥsarve te dvibhujā jñeyā ekavaktrā dvivaktrakāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarve śaktisamārūḍhāḥ padmahastāśca raktakāḥsāvitrī caiva gāyatrī dhṛtiḥ kāntirmatirdyutiḥgagana sparśanastejo rasaśca pṛthivīti casvanāmādyakṣareṇaiva bindunāda samanvitāḥsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktāḥ sarve padmāsanasthitāḥtejī vāpī ca dhāriṇi somī sūryavatī caivaaṣṭau ca vasuśaktyaśca kramaśaḥ parikalpayetprāṇaḥ prāṇeśa jīveśau marutaścāśca pūjayetsarve te dvibhujāścaiva dvinetrāścaikavaktrakāḥvilāsinī sammukhī ca svarūpā ca yaśasvinīsarvāste śaktibījāstu svanāmādyakṣaraṃ bhavetgandharvāścāraṇāḥ siddhāḥ yakṣā nāgāśca kinnarāḥjayaścā sparśarāsaśca asurāśca trayodaśasarve te dvibhujā jñeyāḥ dvinetrāścaikavaktrakāḥśeṣān mātṛgaṇān sarvān svanāmādyena pūjayetindramagniṃ yama rakṣo varuṇaṃ vāyumeva cavajraṃ śaktiśca daṇḍaśca khaḍgaṃ pāśastathāṅkuśamsarve te dvibhujā jñeyāḥ ekavaktrā dvilocanāḥjaṭāmakuṭadhāraṃ ca nāgayajñopavītakamsarve padmāsanā hyete śivaika nihitekṣaṇāḥśaktīnāmapi sarvāsāṃ ādhāratvena vai guhaiti śrīkālottare mantroddhārapaṭalo dvitīyaḥmṛtkāṣṭhaṃ gomayaṃ puṣapaṃ tilamāmalakaṃ śubhamprayatnena pumān snāyāt na ca gṛhyodakena tutadalābhe taṭākaṃ syāt tadalābhe tu puṣkaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prabhūte sati nālpaṃ tu snānāya syātkadācanaraviṃ dakṣiṇataḥ kṛtvā divā viṇmūtrasarjanamnālikeraphalaṃ mātraṃ śaucārthaṃ mṛdamāharetmeḍhre tu trimṛdaṃ dadyāt vṛṣaṇe ca tathaiva caāmalī phalamātreṇa pādamekaṃ tu kṣālayettriḥ prāśyāpo dvirunmṛjya pādau prokṣya pramārjya caghrāṇadvayaṃ tathā spṛśya śrotre * * * * * * tsarvābhiraṅgulībhistu nābhiṃ saṃspṛśya deśikaḥhṛdgābhiḥ śudhyate vipraḥ karṇakābhistu kṣatriyaḥhṛdayena mṛdaṃ vatsa tribhāgaṃ kārayedbudhaḥpūrvamṛdbhāgaṃ vai vatsa daśadikṣu vinikṣipetdakṣiṇena mṛdā caiva sarvāṅgaṃ samupaspṛśetuttareṇa mṛdā caiva śivatīrthaṃ tu kalpayetnārācāstra prayogeṇa prakṣipejjalamadhyataḥpunarvai gomayenaiva sarvāṅgaṃ samupa spṛśetaghoreṇāpi hṛdayaṃ guhya vāmena lepayetpavitraivyomamamantreṇa mārjayitvā tu mantravitkalaśamudrāṃ tu saṃkalpya prāsādenābhiṣiñcayetnābhimagrodake sthivā saṃmukhaṃ sūryasannidhauvidyeśvaraṃ śivaṃ caiva rudraikādaśakānapitīrthamāsādya mantrajñaḥ kuśaiḥ puṣpaiśca saṃyutamsarvāṅgaṃ lepayitvā tu mārjayitvā pavitrakaiḥprakṣipenmūlamantreṇa kurumajya samāhitaḥtīrthamāsādya mantrajña ācamya ca vidhānataḥāpaḥ punantu vai vatsa aghorātpiṇḍamantrataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: piṇḍeśe naiva vā vatsa mārjayedvyomamantrataḥtatpuruṣaṃ japeddhīmān aṣṭottarasahasrakamtadvajjapet tu sāvitraṃ prāsādaṃ ca punarjapetprāsādena mahāsena sūryāya salilaṃ dadetaṣṭavidyeśvarānmantrān rudraikādaśamantrakānvyomavyāpinamāvartya ūrdhvabāhusthito budhaḥpradakṣiṇatrayaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍavatpraṇamet kṣitauraktacandanagandhena akṣataṃ na ca taṇḍulamtāmrapātre tu saṃsthāpya hastamātre tu maṇḍalepādyamācamanaṃ dattvā arghyaṃ tasmai nivedayetvisarjayitvā deveśaṃ tarpayenmantrapūrvakamśivasya daśavāraṃ tu tarpayenmūlamantrataḥvidyeśvarānmūrtipāṃśca rudraikādaśa eva caaśvinau marutaścaiva lokapālagaṇeśvarāngandharvāṃścāraṇān siddhān nāgānvai yātudhānakānbhūtavetālakuśmāṇḍān kumārapāhapūtanāneteṣāṃ caiva patnīnāṃ kumārāṇāṃ ca vai budhaḥviṣṇubrahmendrarudrāṇāṃ saptavāraṃ tu tarpayetśeṣān vaiṇāṃ sarvadevānāṃ trivāraṃ caiva tarpayetdevapatnīrdevaputrān trivāraṃ tarpayedguhapitṝṇāṃ prācīnāvītī tarpayetsusamāhitaḥārṣeṇaiva tu tīrthena ṛṣīṇāṃ tarpayetpunaḥkaniṣṭhikāṅgulimūle tu daivikaṃ tīrthamucyatemadhye karatalasyāpi śaivaṃ tīrthamudāhṛtamtasya pūrve sūryatīrthaṃ paścime vāruṇaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāyavyāṃ pāvanaṃ tīrthaṃ aiśānyāṃ rudratīrthakamtasmātsarvaprayatnena brāhmaṇasya karāccyutammanvagastyavasiṣṭhāśca gautamāṅgirasastathāpaiṅgadīrghamato vyāsa śaunako māmato yadiśālikirjamadagniśca upamanyurvāmadevakaḥārṣeṇaiva tu tīrthena ṛṣīn sarvāṃśca tarpayetmātāmaha mahīścaiva māturmātāmahīti cagururmātā pitā caiva tanmātā tatpitāpi cakuśa puṣpākṣatenaiva devānāṃ tarpayedbudhaḥdevānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca jalenaiva tu tarpayetpretake kumbhato haste mukīśaktiṃ tilena caadhyāyanaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā vaktrairvedādibhistathāathaikādaśa rudraṃ ca puruṣasūktaṃ japettataḥvāmadakṣiṇahaste tu tarjanyaṅguṣṭha hastakesnānavastraṃ prapīḍyaiva tīrthaṃ saṃhṛtya buddhimāntailaṃ piṣṭaṃ ca gandhaṃ ca akṣavṛkṣasya cūrṇakamsnānaṃ kuryātprayatnena pūrvaṃ brāhma samācaretbhojane vaiśvakārye ca maunaṃ ṣaḍdhā vidhīyatevighnānāṃ vividhānāṃ ca kṣipramuccāṭanaṃ bhavetgacchedāyatanaṃ mantrī puṣpa haste vicakṣaṇaḥiti kālottare snānapaṭalastṛtīyaḥkapilā gobhayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ jarāgobhayamevaśirāmantreṇa dagdhāvai sadyojātena grāhayetmṛtkumbhe vā nave sthāpya kavacenābhirakṣitamsarvamantraiḥ sakṛdvatsa abhimantrya sakṛtsakṛt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śreṣṭhaṃ suvarṇapātraṃ tu rajataṃ madhyamaṃ bhavetalābupātra madhamaṃ poṭṭalī cādhamādhamamśira ūrdhvaṃ * * śena mukhaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tuvāmadevena mantreṇa guhye'pāne ca bījayoḥpārśvayorubhayoścaiva pṛṣṭhayorubhayorapinaiṣṭhikānāṃ ca viprāṇāṃ sarvāṅgasnānamācarettrisandhyaṃ bhasmanā snānaṃ tripuṇḍraṃ vā samācaretdvātriṃśat ṣoḍaśāṅge vā trisandhyāyāṃ tripuṇḍrakammūrdhālalāṭakarṇau ca cakṣuṣī ghrāṇayorapimaṇibandhau ca hṛnnābhi meḍhrapāyū tathaiva capādayostatpṛṣṭhau ca tripuṇḍraṃ dvātriṃśaducyatelalāṭa grīve skandhau ca bāhukūrparayugmayoḥtripuṇḍraṃ ṣoḍaśasthāne kārayedvai śivā * * *mīdvātriṃśasthāne tripuṇḍraṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattatva devatāśivaḥ sadāśivaścaiva maheśo brahmapañcakamaṣṭasthāne ca vakṣyāmi tripuṇḍraṃ daivataṃ tathākaṇṭhe vināyakaḥ prīto bāhvorvai viṣṇureva capṛṣṭhe'pi pitaraḥ prītāḥ tripuṇḍre'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥcaturaṅgula vistāraṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tripuṇḍrakamekāṅgulaṃ tu śūdrāṇāṃ strīṇāṃ caiva viśeṣataḥmadhyamānāmikābhyāṃ ca tarjanyā ca tripuṇḍrakamnṛpāṇāṃ bālacandrastu rekhāmātraṃ viśeṣataḥaṅgulītritaye tāladehe kurvīta buddhimānsamayī putrakaścaiva sādhakācārya eva caduḥsvapnaṃdarśane caiva durjanasparśane'pi ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhasmasnānena śuddhiḥ syādarcane yogyatāpi caśivaṃ pañcavidhaṃ snānaṃ pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥāpo hiṣṭheti mantraṃ syāt vāyavyaṃ gorajo bhavetteṣu sarveṣu vaivatsa śaivamāgneyamuttamammarudgaṇāḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ sarvāmātṛgaṇā apirakṣārthaṃ maṅgalārthaṃ ca pavitrārthaṃ ṣaḍānanabhojane tuṣakeśaṃ ca virāṅgāranasvānyapisūkā bhramaradāśāśca kṣopācchudhyanti bhasmanāmnālikeraṃ ca salilamudakaṃ copadaśakamtāvanmā samuddhṛtya bhasmakṣepeṇa śuddhyatitrikālaṃ vā dvikālaṃ vā ekakālaṃ tripuṇḍrakamdevarakṣaḥ piśācāśca asurā yā tu dhānakāḥbrahmarākṣasa ucchiṣṭāḥ pūtanākuṣṭhagulmakāḥcatuṣṣaṣṭi pittarogāḥ śleṣmaṣaṭpratipañcakaḥbhāsakatvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ bhāsakatvācchubhasya capūrvāhne bhojane caiva svapne'pi gamane'pi caabhayaṃ brahmaviṣṇubhyāṃ * * * * * * * *iti kālottare bhasmasnānapaṭalaścaturthaḥavarjyavarjyapuṣpāṇāṃ phalānāṃ ca graha śṛṇubilvapatraṃ sahasrebhyo patramekaṃ viśiṣyatepuṇḍarīkasahasrebhyo śatapatraṃ viśiṣyatesahasrapatra viśeṣebhyo apāmārgaṃ viśiṣyatekuśapuṣpa sahasrebhyaḥ śamīpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyatevyāghātaka sahasrebhyo bakapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyatedhurdhūrakasahasrebhyo droṇapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sadābhadrasahasrebhyo kṛṣṇānirguṇḍikā parābṛhatpuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ śvetārkaṃ ca viśiṣyatebṛhaddroṇa sahasrebhyo śrīmannīlotpalaṃ paramnīlotpalaṃ hemapuṣpaṃ nirmālyaṃ vatsarādbahvetmallikājātipuṣpaṃ ca durdhūraka samaṃ bhavetmālatī kovidāraṃ ca karajīra samaṃ bhavetaśokaṃ śvetamandāraṃ vyāghātaka samaṃ bhavetjapā kadambapunnāgaṃ droṇapuṣpa samaṃ bhavetlakṣmī ca sahadevī ca bilvapatra samaṃ bhavetcibukā gūḍhapuṣpaṃ ca padmapuṣpasamaṃ bhavetnīlanīrada puṣpaṃ ca kalhāraṃ kuṭilaṃ bhavetpalāśamusalīpuṣpaṃ droṇapuṣpa samaṃ bhavetmayūraśaṅkhapuṣpaṃ ca sūryāvartaṃ ca nāgakamkaṃsakaṃ kṛṣṇatulasī pra * * * * * * *dhurdhūrakasamājñeyā mahābhadrātṛṇāvapiindranīlaṃ mahānīlaṃ sūryakāntendutārakamyavagodhūmanīvāra śālīvaiṇavakāni cabījānyekādaśaitāni pācayitvā tu buddhimānvyāghāta puṣpasadṛśānyaṅkurāṇi pṛthakpṛthakkadalīkusumaṃ caiva śāribākusumāni cakaravīra samājñeyā madhūkaṃ cūtameva caketakī mādhavī kundaṃ yūthikā madayantikākiṃśukā haritaṃ caiva nīlakarṇikameva caśignuṃ ca * * nyagrodhamatsyākṣau ca vivarjayettalapoṭaka puṣpāṇi koṭapi pūjayedguha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: siṃśu mārakapuṣpāṇi umādevīṃ ca pūjayetindravallī kanakapuṣpamindraprītikaraṃ mahatpūjayetketakī puṣpairaraṇyamālatī tathāvarjayet kiṃśukaṃ vatsa prayatnena tu sādhakaḥarcayet kṛṣṇapuṣpāṇi piśācagirikarṇakaḥharitāni ca puṣpāṇi arcayet sarvameva cacandanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ caiva khaḍgaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ tathāturuṣkaṃ ca ghanaṃ celaṃ vanalohaṃ tu cāṅganāabalaṃ caṇḍī śaṅkhaṃ ca kuṅkumaṃ gurameva cakuṣṭhaṃ mīsasamoraṃ ca māṃsusākalameva camadhvaśarkaragaṃ khaṃ ca kunduruṣkaṃ caturguṇamekadvitricaturthāni khagacandanavāyasaiḥśītāni dhūpamevaṃ tu madhunā ca pariplutammulaṃ tvaṣṭaguṇaṃ devaṃ dhūpaṃ rudreṇa nirmitamgulasajjaraso dhūpaṃ kalabhaṃ śaṅkarapriyamna tu sajjaraso dhūpaṃ gandhaṃ rūdreṇa nirmitamdhūpitā gulasarpiṣyā gandhaṃ syācchivanirmitamvilepanaṃ śambhuvinirmitaṃ paramśivamataṃ varagandhamahāvahamādityakiraṇa tailatapta campakatailaṃ tu śivakāntamśivanirmitametadeva gṛhaṃ hi sudhūpamidaṃ tatdhūpayedgulasarpibhyāṃ gandhaṃ rudrapriyaṃ sadāmadhuśarkaralohaṃ ca turuṣkeṇa tu dhūpayetśivapriyamidaṃ gandhaṃ sarvayatnena lepayetvasecchiva purenityaṃ śivena sahamodate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāladvayaṃ cāpyadhikaṃ sarvapīṭhe tu vistarampīṭhantu dvāramātmānaṃ pīṭhaṃ tasya dviguṇasyavalayaṃ vāpi vistaram (?)dvikhaṇḍanena kartavyaṃ ekenaiva umā bhavetdārave dāravaṃ kuryāt pārthivena tu pārthivamvajraṃ maratakaṃ māṇikyaṃ mauktikaṃ vidrumameva calohena pīṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ ārakūṭena vā kurupūrve tu calanaṃ liṅgaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ bhayaṃ bhavetbrāhmaṇānāṃ bhayaṃ tatra nātra kāryā vicāraṇānair-ṛtyāṃ calite liṅge catuṣpādabhayaṃ bhavetavyagro caiva matimān śanaiḥ pīṭhaṃ prapūjayetaiśānyāmāśrayelliṅgaṃ pūjyamācandratārakamsubhikṣaṃ gobahulaṃ ca putrapautravivardhanamsnapanaṃ kārayet paścāt śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇāliṅgaṃ sākṣānmaheśānaḥ pīṭhaṃ sākṣādumā bhavetsākṣātpṛthivī pīṭhaṃ tu liṅgaṃ sākṣāddhiyatparamaṣṭabandhaṃ prakartavyaṃ pīṭhaliṅgasya chidrakeiti kālottare pīṭhabandhapaṭalaḥ ekonapañcāśatsarva śāntikaraṃ caiva sarvāriṣṭavināśanamgrahaṇe viṣuve caiva ayane vyatipātakedīkṣānte cādbhute caiva ghoraduḥsvapna darśanebhūmikampe ca durbhikṣo pratimābhedane'pi capīṭhabandhe sudhākārye sthalasaṃskāraṃ kārayetsauvarṇai rājataistāmraiḥ pārthivairvā susaṃsthitaiḥarbudairnyarbudairvāpi snapanaṃ kārayedguha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekāśītiścatuḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ snapanaṃ tatra kārayettayormadhye bṛhatsūtraṃ kārayettantravittamaḥyavārdhamātraṃ saṃlīnaṃ gatantatra ca sthāpayetadhikamaṅgulaṃ kuryāt vistāroṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhavetbrahmajajñānamevaṃ tu sadasaspatimeva caratnanyāsaṃ prakartavyaṃ brahmapādaśiloparibījaṃ coṣadhipuṣpaṃ ca navakakṣaṃ ṣaḍānanavidrumaṃ puṣyarāgaṃ ca sūryakāntendukāntakamsuvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmraṃ āyasaṃ trapusīsakamtālakaṃ gandhakaṃ śīlaṃ daragairikamākṣikamtadīnāṅgo viṣāṇotthavarāhakuśamūlataḥśubhamṛtprakṣipedvatsa pūrvavanmantrapūrvakamkumudakahlārakoṭī ca nīlotpalameva capūrvavadvikṣipedvatsa brahmādyeśānamantrakamkastūriṃ patranavamaṃ pūrvavatparikalpayettilamudgāssamāṣāśca pūrvavatparikalpayetśāribā indravallī ca sūryāvartaṃ balāni camallikājātipuṣpaṃ ca vakulaṃ pāṭalāni canavamaṃ vakulaṃ vatsa pūrvavatparikalpayetsvarṇaṃ dvādaśaniṣkeṇa kūrmaṃ kṛtvā tu nikṣipetvṛṣabhaṃ kesarī nāgaṃ śrīvatsaṃ bherimeva catoraṇaṃ caiva bhāṇḍena pūrvavatparikalpayetpavitraiḥ pañcabhirjaptvā prāsādaṃ bījamukhyakaiḥpṛthakkapilāndohayettatra pañca ete dvayor-ṛcoḥsumuhūrte dine caiva sunakṣatre tithau guha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: snātvācamya vidhivadācāryastu samāhitaḥdevadevaṃ samutthāpya śakaṭopari nirvahetgrāmaṃ vā nagaraṃ vāpi pattanaṃ vā pradakṣiṇamācāryastvagrato gacchet arghyantasya samāhitaḥśaṅkhatūryaninādaiśca puṇyāhajayamaṅgalaiḥdevālayaṃ samāgatya praviśedgarbhamandirenirmālyaṃ sarvatantraiśca visṛjya praviśedguhaḥprāsādaśatakaṃ divyaṃ bījamukhyena saṃpuṭesakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ dhyātvā nyasedbrahmaśiloparisadyenā pañcayeddevaṃ vāmadevena sthāpayetīśānena tu puṣpāṇi makuṭaṃ kuṇḍalāni caaghorandakṣiṇe sthāpya pūrve ca puruṣaṃ nyasettryakṣaṃ dvibhujaṃ devaṃ candrārdhakṛtaśekharamdivyāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ divyagandhānulepanamsarvābharaṇamadhyakṣaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamliṅge tu vinyaseddevaṃ bījamukhyena caiva hiniṣkalaṃ nirmalaṃ śāntaṃ niṣprapañcamalakṣaṇamvācyavācakarahitaṃ sadasaspatimadbhutamyogigamyaṃ paraṃ brahma udvayantamataḥ paramevaṃ dhyātvā mahāsena prāsādena tu saṃyutamsadāśivasya hṛdaye prāsādaṃ vinyasedguhahṛllekhā viṣṇubhāge tu trirjapitvā tu vinyasetvidyātattvamatho nyasya ātmatattvaṃ tu madhyamepunaḥ pavitrannyaseddehe kalāmantrairvidhānataḥaghoraṃ hṛdaye nyasya guhye vāmaṃ prakalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrve dakṣiṇataścaiva paścime cottare tathāpūrve dakṣiṇataścaiva paścime cottare tathāhṛdi grīvāṃsayoścaiva nābhau īśānameva cagude liṅge ca ūrvośca jānvośca jaṅghayorapivāmadeva kalānnyasya trayodaśa anukramātsadyasya tu kalā aṣṭau krameṇaiva tu vinyasetevaṃ nyastvā vidhānena kalaśaiḥ snānamācaretpunargandhodakenaiva snāpayedbījamukhyakaiḥpūjayeddhṛdayenaiva bījamukhyena vai guhamakuṭaiḥ kuṇḍalaiścaiva svarṇayajñopavītakaiḥevaṃ saṃpūrṇavidhinā praṇipatya kṣamāpayetiti kālottare pratiṣṭhāpaṭalaḥ pañcāśatgarbhagṛhaṃ tridhā bhajya dvibhāgaṃ pīṭhamuttamamcaturaśraṃ vṛttapadmaṃ bhāgākṛtimathāpi vāsaptāśraṃ vāpi cāṣṭāśraṃ navāśraṃ vāpi kārayetaṣṭādaśāśraṃ vā kuryāt viṃśadaśramathāpi vācitrākṛtirvā pīṭhaṃ tu kūrmākṛtimathāpi vāpañcaviṃśaiḥ ṣoḍaśairvā navabhirvātha kārayetnibudaiḥ kalaśairvatsa mahāviṣṇukṛtaṃ purāādityastu nikharvaiśca sarvaiśśakreṇa vai guhamaṇḍalīkā na romāśca śataiḥ pañcabhireva tusahasrakalaśairvatsa tantritaiḥ snapanaṃ bhavetdvyāḍhakaiścaiva saṃpūrṇaiḥ kalaśairmadhyamaṃ bhavetyāvatkalaśavistāraṃ tāvanmaṇḍapavistarampūrayedviṃśatipadaṃ dravyāṇāṃ ca yathā vidhi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahasrairdaśabhirvatsa kalaśairayutaiḥ kurunyarbudaiśśatasahasreṇaṃ ghṛtena paripūrayetniyutaiḥ kalaśaiḥ snapanaiḥ daśasahasrakṛtaṃ bhavetsahasraistu śataṃ pūrya snapanaṃ kārayedbudhaḥghṛtasyārdhaṃ tu vai kṣīraṃ kṣīrasyārdhaṃ dadhi bhavetnālikerasya salilaṃ kṣīreṇa tu samaṃ bhavettuṣārasalilaṃ vatsa pañcaviṃśattu viṃśatiḥsahasrakaṃ tuṣārasalilaṃ kalpayedvai ṣaḍānanaviṃśatpañcadaśa caiva daśa ṣaṭpañcakadvayammahāsnapanamevaṃ tu śeṣānnṛttānniyojayetviṃśatpaṅktiṃ prakīryātha dakṣiṇottaragaṃ guhaekaikena tu pañcāśatpadaṃ paścimapūrvakeekaikaṃ kalaśamūle tu dviprasthaṃ śāliṃ nikṣipetkalaśān kṣālitān śuddhān dhūpitāngandhalepitānāmrapallavasaṃdhinnān sugandhena tu varcitānathavā catvāra ācāryaḥ snapanaṃ kārayedguhanavavastra dharāḥ śuddhāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥsuvarṇapuṣpasaṃyuktaiḥ soṣṇīṣaiḥ sottarīyakaiḥcatustoraṇa saṃyuktaṃ caturdvārasamanvitammuktādāmaiḥ puṣpadānaiḥ sarvataścāpyalaṃkṛtamkulaparvatāṣṭadikṣu viprādeśocchritaṃ bhavetkailāsaṃ śvetamṛtsābhiḥ merumātraṃ tu kārayethimaṃ vindhyaṃ sucakraṃ vā mahendraṃ pāriyātrakamniṣadhaṃ pūrvadigbhāge himavānagnigocaresuvarma paścime sthāpya vāyavye pāriyātrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahendraśikharaṃ vatsa aiśānyāṃ parikalpayetmeroḥ prācyāṃ tu vai vatsa śivakumbhaṃ nyasedbudhaḥathavā tuṣārasalilaṃ śuddhodakamathāpi vādaśame paṅktau ṣaṇmukha pañcāśadghṛtaṃ pūrayetkṣīreṇa pūrayetteṣu pañcāśadvāmavidyayātasya paścimapaṅktau tu pañcāśadgomayaṃ bhavetaṣṭalohamayāmbhaśca tasya paścimapaṅktiketasya paścimapaṅktau tu kaṣāyāṣṭakaṃ pūrayettasya paścimapañcāśuddhadodake tu pūrayetsuvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tāmramāyasaṃ trapusīsakamāmramaudumbaraṃ caiva nyagrodhaṃ panasaṃ tathākaṣāyavṛkṣamadhye tat kaṣāyāṣṭakamudāhṛtamvalmīkāṃ kṣetrakoṣṭhābhyāṃ vedimadhyaṃ tu cāṣṭakamsaurāṣṭraṃ vāradaṃ caiva dhātvaṣṭakamudāhṛtamkuṅkumaṃ caiva karpūraṃ khaṃgarogaphalatrayamtadghṛtapaṅktyāstu pūrvaṃ tu pañcāśatkalaśeṣu canṛpa puṣpaṃ paṅkajañcotpalaṃ vakulapāṭalītasyāḥ prācyāṃ tu paṅktau ca phalāṣṭakāmbhaśca pūrayetkapityaṃ nālikeraṃ ca nāraṃgaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ bhavetetatpaṅktyāstu pūrvasyāṃ ikṣuvāri nyasetkramātśālinīvāragodhūmayava veṇupriyaṅgavaḥtatpaṅktyā pūrvapaṅktyāttu auṣadhāṣṭakatoyakamsūryāvataṃ ca valmī ca bandhūkantirikarṇikātatprācyāṃ caiva paṅktau ca mahāśālyāṣṭakaṃ nyasetkṛṣṇaśālī śvetaśālī kalamāśālimeva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bījamukhyena vai vatsa nyasenmantreṇa deśikaḥharidrāśatapuṣpā ca gaṅgā caiva haripriyātuṣārodakamiśrāntaṃ pūrvapaṅktiṃ tu pūrayetsamubhramacca matimān tuṣāreṇa sahanyasetpākajotpala * * * kalhāraṃ kumudaṃ tathāindrādyaiśānaparyantaṃ bījamukhyena vinyasetvinyasetpūrayedvatsa puṣpagandhādibhiḥ kramātrudrasūktaṃ puruṣasūktaṃ viṣṇusūktaṃ triyambakamtvaritaṃ rudramaparaṃ pavamānaṃ hiraṇyakampañcaśataistadardhaiśca tadardhairviṃśatāpi caekāśītiḥ prakartavyaṃ navake navakeṣu cacatuḥṣaṣṭikalaśairvatsa catuṣṣaṣṭidravyasaṃyutampādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ pañcagavyaṃ kaṣāyakampuṣpodakaṃ phalābhaśca gandhodakayavodakamnālikekṣurasaṃnnābhaḥ pa * * * * viṃśakampūrvaṃ kathitaṃ pañcaviṃśatpañcaviṃśatibhiḥ kurupūrvanava dravyeṇa tatkalaśaṃ tu va * * vatpañcavarṇaṃ caruṃ dadyāt praṇipatya kṣamāpayetiti kālottare snapanapaṭalaḥ ekapañcāśataṣṭavidyeśvarāścaiva aṣṭamūrtiṃ tathaiva cavasavaścāṣṭabhiścaiva gaṇeśān lokapālakānparivārānekādaśa ca kramaśaḥ parikalpayetṛṣiyakṣāścāṣṭabhiśca pīṭhe saṃpūjayedguhadvādaśadale dvādaśādityān aṣṭarudrāṃstu pūjayetnandiṃ saṃpūjya pūrve tu mahākālaṃ vahnigocare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śṛṅgīśaṃ vāruṇe pūjya ṣaṇmukhaṃ vāyugocareyamanair-ṛtayormadhye sarasvatīṃ pūjayedguhavaruṇānilayormadhye kuberasya gṛhaṃ kuruīśānasomayormadhye viṣṇusthānaṃ suśobhanampārvatī viṣṇu grahayoścaturmukhasya grahaṃ kurusarasvatīyamayormadhye saptamātṛgaṇālayamvārāhī caiva māhendrī cāmuṇḍī ca gaṇādhipaḥuttare kheca vai vatsa bhāṇḍārabhavanaṃ kuruśailena kārayettatra sudṛḍhārgalasaṃyutamindrasya bhavanaṃ pūrve āgneyyāmanalasya tuvāruṇyāṃ varuṇasthānaṃ vāyavyāmanilasya tuprāsādamekaṃ bhaumaṃ tu caturhastastu pañca vādakṣiṇe cāpi vai vatsa pitṝṇāṃ gṛhamuttamamvāruṇe vidyādharagṛhaṃ vāyavyāṃ garuḍālayamjambalaṃ māṇibhadraṃ ca śaṅkhapadmanidhergṛhamananto gulakaścaiva vāsukiḥ śaṅkhapālakaḥkūṭaṃ vā maṇḍapaṃ vāpi dhāma dvādaśahastakamdakṣiṇe āyurbhavanaṃ dṛḍhaṃ prāsādamuttamampuṣkaraṇī vāruṇyāṃ tu śatahastaṃ vartulaṃ bhavetudyānaṃ paritaḥ kuryāt āmrabilvādiśobhanaiḥpanasairnālikeraiśca kumudaiḥ kadalīcayaiḥmālatīmādhavībhiśca madantīsindhuvārakaiḥaśvatthabrahmavṛkṣaiśca raktacandanavedukaiḥkuṅkumaiḥ mārakaiścaiva uśīraistadgaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥpiśācaiśca mṛdaṅgī ca bhāryāṅgī ca garuḍastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāmbūlavallī pūgā ca bhakṣyakandāśca sarvaśaḥanyaiśca puṣpavṛkṣaiśca varyagaistarubhiḥ śubhaiḥṣaṭcampakaṃ tālavanaṃ śataṃ ca navāgramekaṃ narakaṃ na yātigośālāṃ pūrvadigbhāge āgneyyāṃ tāpasālayamdīnāndhakṛpaṇānāṃ tu ārtānāṃ vasatiṃ śubhamrudrasya gaṇikāsthānaṃ prākārabāhye pūrvataḥtadbāhyarājaveśmaṃ tu vaṇiggrāmasya bāhyataḥnāgarādbāhye cāntyajātsvarṇalohādikārakānrajakā ca makārāśca naṭovakuṭa eva catakṣakāṇāṃ bahiḥ kuryāt anyairanyajanairapidvidaṇḍādviṣṇubhavanaṃ tridaṇḍāśca gaṇeśvaramgaṇeśvarāvaraṇaṃ bāhye lokapālāstridaṇḍataḥtadbāhye viṃśadaṇḍāttu śivaprākāramuttamamkoṣṭhākā(gā)raṃ ca medhāvī prakārābhyantare kurupitāmahasya bhavanaṃ viṣṇorbhavanameva caprākārābhyantare kuryāt gṛhaṃ saṃnyāsakāriṇāmiti kālottare parivārapaṭalo dvipañcāśatliṅgasyaivānurūpaṃ tu prākāraṃ kārayedbudhaḥprathamaṃ meruprāsādaṃ dvitīyaṃ mandaraṃ bhavetpañcamaṃ valabhiścaiva svacchandanandyāvartaṃ tu ṣaṣṭhakamnavamaṃ garuḍaprāsādaṃ daśamaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ bhavettrayodaśaṃ tu sukṣetraṃ caturdaśaṃ mānavaṃ bhavetprāsādānaṃ ṣaṇṇavatiḥ pradhānaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ bhavetnāgaraṃ drāviḍaṃ caiva vesaraṃ trividhaṃ bhavetaparaṃ ṣaṣṭhamaṃ vatsa vesaramuttamaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvātriṃśadvesaraṃ proktaṃ ṣaṇṇavatiḥ prakīrtitāḥnāgaraṃ taṃ vijānīyāt cirajālaṃ pratiṣṭhitamkoṣṭhaṃ nāsikahīnā ca drāviḍaṃ parikīrtitamśālānāsikāsaṃyuktaṃ upānakumudānvitamgrīvāśikharasaṃyuktaṃ tadvesaraṃ parikīrtitambrahmā viṣṇuśca virudraśca kṛtayugme ṣaḍānanabhūmiṃ pañcaśataṃ jñeyaṃ tretāyāṃ tu ṣaḍānanakaliyuge tu ṣaṣṭhibhūmiruttamaṃ parikīrtitamkaliyuge mānuṣāṇāṃ tu saptapañcatrayaṃ hi vāindrādilokapālānāṃ catuṣṣaṣṭirudāhṛtamkṛtayuge devamevaṃ tu trayahīnaṃ tu tretāyāmkaliyuge saptabhūmistu uttamaṃ parikīrtitampañcabhūmirgrahāṇāṃ tu uttamaṃ parikīrtitamsārvabhaumasya vai vatsa ṣoḍaśabhūmirucyatesaptakaṃ bhūmirurdhvantu mahāpātabhayaṃ bhavetsāmantānāṃ dvibhūmistu devīnāṃ tu tribhūmikamkośādhyakṣasyaikabhūmiḥ tribhādhyakṣasya ekataḥrājaduhitāścaikabhūmiṃ kumārāṇāṃ tu ekataḥlohaloṣṭaicchaditaṃ prāsādaṃ parikīrtitamsamṛddhānādyadvayutādūrdhvaṃ rajataṃ vā suvarṇakamprāsādaṃ vaiśyajātīnāṃ valabhicchandanārdhakamśūdrāṇāṃ galikānāṃ ca tṛṇācchādya gṛhaṃ bhavetcaturvedavidāṃ caiva yāvāgāraṃ praśasyatedhavalākāraṃ na kartavyamanyeṣāṃ tu kadācanaviśiṣṭo yajñaparo nṛpo dhavalākāraṃ praśasyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dīpamarghyaṃ ca pādyaṃ cācamanīyaṃ havistathāiti kālottare puṣpagandhapaṭalaḥ pañcamaḥalābhe'jaghṛtaṃ dīpaṃ śuddhatailena vādhunāuttamaṃ kāpilaṃ siddhiḥ sāttvikaṃ dīpamucyatesarveṣāṃ vṛkṣatailānāṃ śivadīpaṃ tu varjayetpādyānāmuttamaṃ vatsa śivapādābjadhāriṇammadhyamaṃ pādyaṃ vijñeyaṃ śivapādābjakṣālanamtakkolaṃ kaṭakaṃ caiva jātikośaṃ tuṭīstathākuṅkudevinataṃ caiva kuṭiḥ pākalacandramāḥtilāḥ siddhārthakāścaiva arghyamaṣṭāṅgamucyateśamīvyāghāta puṣpaṃ ca droṇaṃ vai bilvapatrakamapāmārgaṃ bṛhatī vāpi supuṣpaṃ na ca kīrtitamelā suvarṇapuṣpaṃ vā saṃyutaṃ prayutaṃ phalamtasmātsarvaprayatnena puṣpagandhasamāyutamkīṭakeśāpaviddhāni lūtasūtrāvṛtāni casvayaṃ patitapuṣpaṃ ca tyajedupahṛtāni canābheradhastādānītaṃ pādasaṃspṛṣṭameva cabiḍālamūṣika spṛṣṭaṃ mahiṣājagavāmapirajasvalādibhiḥ spṛṣṭaṃ antyajairapi dūṣitamdravyeṇa krītapuṣpāṇi madhyamaṃ phalamaśnuteanyārāmodbhave puṣpe kanyasaṃ phalamādiśetekaikena tu māsena puṣpamekaikaṃ varjayetarkaṃ bilvamapāmārgaṃ droṇaṃ cotpalapaṅkajammāse māse caikapuṣpaṃ puṣṭyādāvārjayedbudhaḥ* * * * * gotrasya sahasrāṇāṃ na saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: varuṇavāyukubereśa amarādityapā *dhaneśaṃ kecidicchanti vasurudravināyakāndhavalākāraṃ homāttu acirādeva naśyatimānuṣāṇāṃ tu vai vatsa nṛpabrāhmaṇayordvayoḥdhavalākāraṃ tu vidhinā śivāya paramātmanekṛṣṇaṃ śilāṃ ca dhavalokāramūḍhatrayaṃ guhasirāsiravipannaśca granthimaṇḍalavarjitamkoṭakaṃ vāpi kurvīta prāsādaṃ vesaraṃ tu vāaśvamedhyasya koṭyastu kapilānāṃ nikharvataḥprāsādāttroṭakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ praśaṃsanti manīṣiṇaḥtasmāttu dviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥprāsādaṃ vāpi troṭaṃ syātkārayedvai ṣaḍānanavaktuṃ na śakyate tasmātko vā varṇayituṃ kṣamaḥtattadbhūmau śivaṃ kuryāt tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇuhiraṇyagarbhasahasraṃ yattatphalaṃ labhate naraḥsthāpayetroṭaprāsāde bhūmau bhūmau tu vai nṛpaḥpūrvasmācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ labhate troṭake'pi vāiti kālottare prāsādapaṭalaḥ tripañcāśatāyāmaṃ sthānabhedaiśca pramāṇaṃ garbhameva caanirvāṇapradīpaṃ ca amlānapuṣpameva caratnagarbhaṃ pañcagarbhaṃ pañcadhāgarbhameva hibhūsurairaṣṭalakṣaṃ tu uttamaṃ grāmamucyatesaptalakṣaṃ tu vai vatsa uttamādhamamāviśetṣallakṣairbrāhmaṇairyuktaṃ madhyamottamamucyatedvilakṣabhūsurairyuktaṃ adhamaṃ grāmamucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lakṣādhīnaṃ tu vai vatsa kugrāmaṃ tu vinirdiśetcatvāro vedāḥ ṣaḍaṅgaiḥ dharmaśāstrapurāṇakaḥbhāṣyāścatvāra evaṃ tu daśāṣṭādaśasaṃhitāḥcatuṣṣaṣṭikalāścaiva ṣaṭtarkāṇi tathaiva caāyurvedaṃ sāmudrikaṃ somasiddhāntameva caṣaṭsiddhāntakamārgaṃ ca jñātvā vai deśiko bhavetabhedaṃ yo vijānāti sa vai deśika ucyategrāmaṃ vā nagaraṃ vāpi pattanaṃ kheṭakaṃ tu vāsarvaśālīprarohaṃ tu gṛhaṃ prākārasaṃyutamtadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā sahasraṃ dhanurmātrataḥcaturaśramāyatāśraṃ vā vṛṣabhāya prakalpayetsarvasasyāśrayaṃ caiva sroto nadyatha dakṣiṇeanyajātiśatairyuktaṃ saptakāruśataṃ bhavetaṣṭalakṣo dvijāya tasmin mahāgrāmaṃ ṣaḍānanapuramevaṃvidhiṃ dadyāt pārśvayośca nadīdvayampattanaṃ samudratīre tu vaiśyaprādhānyameva cayugmābhāsasamākīrṇaṃ triyojanapadaṃ bhavetvaiśyāḥ śatasahasraṃ tu potavyāyānasaṃyutaiḥjhallamallasamākīrṇaṃ barbarairdvisahasrakamvṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā vṛttāyatanameva vāpūrve vā paścimevāpi dakṣiṇe vā samudrakamekaṃ pārśvastha śūdrasya dīrghikā tu ṣaḍānanadvādaśa dvārasaṃyuktaṃ prākāraṃ tu śivālayamnagare vātra kartavyā kheṭakaṃ cāpi śobhanamāyatāśraṃ prakartavya nadyāstīre ṣaḍānana
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kheṭakaṃ kārayānī ca eka eva tu saṃjñikāaneka prāsādasaṃyuktaṃ gṛhaprākārasaṃyutamdīrghikāparivṛtādurgaṃ durgaṃ prākāra eva cabrāhmaṇairvedasaṃyuktaiḥ paścime vāyu taṃ bhavetrājaveśmaṃ ca paritaḥ sarvadīrghaṃ ca kārayetgajavājisamākīrṇaṃ rathaiścāṣṭasamākulaḥkṣatriyo dānadharmaiśca yuktaḥśūraḥ pratāpavānvajraṃ ca padmarāgaṃ ca maratakaṃ mauktikaṃ tathādhānyānāṃ saṃgrahaścaiva vastrābharaṇameva cavardhanaṃ cādhānāṃ ca yuddhyate na kadācanasenānāṃ vardhanaṃ caiva na yuddhyeta kadācanasarvaratnānāṃ vṛddhiśca na yuddhyeta kadācananetranirvāṇakṣamaṃ ca na yuddhyeta kadācanagajāśvopaskaraṃ caiva na yuddhyeta kadācanakanakaratnaṃ vastraratnaṃ maratakaṃ ratnameva cameṣaratnaṃ mahiṣaratnaṃ tathā kumbhakaratnakamgaṇikāratnaṃ dāsaratnaṃ dāsīratnaṃ tathaiva canaṭaratnaṃ gītaratnaṃ tathā kinnararatnakamvipaścīratnamevaṃ tu satataṃ saṃgrahennṛpaḥcaturdikṣudaṇḍamokṣau ca āsanaṃ cāṣṭadikṣu casarvaśāstreṣu mukhyaṃ ca tattaddakṣaṃ tu saṃgrahetgrāṇaiḥ paśyanti paśavo cakṣurbhyāmitare janāḥprajñāyuddhaṃ rājyayuddhaṃ na yuddhyettu kadācanaiti kālottare grāmapurapattanakheṭaka rājadhānīpaṭalaścatuḥ pañcāśatgarbhahīne tu grāmāṇāṃ gṛhāṇāṃ nāśameva hi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trīṇyuttarāṇi revatyā anūrādhā tathaiva cagarbhādhānaṃ ca yadgarbhaṃ gṛhakāryatvamanyatanyadyadgṛha kāryaṃ tu kartavyaṃ tattadeva tucaitra phālgunavaiśākhā trimāsāsteṣu śasyatemāghamāsaṃ kanyasaṃ syādgarbhaśāstravido vadetsvātī vai cottarāṣāḍhā pauṣṇaṃ vāruṇameva vāagastyaḥ kuśeśayaḥ proktaḥ kāśyapogārgya eva cacitrāṃ śaṃsanti vasavo rudrādityāśca eva vārohiṇīṃ saṃpraśaṃsanti brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥsome budhe ca jīve ca śukre caiva yame śubhecāpe kumbhe praśaṃsanti bhargaśāstravido bhavetvṛṣabhe pañcasāhasraṃ kalpameva sa tiṣṭhatimakare trisahasraṃ tu kalpaṃ tiṣṭhati garbhakamsiṃhe ca kanyakāyāṃ ca mīne vṛścika eva vāmīna eva tulāṃ vatsa varjayedgarbhaśāstravitśukrodaye vā kartavyaṃ budhodayepi nikṣipetkanyasaṃ budhodaye tu sthāpayedgarbhamuttamampañcasaptaikādaśe caiva svasthāne jīvamuttamampañcame daśame caiva dvādaśe bhṛguścandramāḥathavā siddhayoge tu sthāpayedgarbhamuttamamśanirohiṇyāṃ pradhānaṃ tu aṣṭamyāṃ candratārakamgurupuṣpayoge caiva ayutaṃ kalpaṃ sa tiṣṭhatikalpakoṭyayutaṃ vatsa tiṣṭhate nātra saṃśayaḥsahasrapañcakalpaṃ tu tiṣṭhatyeva na saṃśayaḥvicitrayoge garbhaṃ tu prakṣipenmantra pūrvakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthirāṃśe sthiranakṣatre sthirahorāsthiragraheaṣṭame ca vyaye caiva saptame kendrakeṣu casadā sute ca lābhe ca trayandharme tathaiva cadvayodvayormahāyogaṃ prakṣipedgarbhamuttamambālā ṣaḍaṅgulādhikyaṃ sarvataścaiva tatra vaidvividhaṃ tu samutsedhaṃ rājataistāmrajaistu vāṛgyajussāmātharvaiśca sarvairvai svarṇadīpakamdakṣiṇe yajurvidā homaṃ paścime sāmavedagāḥpalāśa khadirāśvatthaplakṣanyagrodhameva cavaikaṅkatamaśokaṃ ca vyāghātaṃ pañcakaṃ tathākhādiraṃ tu bhru(sru)vaṃ vidyājjambūpālāśamucyateśālīnīvāragodhūmatilamudgapriyaṅgavaḥapūpaṃ kṛsaraṃ kṣīraṃ apūpaṃ phalabhakṣakamtadardhaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā pratyekaṃ homayeddvijaḥmahāvyāhṛtibhiścaiva sāvitryā tu huneddvijaḥhiraṇyaṃ pavamānaṃ ca śannovargaṃ ca homayetyāmyaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ brāhmaṃ ca aindramāgneyameva caaiśānyāṃ dvādaśādityaṃ rudraikādaśameva caapūpamannajātaṃ ca sarpiṣā homayedbudhaḥdaśahotā saptahotā caturhotā tathaiva cabārhaspatyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca yajurviddho mayet pṛthakbahiṣpavamānaṃ puruṣaṃ gatiṃ bṛhadrathantaramsomaṃ rājānamevaṃ tu sauramāgneyavāruṇamṛcā vai juhuyādvatsa sāmagān paścime sadāyāmyaṃ vāyavyamīśānaṃ aindraṃ vai pippalodakān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nīlarudraṃ mahārudraṃ caṇḍarudraṃ tathaiva caprāsādaṃ ca pavitraṃ ca vyomavyāpi tathaiva capaścādevaṃ hunetprājño brāhmaṇaiḥ saṃśita vrataiḥvāstuhome vāstudevān hunecca catvāriṃśakānato devā avantviti ṛcā dvādaśa homayetpṛṣadājyena juhuyātpuruṣasūktena madhyamekūṭe vā maṇḍame vāpi prapāyāṃ vādhivāsayetcaturdvārasamopetaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśaddhastamaṇḍalamdarbhamālāparikṣiptaṃ muktādāmairalaṃkṛtamdhvajāṣṭakasamāyuktamaṣṭamaṅgalabhūṣitamyavagodhūmanīvāraiḥ śatadroṇaiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kurunṛttaṃ bālaṃ tu tatraiva śāyayedviṣṇumantrataḥvastradvayena saṃchādya yuvaṃ vastrāṇi vai ṛcāpaścādadhivasedbālamaṣṭākṣaramanusmarandaśamāsākṛtiṃ bālāmaṣṭamāsākṛtiṃ tu vāsākṣādbālaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ sarvadevottamottamamaṅguliṃ pādaṃ gulphaṃ ca jaṅghājānūrumeva castanayorurusaścaiva grīvā vāhau ca kūrparaucibukaṃ hanucoṣṭhaṃ ca jihvā vai tālurandhrakamlalāṭaṃ bhrukuṭiścaiva śaṅkhe śirasi eva carasāgramāṃsamevāsthimajjāśuklāni dhātavaḥmantragrāmaṃ nyasetpaścādekacittena buddhimānikāraṃ dakṣiṇe netre īkāraṃ vāmalocaneṛkāraṃ dakṣiṇe śrotre ṛkāraṃ vāmakarṇakeekāraṃ dakṣiṇe gaṇḍe aikāraṃ vāmagaṇḍake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṃkāraṃ tālumadhye ca āṃkāraṃ brahmarandhrakeṭavargaṃ dakṣiṇe pāde tavargaṃ vāmapādakemakāraṃ śiśnadeśe tu yakāraṃ tvakpradeśataḥvakāraṃ medasi nyasya śakāramasthideśataḥhakāraṃ hṛdaye nyasya ātmarūpaṃ ṣaḍānanapañcāyudhābharaṇaṃ hi valayaiḥ kiṅkiṇīti cagandhapuṣpādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ vāstavena ca pūrayetvratahādhyāyanaścaiva brāhmaṇaiḥ saṃśitavrataiḥgarbhanikṣepakāle tu sahasrabhojanamārabhetsumuhūrtātpūrvanāḍyāṃ dvitālamūlaṃ vitālataḥācāryo nṛpatiścaiva miśraṃ bhrūṇaṃ ca tatra tuatigupte tu garbhajñaiḥ prakṣipetpīṭhamadhyametatkṣaṇaṃ nṛttaṃ kurvīta nṛttasālaṃ ṣaḍānanaupari cottaradaṇḍaṃ ca śilā yena trihastakamkūraṃ vā maṇḍapaṃ vāpi tasyopari samācaretevaṃ vai nṛttabālaṃ tu garbhaṃ vai cottamottamamtrisandhyaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā trayaṃ vā pañca eva vāācāryaṃ pūjayetsamyaggobhūmikāñcanādibhiḥpunardṛṣṭanna kartavyaṃ nṛttapālaṃ kadācananṛttasālākhyagarbhaṃ tu ākhyātaṃ nava suvratalohamayena vratimān sa jīvati ṣaḍānanatasmātsarvaprayatnena nṛttapālaṃ tu sthāpayetkheṭake devaveśmāni viśeṣeṇa tu prakṣipetbālanṛttaṃ viśeṣeṇa jagatsthānādikeṣuiti kālottare garbhalakṣaṇe nṛttapālagarbhapaṭalaḥ ṣaṭpañcāśat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śeṣadeśagṛhe śreṣṭhamanirvāṇaṃ pradīpakampure vā kubjake vāpi gṛhakṣetrepi koṣṭhakedvātriṃśaddroṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ dīpabhājanamuttamamstambhapālikasaṃyuktaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ suśobhanamajāghṛtaṃ madhyamaṃ syānmahiṣaṃ kanyasaṃ bhavetśvetapadmajasūtraṃ tu kaniṣṭhārdhapramāṇakamśvetārkamūlamiśraṃ tu phalatrayasamanvitamgulavaddāru cūrṇaṃ tu * * punnāgacūrṇakampalāśakhadirannāgacūrṇamiśraṃ tu vartitamdīpabhāṇḍe ghṛtaṃ sicya sarvayatnena buddhimānnadī nāgaviṣāṇotthavarāhavihitaṃ tathāsamudrātparvatāccaiva vṛṣaśṛṅgāttathaiva calakṣmīgṛhānmṛdaṃ gṛhya dīpamūle tu nikṣipetpṛthakpṛthak ca niṣkaṃ tu uttamaṃ cāṣṭamaṅgalamalābhe rajatenaiva kārayedaṣṭamaṅgalamtāraṃ hi ca alābhe tu śūlpenāpi ca kārayetnavalakṣābhirmantraiḥ vinyaseddīpamuttamamtā sāmuddhāraṃ vakṣyāmi garbhasiddhyarthakāraṇamcaturtha svarasaṃyuktaṃ rudraviṣṇusamanvitamcaturthaṃ kubjarāgrāhya jātavedasamanvitamcatvārthaṃ lakṣmībījaṃ tu trideśairapi durlabhamsaptamaṃ lakṣmībījaṃ tu dīpagarbhaṃ tu vardhanamprajāpaterdvādaśaśirasi bindunādasamanvitamgaganaṃ coddhṛtya medhāvī saṃvartāgnisamanvitamnavamaṃ lakṣmībījaṃ tu sarvalakṣmīprabodhanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: maṅgalādanyabījantu sthāpayitvā vicakṣaṇaḥārohantu prakurvīta satyaṃ satyaṃ ṣaḍānanasvasthāne saṃsthitaṃ gantumanirvāṇapradīpakammuhūrtabalā ṛjatrabalā gaccheti rohaṇambhojanaṃ pūrvavatkṛtvā gobhūmikāñcanādibhiḥanyānsarvān bahiṣkṛtya sugupte garbhaṃ nikṣipetagreṇa vāvadhānena sthāpayeddīpamuttamamācāryadakṣiṇāṃ dattvā gobhūmikāñcanādibhiḥiti kālottare nirvāṇapaṭalaḥ saptapañcāśatgarbhāṇāmuttamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dharmakāmārthasādhanamapamṛtyunāśanaṃ caiva dīrghamāyuṣyamāpnuyātbhūmikampadvajotpāta bhaktyanāśanameva cacāṣanāśanamevaṃ tu sasyavardhanameva cacaṭakaiḥ kapotakāraṇḍaiḥ bakairvihīnamatra tupararāṣṭrarājapīḍā tu parasenādi pīḍyategarbhavṛkṣa pradeśāttu ṣaṭtriṃśadyotanaṃ hi tatna rākṣasāḥ piśācāśca bhūtavetālapūtanāḥcatuṣpānmaraṇaṃ tatra dvipādaṃ karaṇaṃ ca caāyurārogyadaṃ caiva sasyavardhanameva caśātakumbhamayaṃ kumbhaṃ daśadroṇaprapūrṇakamrajataṃ vā prakartavyaṃ kanakaṃ triguṇaṃ bhavetrājataṃ daśabhāreṇa rājataṃ śātakumbhakamsudṛḍhaṃ nirghṛṇaṃ kumbhaṃ dvāramaṣṭāṅgulaṃ bhavettīrthodakaṃ prayatnena viprairmāṇavakairnayetāpa udakaṃ dvitīyaṃ ca imaṃ mevaruṇameva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etairmantraiḥ saptajaptvā hiraṇyaṃ pavamānañcadaśākṣaraṃ vā bījamukhyamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japetpūjayitvā vidhānena paścādamlānamālikāmathavāṣṭottaraśataṃ raktapaṅkajameva vācampakānāṃ pañcaśataṃ pāṭalaṃ vakulaṃ tathāaśokaṃ karṇikāraṃ ca bandhūkaṃ girimallikābilva puṣpaṃ śamī puṣpaṃ śvetārkaṃ kaṅkapuṣpakamsadābhadra mahābhadramapāmārgaṃ kadambakampunnāganāgamalayaṃ muramāṃsī ca puṣpakamśvetā ca girikarṇī ca siṃhakesarameva cakṣāraṇī kāṇḍalī caiva koṭṭavī navamālikāapasmāra kusumaṃ caiva piśācapuṣpaṃ varjayetanyadvai sarvapuṣpāṇi gṛhītavyaṃ prayatnataḥcatuṣṣaṣṭiraratni mātraṃ rajjuṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥśataratniścatuṣṣaṣṭiradhikaṃ rajjurucyateahorātroṣitaḥ snāto rajjubandhantu kārayetpuṣpadīpamanusmṛtya navonavaṃ tathaiva capavitre naiva mantreṇa tatsarvaṃ pañca nikṣipetnavagandhaṃ navalohaṃ tu navatvaṅnavamūlakamvajraṃ ca padmarāgaṃ ca maratakaṃ mauktikaṃ tathāmahānīlaṃ candrakāntaṃ navaratnaṃ tu nikṣipettilasarṣapamudgāni priyaṅgurnavamaṃ bhavetsaurāṣṭraṃ pāradaṃ caiva mākṣikaṃ rasamañjanamvaiṣṇavī cenduvallī ca girikarṇā śaṅkhapuṣpikātriphalā trijātakaṃ caiva karpūrāgarucandanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: candanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ caiva apagaruṃ khagameva caniryāsaṃ pākalaṃ caiva māsekaikaṃ yathā kramammahiṣāguggulaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvamāseṣu sarpiṣānivedyāddaśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ śālivaiṇavaṃ saṃyutamiti kālottare puṣpaviśeṣagandha dhūpārghya paṭalaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥbhūtaśuddhiṃ purā kṛtvā tato'ntaḥkaraṇaṃ kurutalikau hastapṛṣṭhau ca astrabījena śodhayetīśānādyādisadyāntaṃ kramādvinyasya buddhimānaṅguṣṭhādika niṣṭhāntaṃ sṛṣṭinyāsa udāhṛtaḥmadhyamādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ sṛṣṭinyāsa udāhṛtaḥvyomavyāpinnyasettābhyāṃ sarvatomukhamādiśetvidyeśvarānnyaset paścāt sadāśivamaheśvarautrimūrtyādīn dakṣahaste aṣṭadevānnyasetpunaḥātmatrayaṃ tu vinyasya sarvāṅgulimanukramātkarāṅguliṣu sarveṣu prāsādaṃ vinyasetpunaḥātmānaṃ yojayet paścāt śive paramakāraṇeśivatatve pare sūkṣme jyotīrūpe tu nirmaletrikoṇe cāgnibhuvane triyakteya dvitīyakebhasmakūṭamiha dhyātvā nirdagdhvā tu svakī tanumśvetapadmopaviṣṭaṃ tu yogapīṭhamadhomukhamvidyātattvamukārastu śivatattvaṃ makārakamtenāmṛtena sarvāṅgaṃ saṃplāvya tu vicakṣaṇaḥbhūtaśuddhiṃ purākṛtvā tato'ntaḥkaraṇaṃ kuruśirobījena śāpyaṃ tu dhārayet sarvakāmadamsarvapāpakṣayaṃ cāsya śatrunāśanameva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: suvarṇarajataṃ tāmraṃ āyasaṃ trapusīsakamāmramaudumbaraṃ caiva nyagrodhaṃ panasaṃ tathānavatvak ca mahāsena varjyabījena nikṣipetnīlotpalaṃ ca kalhāraṃ kaṭumelakamūlakamekaikamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā kumbheṣu nikṣipetbhojanaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca dānaṃ gobhūmikāñcanampīṭhe tu phalake vāpi mālācāmlānā vinyasetutpalairnandikāvartaiḥ vakulaiḥ pāṭalacampakaiḥkāśmīrairvā mṛgairmālāśriyaṃ gauraṃ ca pūjayetdvibhujāmekavaktrāṃ tu śyāmavarṇāṃ trilocanīmcārubimbādharāṃ cāpi nīlakundalamūrdhajāmsubhruvaṃ cāpi sukarṇīṃ ca hemakumbhapayodharāmhaṃsanābhiṃ nimnanābhiṃ turimadhyama saṃsthitāmrathacakragajāṃ caiva rambhāstambhoru saṃhitāmpādaupaṅkajapañciṣṭau pārvatīrūpamuttamamsuvarṇakaṭakopetavalayairnūpurairyutāmkṣaumaratnāmbaradharāṃ sākṣātprakṛtirūpiṇīmpadmakiñjalkasadṛśāṃ drutacāmīcakaprabhāmpadmavadanāṃ padmanetrāṃ padmapādakarāmbujāmpārvatīṃ vinyasetkumbhe hṛllekhāśatajaptayāmālāṃ saṃspṛśya japedyāvattatraiva gacchatimuhūrtaṃ mantrabalāṃ mālāṃ tatraiva gacchatiamlānapuṣpamevaṃ tu garbhāṇāṃ cottamottamampūrvoktena vidhānena ka sarvakarmāṇi kārayetiti kālottare garbhalakṣaṇe amlānapuṣpapaṭaloṣṭapañcāśat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: garbhahīne pure rāṣṭre grāme vā nagare'pi vākṣetre kṣetre koṣṭhakāre prākāre gopure'pi calokeṣu ca * * niṣṭairgarbhaṃ sthāpya vidhānataḥyasmāttasmātsadāsvargaṃ sarvaiśvaryasamanvitamsauvarṇai rājataistāmrai ārakūṭamayena vāphalapañcāśate naiva garbhaphelāṃ tu kārayetkoṣṭhabhittiṣu viṣkambhaṃ aṅgulārdha pramāṇakamāyāma tāvadevaṃ tu caturaśraṃ samantataḥgarbhasthānasya bāhye tu tritālandūrameva cacandrakāntaṃ tu saumye tu koṣṭhe ṣaṭkoṭisaṃyutamvaruṇakoṣṭhe samuktā ca sve sve naiva mantrataḥpravālamagnikoṣṭhe tu vinyasedagnimantrataḥvāyavyāṃ tu mahānīlaṃ aiśānyāṃ puṣyarāgakamāgneyyāṃ śuklaṃ vinyasya tāraṃ yāmye tu vinyasetvāyavyāṃ kāṃsyaṃ vinyasya sīsaṃ saumye tu vinyasetcakrānalayormadhye daradaṃ vinyasedguhayamanair-ṛtayormadhye manaśśilāṃ nyasedbudhaḥvaruṇānilayormadhye saurāṣṭraṃ vinyasedbudhaḥsoma īśānayormadhye añjanaṃ tatra vinyasetyathā krameṇa matimān madhuneśānamantrataḥvalmīkaṃ kṣetrakoṣṭhaṃ ca hṛdā caiveti madhyataḥhimavatpārśva bhṛccaiva vindhyaparvatamastakānkāverīmuddharedvatsa godāvaryā mṛdaṃ haretkṛṣṇaśālī ca godhūmaṃ kalamāśālireva cavaiṇavaṃ tilamudgaṃ ca caṇakaṃ māṣameva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuṅkumaśyāmakaṃ caiva priyaṅgustṛṇadhānyakampūrvavadvinyasedvatsa bījamukhyena mantrataḥlakṣmīśca sahadevīśca viṣṇukrāntirnṛpastathāgirikarṇī sitācaiva niśāgokṣīrameva casūryavartā meghanādā amṛtākṛṣṇamallikāvedaṃ ceti pañcaviṃśat pūrvavadvinyasedbudhaḥkāśmīraṃ harakaṃ caiva mṛṇālaṃ vyādhimeva casthūṇīmṛdaṅgamahiṣaṃ varāhaṃ gajameva capaṅkajotpalakumudaṃ nīlotpalamathāpi vāmallikājātivakulaṃ aśokaṃ jātiketakīpunnāgaṃ kuravaṃ dīpaṃ mūlakaṃ karavīrakameteṣāṃ mūlaṃ puṣpaṃ ca vinyasetpūrvavadguhapṛthivīkūrmaścandraśca madhyakoṣṭhe tu vinyasetadhidevaṃ pravakṣyāmi ratnagarbheṣu vai guhaindramagniṃ yamaṃ nir-ṛtiṃ varuṇaṃ vāyumeva caaṣṭau ca vasavaścaiva dvādaśāditya eva casvasvenaiva tu mantreṇa bījamukhena vai guharudrasūktaṃ sūryasūktaṃ aṣṭavasusūktakamuttamaṃ pūrvavaddhomaṃ puṇyāhādhyayanaṃ tathāyāvatphelakamadhyasthaṃ tāvadgarbhaṃ ṣaḍānanamantrabalāntantragaccheti muhūrtabalā phelakāācāryaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇānāṃ tu bhojanamāyurārogyadaṃ caiva sarvavyādhivivarjitamna tatra deśe durbhikṣaṃ na ca mārī ca vardhanamiṣṭakā vāthavā kuryāt sudhāṃ samyakpralepayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nityameva baliṃ kṛtvā trisandhyaṃ tribhireva capūrvaṃ vinyasya dravyāṃstu paścāddevāṃstu vinyasetuparyadhaścātra śilāṃ samyagvai parikalpayetatiguptamidaṃ garbhaṃ suguptaṃ na prakāśayetiti kālottare ratnagarbhalakṣaṇaṃ ekonaṣaṣṭitamaḥ sargaḥ (?)daridrāṇāṃ hitārthāya tanme nigatataḥ śṛṇusarvāriṣṭavināśaṃ ca sarvāpattivināśanamsarvaṃ vai brāhmaṇaṃ hīṣṭhaṃ pañcagavyasya garbhakampūrvoktaphelakāyāṃ tu prakṣipedgarbhamuttamampure vā kubjake vāpi kugrāme vā tathaiva casuvarṇarajatabhāṇḍāre gajāśvasthāne nikṣipetsūpasthāne viśeṣeṇa sthāne vā kramaṇe'pi camaṇḍapasyālaye caiva kanyāprāsādakeṣu cagaṇḍamaṇḍalake caiva puṣpamaṇḍapakeṣu casāmantānāṃ gṛhe caiva gaṇikāyā gṛheṣu cadevatā bhavane caiva tathā dūtagṛheṣu carājñāṃ saparivārāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhavaneṣu cavatsare vatsare caiva ṣāṇmāseva trimāsikepañcagavyena nṛpatiṃ abhiṣekaṃ tu pūrvakeabhiṣekaṃ parvaparve sarvakṛtrimanāśanamāyurārogyadaṃ nityaṃ lakṣmīvivardhanaṃ tathātaddine duṣkṛtaṃ yacca sarvaṃ naśyati lakṣaṇātīśānaścaiva parjanyo jayo mahendra eva cavahnipūrvā ca vitayo grahakṣatayamau tathānair-ṛtyāṃ dauvārike ca sugrīve puṣpadantake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anile nābhe tathā mukhye bhallāṭe garbhaṃ nikṣipetdvātriṃśadvāstudeśeṣu nikṣipedgarbhamuttamampadadvaye kṣipeddhīmān marīcakasya ṣaṭpadesāvitrau dvipadau caiva prakṣipedgarbhamuttamamvivasvatṣaṭpade garbhaṃ yamabrahmāntare kṣipetpadadvaye kṣipeddhīmān pañcagavyasya garbhakamvaruṇaṃ brahmāntare vatsa ṣaṭpade mitramucyatesomabrahmāntare vatsa pṛthivīdharaṣaṭpadephelakāyāṃ kalaśe vā gṛhamadhye garbhaṃ nikṣipetnavacatvāriṃśaddeveśa tathā vai vāstudevatānvardhate tadgṛhaṃ vatsa paśudhānyadhanena cakauśasya bhavane vatsa dvādaśaṃ garbhaṃ nikṣipetgomūtraṃ śataphalaṃ dadyāt pañcāśadgomayaṃ bhavetpañcaviṃśatphalaṃ sarpiḥ pañcagavyamudāhṛtamśvetāyāṃ kṣīraṃ grāhyaṃ raktāyāṃ dadhi ucyatesa katheti ṛcā yāyādgomūtraṃ pariyojayetghṛtavatīti ghṛtaṃ yojya praṇavena kuśodakampañcagavyamiti proktaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanambrahmakūrcamiti proktaṃ brahmajajñena yojayetsnāne pānena garbhe ca prokṣaṇe lepane'pi caabhiṣekaṃ ca devānāṃ śivasya ca viśeṣataḥcāndrāyaṇeṣu sarveṣu vārapakṣatrayeṣu capakṣopavāse vai vatsa sarvamāsopavāsakesabhidheyamaniyame kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ ghṛteṣu cadvādaśyekādaśī navamī grahaṇe viṣuve'pi ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃkrānte janmanakṣatre pañcagavyantu pāyayetiti kālottare pañcagavyapaṭalaḥ ṣaṣṭitamaḥanantaśaktiśca vibhorvidhijñāḥ ṣaḍāhuretāśca maheśvarasyamṛtyuñjayaparaṃ hyetatsūkṣmātsūkṣmataraṃ paramnākhyātaṃ brahmaṇe pūrvaṃ nākhyātaṃ viṣṇavepi cavajrakavāṭopadeśaṃ nākhyātaṃ yasya kasyacitdhātākhagapatidvayaṃ kavāṭastambha ucyateyonibhramaro vatsa te kaulau parikīrtitauviṣṇurudraśikhākrāntaṃ kavāṭaṃ vāmanāsakeṣoḍaśaṃ pañcapuṭakośau prakīrtitausavisargaṃ vijānīyātkośamantaḥ prakīrtitambhadrakālīṃ paraṃ bījaṃ dakṣiṇastambha ucyatejapākusuma saprakhyaṃ dakṣiṇastambhamucyateprathamaṃ dakṣiṇastambhaṃ tuṣārarajataprabhamdrutajāmbūnadaprakhyaṃ vajrakavāṭavarṇakamkāśmīrasadṛśaprakhyaṃ yonibījasya varṇakamdvitīyaṃ dakṣiṇastambha mahārajatasaprabhamsandhyāmbadanibhaprakhyaṃ yonibījaṃ mudāhṛtampuṭavarṇaṃ pāvakanibhaṃ japānibhaṃ kośamucyatedakṣiṇe dakṣiṇe nāsāpuṭe tu vajrakavāṭamucyatesuṣumnākavāṭaṃ vakṣyāmi mṛtyunāśanamuttamambindumastakamākrāntaṃ vāmastambhamudāhṛtambindumastakamākrāntaṃ dakṣiṇastambhameva hisvabījena mahāsena ūrdhvottaramudāhṛtamathottaraṃ vijānīyātprayatnena tu kārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhavaśarvatatheśāna paśupatirnāmadevatāiḍāyāmadhidaivaṃ hi proktaṃ vajrakavāṭakeśūlapāṇiḥ kṛttivāsāḥ kapardī meghavāhanaḥgaṅgādharo virupākṣo nīlagrīvo vṛṣadhvajaḥumāpatiśca navamaḥ suṣumnāvajraśiṣṭakepiṅgalāvajrakavāṭaṃ rahasyamidamuttamammaheśa varadaṃ hyetadrahasyaṃ vajrakavāṭakammāyordhvaṃ tu saṃsthitaṃ ca bindunādasamanvitamtrayodaśaṃ vāmastambhaṃ śakracāpasamaprabhamsandhyāmbuda samaprakhyamīṣacchaśi samaprabhambhramaraṃ ṣaṣṭhamevaṃ tu tava pora(ṭa?) samaprabhambhinnāñjanasamaprakhyaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ parambindumastakamākrāntamatasī kusumaprabhamugraḥ śāntaḥ suśāntaśca pinākī tridaśeśvaraḥiti kālottare kajrakavāṭalakṣaṇapaṭalaḥ ekaṣaṣṭitamaḥcaturthasya caturthaṃ tu jātavedasamanvitamvajrakavāṭamekaṃ tu yatsurairapi durlabhamkavāṭastambhavāme tu indrakropakasannibhamcaturthasya dvitīyaṃ tu binduśekharabhūṣitambhramarayonī imau vatsa te ca dvau parikīrtitauatha vai puṭabījantu binduśekharabhūṣitamcaturthādi prayoktavyaṃ trayodaśasamanvitamkośaṃ vai hastijihvāyāḥ kavāṭasya hi ṣaṇmukhapūṣākavāṭaṃ vakṣyāmi yena mṛtyuñjayaṃ bhavetūrdhvaṃ vai prabhuśaktistu bindunāda samanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vajrakavāṭamevaṃ tu sarvamṛtyuvināśanampūṣāyā vāmastambhaḥ syādvisinīpatrasannibhamdakṣiṇastambhamityāhuḥ śuddhaṃ maratakaprabhamraktotpalanibhaprakhyaṃ mitaṃ nīlotpalasya tuphaṃ phaṭ tau dvau paṭakośau tuṣārarajataprabhauvidhānaṃ tu pravakṣyāmi vatsa tvaṃ śṛgu sāṃpratamjāraṃ binduśikhākrāntaṃ tṛtīyasvarasaṃyutamlale bhramarayonī dvau atasī bhṛṅgasannibhampuṭakośau samākhyātau mahadagrau ca siddhidauanilāccaturthaṃ saṃgṛhya hutāśanasamanvitamsūryāyuta samaprakhyaṃ alaṃvajrakavāṭakamśuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ dhūmajyotisvarūpiṇambindumastakamākrāntaṃ dakṣiṇastambhamucyatedvādaśasvarasaṃyuktaṃ athottarameva catrayodaśāntadantaśca bhramarayonī prakīrtitauvisargakośamākhyātaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ kokilodbhavamvaruṇa rūpaṃ tu * * amṛtādhāramucyatevajrakavāṭamākhyātaṃ alaṃbuṣāyāḥ prakīrtitāḥvicitraṃ vistaraṃ sūkṣmaṃ paraṃ viśvasya sādhanamṣaṣṭamaṃ nārasiṃhasya trailokyaṃ vismayaṃ paramśikhāhari harācoktandrutacāmīkaraprabhampāntaṃ bindusamāyuktaṃ kiñjalkasadṛśaprabhamlāntāntaṃ vā vijānīyātsarvamṛtyuvināśanamuttarottaramevāhuḥ aṅguṣṭhasadṛśaprabhampiṇḍārakasamaprakhyaṃ adharottaramucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mañjiṣṭhā karṇikārābhau raktau bījasya sannibhaugorocanāniśābhau ca samāsātparikīrtitāśaṅkhinīvajrakavāṭaṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukha tattvataḥīśavargadvitīyaṃ tu kṛśānubhayasaṃyutamśvetapaṅkajasaṃkāśaṃ himakundendusaprabhamjīvabindusamāyuktaṃ vāmastambhamudāhṛtam* * * * nibhau dvau tu varṇataḥ parikīrtitaujīvo vā dvādaśopeta śaśivarṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥyonibhramarabījantu trayodaśa caturdaśaśaṃ śaṃ puṭaho haṃ śaṃ hi śaṅkhakundasamaprabhausaṃghaṭya ca vidhānena pūrvaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ guhaajarāmaratvamāpnoti iti satyaṃ ṣaḍānanaiti kālottare vajrakavāṭalakṣaṇapaṭalo dviṣaṣṭitamaḥkavāṭastambhairuttarairyonibhramarameva capaścānmṛtyuñjayaṃ yogamabhyasedekamānasaḥna daṃśamaśakākīrṇe sarvopadravavarjiteapavarge śubhe śliṣṭe saṃkaṭe sumanohareāstīryāstaraṇe divye hastamātrāyate śubhepūrvāhno prāṅmukho bhūtvā madhyāhne cottarāmukhaḥsvastikaṃ cāsanaṃ baddhvā padmāsanamathāpi vāsamapārśvobhyuraścaiva dantairdantānna saṃspṛśetkapālāṅgadvyaṅgulatvādadhastāccakramuttamamṛṣividyādharaiḥ siddhaiḥ kiṃ punaḥ kṣudramānasaiḥkarṇikākesaropetaṃ vitastimātraṃ tu vistaramatiguhyaṃ paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ mṛtyunāśanabījakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭādaśamahābījaṃ śaṅkhakundendusannibhamtrayodaśāntasaṃyuktaṃ ṣaṣṭhena tu samanvitametadeva paraṃ brahma etadeva paraṃ śivamtasya sāraṃ pravakṣyāmi mṛtyunāśanameva casaṃhārarudrasaṃyuktaṃ kṛśānuntatsukhāyatambindunādaśikhāyuktaṃ tasyādhāramudāhṛtamkhiṅgiṃ cāgnidale nyasya khīgī ca vitayairnyasetkhṛgṛdvai tu nir-ṛtadale khṝgṝsugrīvagocarekhe ge vāyudale nyasya khai gai vā mukhyadale nyasetkhaṃ gaṃ īśadale nyasya khaḥ gaḥ jayadale nyasetvisargau visarjanīyau sa rājā deśikottamaḥatasīkusumaprakhyaṃ viśeṣaṃ bījamīśvaramhrasvāśceti nibhā vatsa dīrghā maratakaprabhāḥśaśinī saṃpuṭī kṛtya binduyuktena ṣaṇmukhaśvetapadmoparisthaṃ tu pūrṇacandrasuśobhanamatikṛṣṇaṃ romakūpe tu mṛtyuṃ palitanāśanammantrodaraṃ tu kṣetrajñaṃ nayeddhṛllekhayā budhaḥśvetaṃ samudraphenābhaṃ satataṃ cintayedbudhaḥ* * catuṣṭaye jīve valīpalitavarjitaḥghaṭikādvayaṃ trisandhyaṃ tu dhyāyenmaratakaprabhampunarvai romakūpe tu mayūragalavadbhavettrisandhyāyāṃ dvināḍīṃ tu caturthāme ṣaḍānanavajrakavāṭe ghaṭṭayitvā daśavāraṃ samā bhavetnikṣipya saṃpuṭe dhīmān pūrayitvā samāhitaḥcaturthe * * * * * māyānnirbindusaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāsādaṃ tu śivāstreṇa dhārayenmṛtyunāśanamśuddhyanti pañcabhūtāni śarīrasthāni ṣaṇmukhacaturdhā pāpaśuddhiḥ syāt jānvādyā nābhikaṃ guhadvidhā vai vāyuśuddhistu galāntaṃ tu nidhārayetsuṣumnāgranthiṃ śivāstreṇa ākāśagranthimeva caśūnyaṃ sarvaṃ nirālambaṃ vijñānaṃ kevalaṃ sthitamvigrahe tu (suṣumneṣa)suṣṭhudevaṃ nityamevaṃ vicintayetsakalaṃ maheśvare viddhi sadāśivaṃ sakala niṣkalamsāṃprataṃ kathayiṣyāmi sakalaṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukhatryakṣaṃ daśabhujaṃ śāntaṃ jaṭāmakuṭamaṇḍitamdivyāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ divyahṛdgandhabhūṣaṇamvṛṣabhavāhanaṃ devaṃ triśūlaṃ paraśudhāriṇamagnināgadharaṃ devaṃ maheśvaraṃ jagadīśvarambhujaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryuktaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanamyajñopavītasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamvibhuṃ ca makuṭaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitamchinnavīraiḥ pañcaśaraiḥ bhūṣitaṃ parameśvaramśvetaṃ paṅkajamāruḍhaṃ sahasradalaśobhitamsarayūrgaṇḍakī caiva cāmaravyagrapāṇayaḥtalpakaṃ bhramapuṣpaiśca mallikotpalacampakaiḥnavaśaktyuparyāsīnaṃ devadevaṃ sunirmalamvāmadevaścottarato japāsindūrasannibhamtatpuruṣaṃ mukhaṃ pūrvaṃ mārtāṇḍodaya sannibhamtattadvarṇaṃ tu mūrdhnā ca vipulaṃ sarvameva hipañcaratnaiḥ vicitraṃ tu pañcamūrdhni ṣaḍānana
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yugapatkramaśo vāpi palīpalitanāśanamiti kālottare vajrakavāṭalakṣaṇe kavāṭarandhradhāraṇapaṭalaḥ triṣaṣṭi namaḥdalaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryuktaṃ pralayāgnisamanvitamcaturdaśasamopetaṃ ṣaṣṭhena tu samanvitamkoṭisūryasamaprakhyaṃ mahāmāṇikyasannibhamviṣṇuṃ brahmāgamevāhuḥ śivamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥārya ātmā jagataḥ tasthuṣaśca paraṃ mahatsarvaṃ māheśvaraṃ rūpaṃ hitamādityarūpakamprajāpatiraṣṭamaṃ bījaṃ hutabhugbindusaṃyutamanādhāramidaṃ bījaṃ sarvaduḥkhavināśanammāyāgnibindusaṃyuktaṃ saṃpuṭīkṛtya cintayetṣaṣṭirghaṭikayogīndraḥ kālastadavalambya tupūrvādārabhya vidhinā nyasetsarvānsamāhitaḥabhimukhaṃ mantrarājasya sthāpya ca dhyāyayedguhacājānyasedbhṛṅgadale kiñjalkasadṛśaprabhaucījīnyasedvitathe tu bālārkasadṛśaprabhauchūjū śeṣe tu vinyasya kākavarṇasamaprabhauchai jai ballāṭake nyasya kujavarṇasamaprabhauchau jau aditau vinyasya nīvārasadṛśaprabhauchaḥ jaḥ jaṭenyaseddvau tu śuddhasphaṭikasannibhauḥindraṃ nāsāpuṭīkṛtya dhyāyennityamatantritaḥbhāvayettu pṛthaṅmantrī mṛtyuṃ jīyānna saṃśayaḥsamyaggaṃ yaṃ daśadvāraṃ vāpitān saṃyahluṃ pratiromakūpeṣu sarveṣu pūrayitvā tu cintayetavyagreṇaiva manasā bhāvayedvatsarāṣṭrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ravicandrāgnimadhyasthaṃ padmasyoparikarṇikeghaṭikādvayaṃ dalaṃ bījaiḥ kramādvarṇaṃ sadaivatamvasavaścāṣṭabhiścaiva aśvinau dvau yathākramamsarve te dhavalaprakhyāṃ mṛtyunāśanakarmaṇiśaṅkhakundendudhavalaṃ mokṣārthaṃ cintayetsadāvidveṣaṇe dhūrmavarṇaṃ uccāṭe kṛṣṇavarṇakamchedane śikrośinibhaṃ cāṣṭavarṇaṃ tu bhedanejvālāmālāsahasraiśca dābhaścantruṃmāhavemastake śāstrobhyaśikhābandhantu rajjunā ?ākarṣaṇe prayogoyaṃ vaśye vādena ghaṭṭayetuccāṭane viśeṣeṇa vāyavyena ṣaḍānanastambhe māhendramevoktaṃ mohe vāyavyeśānataḥagnimaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ tanmadhyeśakramaṇḍalamjvālāmālāsahasraiśca dahetparacamūṃ guhavijitvā parasenāṃ tu supure sukhamedhateiti kālottare vajrakavāṭalakṣaṇe bhruvormadhyadhāraṇasenāstambhapaṭalaścatuḥ ṣaṣṭitamaḥkarṇikākesaropetaṃ tuṣārarajataprabhamutsedhaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu īṣaccāmīkaraprabhamdhyāyennārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ śaṅkhagokṣīrasannibhamsarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ śāntaṃ sarvatokṣiśiromukhamkalpodakasamāyuktaṃ sthitisaṃhāra saṃyutamsthitiṃ rūpaṃ paraṃ hyetat somarūpamidaṃ parammṛtyuñjayamidaṃ vatsa satatābhyāsayogataḥprajāpatestrayodaśaṃ gṛhya dvimātreṇa ca saṃyutamatiśītena saṃyuktaṃ rudraviṣṇusamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viṣasaṃharaṇaṃ bījaṃ sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca yatdvau kūṭena mahāsena vāsukerviṣanāśanamkūṭamuccārya matimān tisrorekhāstu kārayetrātrau cāṣṭottaraśataṃ japtvā niśśaṅkhayā japetabhimantryānnena bhoktavyaṃ pādaṃ caivocidaṃśakamparivāraṃ tasya vakṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukhaṭhāḍānyasedbhṛṅgavatsa bandhūkakusumaprabhauṭhī ḍī vitathe nyasedbhadra atasīkusumaprabhauṭhū ḍū nyasedbhṛṅgarāja bhṛṅgavarṇasamaprabhauṭhṝ ḍṝ nyasetkarṇikāra samaprabhau ?ṭhḷ ḍḷ nyasecca śeṣe tu māñjiṣṭha sadṛśaprabhauṭhai ḍai nyasenmukhye tu pāṭalīkusumaprabhauṭhau ḍau nyasededi tau tu japāyā kusumaprabhauṭhaḥ ḍaḥ dve dvinyasejjaye japākusuma saprabhausupūrṇaṃ candravatsākṣāllasaccandraṃ ṣaḍānanatasmādvai vartulākāraṃ ca śabdasya ṣaḍānanatatrasthaṃ puruṣo yajurbhāsassamudāhṛtambrahmā harirharaścaiva trayastrayo'straṃ yojayetsavanatrayaṃ trisandhyaṃ ca triguṇaṃ ca trivargakamtasmātsarvaprayatnena tadbījaṃ cābhyasetsadājapaṃ yānaṃ prakartavyaṃ trisandhyaṃ ghaṭikātrayametaddvādaśavadvatsarānabhyasecca samāhitaḥṣoḍaśābdaṃ cārdharātre ghaṭikāṣṭakamabhyasetśāśvate sparśanaṃ jīrṇaṃ śanaiśśanairdeśikottamaḥiti kālottare pañcaṣaṣṭitamaḥ paṭalaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devāsuramunīndrāśca yakṣavidyādharādayaḥsarve mṛtyuṃ jayiṣyanti japadhyānena nityaśaḥśaṅkhakundanibhaprakhyaṃ ṣoḍaśairdalakairyutamnālaṃ aṣṭāṅgulaṃ vidyāt karṇikā caturaṅgulamtasya madhye mahādevaṃ caturvaktraṃ caturbhujampadmakoṭaramadhye tu āsīnaṃ parameśvaramprajāpateḥ ṣoḍaśaṃ gṛhya caṇḍarudrasamanvitamcaṇḍavāriyutaṃ divyaṃ trayodaśānta * * *amṛtakūṭamidaṃ vatsa mṛtyunāśanamuttamammṛtyuṃjayamavāpnoti nātra kāryāvicāraṇātasmātsarvaprayatnena kṛtakūṭaṃ samabhyasettasyādhāraṃ pravakṣyāmi mṛtyuvañcanakāmyayāpralayānalasaṃyuktaṃ pralayānalasaprabhamṣaṣṭhaṃ trayodaśāntaṃ ca sarvakūṭeṣu yojayetbindunādaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca trayodaśāntaṃ tathaiva caśuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ samu * * samanvitamparivārān pravakṣyāmi mṛtyunāśanakāṅkṣayātayordvayaṃ bhṛśaṃ nyasya sadā bhadra samaprabhamkratudvayaṃ yajedbhṛtye bhṛṅgarājasamaprabhautṛ thṛ bhṛṅgadale caiva vinyaseccaiva sannibhauvāruṇyāṃ turhanyasya haṃsavarṇa samaprabhaute the vāyudale nyasya mayūragrīvasannibhauto tho somadale nyasya śvetadhurdhūrasannibhautaṃ thaṃ aiśānadale nyasya mādhavīkusumaprabhauevaṃ samyaṅnyasitvā tu mānasena samāhitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kavāṭān samyagghaṭṭayitvā saṃpuṭīkṛtya cendunāardharātreṇa ghaṭikāntaṃ nayetsusamāhitaḥanyadbhṛṅganibhaṃ dhyātvā sakṛṣṇena tu dhūpayetpaṭhita stambhabhogantu tridaśairapi durlabhamlakṣamaṣṭādaśa saṃvatsaraṃ jīvati nātra saṃśayaḥbindunā saṃpuṭīkṛtya mantrarājamanusmaretnāsikābhyāṃ pūrayettu kumbhakaṃ karṇarūpakesuṣumnāntargataṃ nityaṃ śāśvataṃ jīrṇayedguhakṣuddhāhaṃ naśyate śīghraṃ śramaṃ tasya na vidyatevāmāyāmabhyaseddevaṃ amṛtamagnestu srāvayetsubhuktavattiṣṭhate vatsa aṣṭabhāsanna saṃśayaḥiḍāyāṃ pūrayetkūpe mantrarājena dhīmataḥmāsamekaṃ prayogeṇa kṣuttṛṣṇānāṃ tu nāśayetātmā vai saṃpuṭīkṛtya jyotirmaṇḍalamadhyamerājasaṃ tāmasaṃ tyajya satya(ttva?) mekena vartateakṣimaṇḍala madhye tu bhāskaraṃ paramaṃ smaretnirdrānirvṛtiyogoyaṃ puruṣātmamidaṃ paramsvapnendriyaṃ pravarteta tasminnidrāṃ nirodhayetnidrāmūlaṃ sarvaduḥkhaṃ kṣunmūlaṃ sarvaduḥkhakamdveṣātkrodhātsamutpannaṃ tasmānnaṣṭau na saṃśayaḥdhyānaṃ japaḥ samādhiśca krodhānnaśyati tatkṣaṇātākrośālasyamasatyaṃ hi rakṣā vai śūnyameva catarkaṃ ca sarvakāleṣu varjayet ṣoḍaśa guhaiti kālottare vajrakavāṭalakṣaṇe karṇarūpadhāraṇākṣutpipāsānidrānivṛttipaṭalaḥ ṣaṣṭitamaḥhṛdaye sarvamartyānāṃ kṣetrajñastatra tiṣṭhati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca rasogandhastathaiva capuryaṣṭake śarīraṃ tu kṣetrajñasya ṣaḍānanapañcaviṃśatimevāhuḥ sarvaśāstreṣu paṇḍitaḥkṣetrajño bhogabhoktātmā cetano dehiliṅgakaḥjaṅghādi prakṛternāyakassukhaduḥkhātmakaḥ smṛtaḥdaśa prāṇaiḥ samopetaḥ daśadvāreṣu saṃcarethṛdaye nābhimadhye tu gudevṛṣaṇayorapijaṅghe trikaṭike caiva gulpayośca padāntaresadyo maraṇamevāhuḥ śāstrajñaiḥ samudāhṛtaḥkaṇṭakairvā prahare * * * * muṣṭibhirnarānhastijihvāyāṃ mūle tu sa * * ta mudāhṛtamamṛtabījaṃ tatra tatra smaredekāgramānasaḥdehātkṣetrajño niṣkrāntaḥ bahirākāśamāśritaḥvajrakavāṭaiḥ saṃghaṭya sarvadvāreṣu paṇḍitaḥtatraiva saṃpuṭīkṛtya hṛtsaroruhakarṇikemṛtyustatra na praviśet dvārā bhāvāt ṣaḍānanakavāṭācchādanādeva saṃpuṭādeva nityaśaḥmṛtyuṃ pāśena baddhvā tu puruṣasya gale guhatasmātsarvaprayatnena gṛhedvajrakavāṭakaiḥapavarge tu sudṛḍhe naraḥ kaścitsa tiṣṭhatitadvajrakavāṭairācchādya tasya mṛtyurna vidyatesuśvetapaṅkajaṃ divyaṃ ṣoḍaśadalaśobhitamkamalaṃ prādeśamātraṃ tu caturaṅgulaṃ karṇikāsattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva somasūryāgnimaṇḍalekriyāśaktyadhiṣṭhitātmā puruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahāsaṃhārasaṃyuktaṃ mahānalasamanvitamtrayodaśāntasaṃyuktaṃ ṣaṣṭhasvarasamanvitamātmānaṃ vinyasetskandakūṭabījasya koṭare* * * je * * * na paścāddhaṃsena saṃpuṭehitaṃ trisandhyaṃ ṣaḍghaṭikaiḥ samādhiṃ kārayedbudhaḥṣaḍviṃśadvatsaraṃ dhāyetparayāmaṃ samastakamhṛtsaroruhamadhye tu guṇatrayākhyamaṇḍalekūṭamadhye tu cātmānaṃ prāṇaiḥ saṃyamaṃ mantravitvajrakavāṭairdaśadvārān pidhāya samyagvidhānataḥdevānāṃ mṛtyuñjayamidaṃ upāyaṃ cātra varṇitamabhyasedekacittena ardharātre tu vai daśaparivārānpravakṣyāmi sarvakāmārthasādhanamphā phā nyasedbhramaradale kiñjalkasadṛśaprabhauphī phī nyasedvitathe mañjiṣṭha sadṛśaprabhauphū phū dvaye'rkannyasedbhṛṅge bhṛṅgavarṇanibhāvubhauphṝ phṝ nyasetsugrīve nīlāmbuja samaprabhauphḹ phḹ śeṣe tu vinyasya bisinī patrasannibhauphai phai mukhye tu vinyasya piśācapuṣpasamaprabhauphau phau adite tu vinyasya dadhimaṇḍalasaprabhauphaḥ phaḥ dvaye nyasejjaye sindūrasadṛśaprabhaudhāraṇāṃ prathamaṃ kuryāt dhyānaṃ vai ta * * * *recakaṃ pūrakaṃ caiva kumbhakaṃ samamācaretpūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ caiva recakaṃ tu visarjayetrecakaṃ pūrakaṃ tyajya kumbhakaṃ tu parityajetprākṛtaṃ bhāvamutsṛjya śivo'hamiti bhāvayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivameva svayaṃ bhāvya svayameva śivo bhavetsvarūpaśūnyamiti bhāvyaṃ śiva eva sadā bhavettadardhamātraṃ nirbhrāsaṃ svarūpaṃ śūnyaṃ bhāvayetsākṣānmṛtyuṃjayopāyaṃ tava snehādudāhṛtamśivasya maraṇaṃ nāsti jananaṃ ca jarādayaḥśiva eva bhavetsākṣājjarāmaraṇavarjitaḥiti kālottare vajrakavāṭalakṣaṇe hṛdayadhāraṇādhyānasamādhipaṭalaḥ saptaṣaṣṭitamaḥsarvaśāntikaraṃ bījamādhivyādhivināśanampramohān viṃśatiśamanaṃ kuṣṭhāṣṭhakadaśāharambhagandharān pañcaharaṃ rā * * * nharandaśapratyaśyāyān pañcaharaṃ kāsānpañcaharaṃ paramṣaṭsaptatiñcākṣirogā * * * * * * gakānaṣṭādaśapittarogānrogānvai daśaśleṣmavānmūtrakṛcchrān ṣoḍaśavidhānmūtrarogāndaśaiva tamtuniḥ parituniścaiva arśānniṣaṭtridhānapiaṣṭādaśa sahasrāṇi * * cānnāśayetkṣaṇātpūtanāṃ pañca sahasraṃ apasmārāṣṭasahasrakānmahāsaṃhāradevaṃ ca dhāraṇānnāśayanti cavitastimātraṃ pañcakarṇikā caturaṅgulampañcaviṃśatparaṃ bījaṃ jagadyoniṃ parātparamsarvamantrāṇi bījāṃśca vedāścopaniṣadastathāpralayadvayaṃ tatoddhṛtya pralayāgniṃ tatoddharettrayodaśāntaṃ saṃgṛhya ṣaṣṭhasvarasamanvitamsaṃkhyātaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu karṇātkarṇagataṃ paramtadādibījaṃ saṃyuktaṃ tadantena samanvitam

sanskrit: vāgbhavāccaturdaśaṃ yojya vāgbhavātṣaṣṭameva caparivārān pravakṣyāmi dalaiḥ ṣoḍaśasaṃsthitānmādyā bhṛṅgadale nyasya kundasya kusumaprabhaumīdhīdvayaṃ vitathe tu japāpāñjana sa prabhaumadhūdvayaṃ bhṛṅgarāje campakābhṛṅgasannibhaumṝdhṝdvayaṃ sugrīve raktakokilasannibhaumḹ dhḹ dvayaṃ śoṣe tu vidyuccastāsamaprabhaumaidhai mukhye nyaseddvau tu tittirīyakasannibhaumaṃ dhaṃ īśe tu vinyasya nyāsagranthasamanvitammantrarājasya varṇaṃ hi mahāmerusamaprabhamjuṃsahaṃsena saṃpuṭya dhyāyetkanakaparvatamardharātre dhyāyettu ghaṭikā dvādaśaṃ guhayena yena hi bhāvena yujyate yatra vāhakaḥśarīraṃ yatra ityāhuḥ śarīrastho maheśvaraḥlākulai pāñcarātre ca gāruḍe bhūtatantrakeetadbījasamaṃ nāsti pañcākle ca prapañcaketasmātsarva prayatnena kūṭarājamanusmaretpunaḥ somena saṃpuṭya samarasī bhāvamāśrayetnābhau haṃsena vai vatsa japākusumasannibhaunābheradhastātkūṭena bālārkasadṛśena canābhau cottarapaścime ca abhyasedindrakopavatmāsamekaṃ cābhyasetkṣudhā nāgaṃ ca nāśayetbhānumaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ mantrarājaṃ sadā nyaset* * * ṣṭādaśāhnanti sākṣānmārtāṇḍavatsthitaḥāditya iva vai dehaṃ bhavate mantratejasā

sanskrit: cittena * * * * * māsamekannirantaramjānupradeśe deveśamagnimaṇḍalamadhyagammāhendraṃ vahnimadhyasthaṃ * * yornābhimūlataḥdhyāyedvai mantrarājānaṃ bāhyāyāmavināśanamgāndhāraharijihvā ca pūṣā caiva yaśasvinīdhyāyettanmantrarājānaṃ bāhyāyāmavināśanamdvādaśāraṃ tu saṃghaṭya bhṛṅgaṃ cānalavāruṇamsomo rogavināśāya yogametaṃ samabhyasetcintayenmeḍhramūle tu mūtrakṛcchravināśanammeḍhramūle tu pārśve tu mūtramasthiṣu cintayetsomasūryāgnimadhyasthaṃ mantrarājaṃ japāprabhamatisāraṃ viṣūcīṃ ca nāśayetsannipātajāniti kālottare vajrakavāṭalakṣaṇe mantrarājanābhidhyāna paṭalaḥ sarvavyādhi nivāraṇapaṭalaścāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamaḥtanmadhye saṃsthitaṃ padmaṃ caturaṅgulamātrataḥtasya madhye paraṃ devaṃ deveśaṃ bhuvaneśvaramsakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ deva manaupamyasureśvaramudbhidaḥ svedajāścaiva aṇḍajāśca jarāyujāḥlakṣañcaturabhītiśca pṛthagyoniṣu tiṣṭhatitadutpannaṃ jagatsarvaṃ tamasaśca carācaramdharmārthakāmamokṣaṃ ca trailokyaṃ caiva sādhanamsarvasaṃhārabījaṃ tu sarvasavyūhanaṃ yutamsthitisaṃhārasaṃyuktaṃ trailokya nāyakaṃ paramtasya dhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi sadyomṛtyuvināśanamhutabhukpavanaḥ somaṣṣaṣṭhaścaiva caturdaśamsamare trailokyasiddhistu kiṃpunarmṛtyunāśanam

sanskrit: hṛdaye maheśvara sthānaṃ nābhideśe sadāśivamniṣkalaṃ nirmalaṃ śāntaṃ niṣprapañcamalakṣaṇamkaivalyaṃ kevalaṃ śāntaṃ heyopādānavarjitamkalpanārahitaṃ divyaṃ svasaṃvedyaḥ śivaḥ patiḥatīndriyaṃ paraṃ tatvaṃ sarvopādhi vivarjitameva taddhyānagamyamaparaṃ tattvamudvayaṃ tamasasparidehe śūnye pade dhyātvā mokṣayiṣyasi ṣaṇmukhagandhapuṣpādibhiścaiva dhūpadīpārghyameva camānasenaiva bhāvena maheśaṃ cintayedbudhaḥpañcabrahmaśivāṅgaiśca vidyeśvara samāyutamaṣṭābhirvasubhiścaiva rudraikādaśabhistadāvidyādharāśca gandharvāścāraṇā yakṣapannagāḥucchiṣṭā bhūtasaṅgāśca vetālā guhyakā apisaptaviṃśatyāvaraṇaṃ nābhimadhye tu pūjayetnaivedyairarghyapādyādbhiḥ pūjayenmānasena tupūjayet ṣoḍaśairmātraiḥ kumbhakasthasya kāraṇamṣāṇmāsayajanādeva mṛtyunāśamavāpnuyātsākṣāt sarpasvabhāvena pūjayetsatataṃ śivammṛtyuñjayamavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇāsanā cintayato nityaṃ mṛtyunāśanamuttamamsvabhāvagatisaṃpannaṃ piṇḍasthaṃ mṛtyunāśanamtrividhamarcanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ varuṇe varuṇe yajetsaptaviṃśatyāvaraṇaṃ saptamātṛgaṇānapisamādhiṃ ca japaṃ stotraṃ pradakṣiṇamathācaretiti kālottare antaḥkaraṇapaṭalaḥ saptamaḥ

sanskrit: vaiśyamākarṣaṇaṃ caiva senāstambhaṃ ca ṣaṇmukhajapo yogaśca dhyānaṃ ca samādhiśca caturvidhamjapoyogo guṇadhyānaṃ dhyānānmṛtyuṃ jayiṣyatisamādhiniṣṭastasya tasya tiṣṭhati vai śivaḥakṣayo hyajare devassarvajñaḥ sarvagaḥ prabhuḥparivārān pravakṣyāmi mantrarājasya ṣaṇmukhalāvādvayaṃ bhraṃśe nyaseḍḍāḍimi kumudaprabhamlīvīdvayaṃ nyasedvitathe śaṅkhāśokasamaprabhaulūvūdvayaṃ nyasedbhṛṅge pakṣimuktāphalaprabhauḹ vṝ dvayaṃ tu sugrīve drutarajatasaprabhaulḹ vḹ dvau śeṣe nyaset dhīmān mākṣīra sannibhaulau vau nyasedatīte tu vidrumasphaṭikaprabhaulaḥ vaḥ kṣipraṃ jayedvatsa ka * randrasamaprabhausūryakoṭi samaprakhyau candrakoṭisamaprabhaumṛtyuñjayo prayoktavyo japādiṣu catuṣṭayesaṃpuṭīkṛtya matimān prāsādaṃ garbhe tu nikṣipetprāsādagarbhe cātmānaṃ śaktyā kṛṣṇena yojayetprāsādagarbhe saṃyojya paścātsaṃpuṭamārabhetsamarasībhāvayogena nityamevaṃ sadābhyasetviśeṣamardharātreṣu ghaṭikā dvādaśaiva tutriṃśadvatsaraṃ nityaṃ abhyasetsusamāhitaḥbalipalitanirmuktau dviraṣṭavarṣakākṛtiḥśaśinā pārśvayoḥ puṣyā ataścordhvaṃ triyakṣakaiḥātmānaṃ śivaśaktyā tu hṛdayādākṛṣya tatra tusamarasībhāvayogena mṛtyunāśanamāpnuyāt

sanskrit: daśadvāraṃ samyaksaṃghaṭya vajrakavāṭairdaśabhirapitato haṃsena saṃpuṭya tato vai bījamukhyataḥādhārādheyakūṭeṣu prāsādāteṣu vinyasetupāyametat paraṃ guhyaṃ rahasyaṃ na prakāśayetjāmbūnadasamaprakhyaṃ bandhūkakusumaprabhamkvacittaṭitsamaprakhyaṃ kvacinmāṇikyasaprabhamkvacijjyoti samaprakhyaṃ kvacinmuktāphalaprabhamkvacidindrāyudha prakhyaṃ indrakopakasannibhammahārajatasaprakhyaṃ madhyāhnaravi sa prabhamevaṃ sadāśivaṃ rūpaṃ anubhavasya tu bhāsategurubhakti prasādena svānubhavaṃ hi jāyateguruprasādāllabhate samādhirdhyānameva cadharmārthakāmamokṣāṃśca guruprasādena sādhayetputrabhrātṛkalatraiśca kharvakoṭiśatāni catasmātsarvaprayatnena prathamaṃ pūjayedgurumalaṃkṛtā gajāścaiva dāsīdāsaiśca pūjayetguruṃ śivaṃ ca vidyāṃ ca pūjayettrayamādarātsadāśivasya sthāne tu saṃpuṭīkṛtya bhāvayetviṃśatsaṃvatsaraṃ bhadra trisandhyaṃ saptanāḍikamdaśahastibalaṃ prāpya anaṅga iva krīḍatepañcāśadvatsātpañcaguṇaṃ bhavati yoginaḥparivārān pravakṣyāmi mantrarājasya sāṃpratamśḷ ṣḷ śḹ ṣḹ śeṣe caiva tānyantareṣu kalpayetśau ṣau śaṃ ṣaṃ śaḥ ṣaḥ caiva kalpayitvā tu bhāvayetbhāvayedvidhivadvatsa mṛtyuṃ jitvā na saṃśayaḥ

sanskrit: devāsurā na jānanti tava snehātprakāśitamayutaṃ japetpaścimadvāre loke vaśyamavāpnuyātjapedayutatrayeṇaiva rājavaśyaṃ bhavedguhanāgavaśyaṃ śataiḥ ṣaṣṭihastivaśyaṃ tridhāśitiḥnagarāṇāṃ śataṃ vatsa bhavetpaśyanti lakṣakaiḥśāśvataṃ sthānamevāhuḥ * * * * * * hṛtamindrāgniyamanir-ṛtivaruṇā vāyureva carudraikādaśakāḥ sarve dvādaśādityā eva camanurdakṣo vasuścaiva kāśyapo nāradastathāvālmīkī vāmadevaśca parāśaravyāsabhārgavāḥśāśvataṃ sthānamete hi na jānanti kadācanaadhastānmeḍhramūlaṃ tu ūrdhvādhastānmahānalaḥhindrakāddakṣiṇaṃ pūrvā paścimottarakaṅkaṭātete caivāṣṭasīmānte tatsthānaṃ caturaṅgulamnābheradhastādaṣṭāṅgulaṃ trikoṇākāramuttamamsarvajñaḥ paripūrṇaśca sarvātmā sarvatomukhaḥniṣkalaṃ nirmalaṃ nityaṃ niṣprapañcamalakṣaṇamkalpanārahitaṃ śūnyaṃ manasotītagocaram* * * * * * * * bāhyābhyantara saṃsthitamguruprasādena vatsaḥ paratattvaṃ hi vandatidvātriṃśaddalasaṃyuktaṃ karṇikākesarānvitamjīvantaṃ suṣiraṃ gṛhya atha saṃhārasaṃyutamsuśāntāmbu samāyuktaṃ trayodaśāntena saṃyutammahāmāyordhva saṃyuktamūrdhvavahni samāyutamśvetaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tathāraktaṃ haritaṃ pārāvataprabham

sanskrit: śuddhakundendu saṃkāśaṃ kūṭamekādaśātmakamanuccāryaṃ triśakairvatsa brahmaviṣṇupurandaraiḥādhāra madhye padmetu cintayet susamāhitaḥśāntaṃ dāntaṃ samuddhṛtya kālānalasamanvitamvādbhavātṣaṣṭhamaṃ bījaṃ sṛṣṭipralayasaṃyutamsattvaṃ rajastamaścaiva somasūryāgnimeva capṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva cavākpādapāṇipāyūpasthaṃ caiva tu pañcamammanohaṃkāraśca mahān prakṛtiḥ puruṣastathāśuddhamāyā śuddhakalā sadāśivaśivastathāteṣāṃ madhye mahāśaktiḥ hṛllekhā parameśvarīhaṇḍarūpaṃ ha kṣetrajñaṃ kūṭamadhye tu nikṣipetpunarvai bīja mukhyena punarvai caikapādataḥpunarvai ghaṭṭabījena punarvaidhārabījataḥpunarvai saṃhārabījena indreṇa varuṇena camāyānalasamāyuktaṃ bindunādasamanvitambindunādasamākrāntaṃ sarvabījeṣu suvratacintayedamṛtaṃ bījaṃ samarasīkṛtavigrahamajarāmaratvamāpnoti vatsaratrayakālataḥsarvadā cintayetkūṭaṃ kalpakoṭiṃ sa jīvatiprāṇāyāmaṃ tatra nāsti pratyāhāraṃ ca varjayetrecakaṃ pūrakaṃ nāsti kumbhakaṃ nāsti vastutaḥsatyamekaṃ parañcaiva ālambaṃ caivameva tateka eva śivaḥ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamamśivakūṭarahasyaṃ tu mṛtyuvañcanakaṃ param

sanskrit: sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ śūnyaṃ kalāḍyaṃ samalaṅkṛtamsadāśivasvarūpaṃ hi prāsādaṃ parikīrtitamaṣṭāviṃśaddevakoṭiśśivakūṭe tu saṃsthitāḥaṣṭāvikalpadevaṃ tu tiryagyoniṃ ca pañcamamjarāyujāṇḍajebhyastu tathā ca svedajodbhijaiḥteṣāṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu caturāśītilakṣakevyālāścaiva tu vai vatsaṃ jarāyujāstu kīrtitāḥkṛkalā sarvagaurādi godhāścaiva tu kokilāḥkṛmiḥ kundaḥ pipīlikā yūkāmatkuṇamakṣikāḥvṛkṣāvalyaśca gulmāśca tṛṇasaṃghāśca codbhijāḥnivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyāśāntistathaiva caśrutismṛtividhānaṃ tu karapādādirūpakambrahmādi stambhaparyantaṃ sarvabhūta hṛdi sthitamkecitsiddhāntikā ūcuḥ prāptirekaṃ śivaḥ smṛtammadabhiprāyamevaṃ hi otaṃ protaṃ ca sarvataḥtvayā niṣkramate dehī deha * * * * * taḥniṣkalaṃ taṃ vijānīyāḥ ṣaḍvarṇarahitaḥ śivaḥūrdhvaśūnyamadhaḥśūnyaṃ madhyaśūnyaṃ nirāmayamsarvaśūnyaṃ nirālambaṃ andhakāramivasthitamśabdasparśarūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca śūnyakamsattvaṃ rajastamaḥ śūnyaḥ nādabindukalāmayambhūtākāśaṃ cidākāśaṃ hīnantattvastha saṃhitamśaktyākāśamanākāśaṃ bindvākāśa * * * *rudrassadāśivākāśaṃ hīnāvai taṃ turīyakamśivākāśavinirmuktaṃ gahanaṃ mūlanāśanam

sanskrit: śivakūṭe cāṣṭatattvaṃ hi tava snehātprakāśitamhasalakṣaṃ nyasetprathame hāsālākṣaṃ nyasettataḥhu su lu kṣu nyasetpakṣāt hūsūlūkṣū nyasettataḥhḷ sḷ lḷ kṣḷ punarnyaset hḹ sḹ lḹ kṣḹ tato nyasetho so lo kṣo nyaset tadanu hau sau lau kṣau punanyasetevaṃ vai sarvabījānāṃ dvātriṃśaddalake nyasetsamarasībhāvayogena mṛtyuṃjitvā na saṃśayaḥyatra tatra sthito vatsa abhyasecchivamādarātśuddho vāpi aśuddho vā snāto vā'snāta eva vāāsīne gamane vāpi abhukte vāpi bhuktakeśoṣyan nṛtyan krīḍan hi svapansannimiṣonmiṣanśāśvate śivakūṭaṃ hi cintayetsamarasībudhaḥyamaṃ niyamaṃ cāsanaṃ prāṇāyāmanta * * *guruprasādena labhate divyaṃ yogaṃ ṣaḍānanaguruprasādāllabhate rājyaṃ caiva ṣaḍānanamanojavatvaṃ tu jñānaṃ guruprasādena labhyateprāptiḥ kā prākāmyamīśatvaṃ vaśitvaṃ cāṣṭasiddhayaḥdharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca mokṣaṃ caiva ṣaḍānanadevatvaṃ brahmaviṣṇutvaṃ rudratvaṃ ca ṣaḍānanagururmātā pitā bhāryā guruḥ putraḥ pitā sakhā* * * jādhanabhūmi * * * * * * * mathāpi vāpramādācchivalopaṃ syādgurulopaṃ na kārayetśivalope niṣkṛtiḥ syādgurulopena niṣkṛtiḥpitṛhā mātṛhā caiva brūṇahā mātṛhāpi cagurulopī kṛtaghnaśca prāyaścittanna vidyate

sanskrit: ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulāyāmaṃ darbhaiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśakaiḥ śubhaiḥpadmāsanaṃ bandhayitvā karanyāsaṃ samārabhetaṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ pañcabrahma kramānnyasetsadāśivaṃ maheśaṃ ca aṣṭau vai cakravartinaḥpunaraṅgāni vinyasya śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇāḥakārādikṣakārāntaṃ mātṛkāṃ vinyasedbudhaḥnāsāvoṣṭhāvubhau caiva dantapaṅktidvayorapiṭavargaṃ dakṣiṇe pāde tavargaṃ vāmapādakepaphau dakṣiṇapārśve tu bagau ca vāmapārśvaketvagraktaṃ māṃsamedo'sthimajjāśuklādidhātuṣuhṛdaye tu hakārāntaṃ lakāraṃ vṛṣaṇe dvayepraṇavādinamontaṃ tu ekaikaṃ vinyasedguhaudghāto śra i * * * * hi ṣaḍānanahukāraṃ cāstramantreṇa daśadikṣu nyasedbudhaḥtathā ca camanapātraṃ ca gandhapuṣpānnapātrakamkumbhaiśca gaṇḍukaiścaiva madhuparkāṅgapātrakaiḥastreṇa śodhayitvā tu kavacenāvakuṇṭhayetbrahmabhistatra vai vatsa udakaṃ secayettadādravyāṇi prokṣayedvidvān śivāstaṃ hṛdayena catṛtīyaṃ dravyaśuddhistu hṛdayāstreṇa deśikaḥpañcabrahma śivāṅgaiśca śivaṃ vidyeśvarairapisakṛjjaptvā tu toye tu dhūpadīpau ca dāpayetapanīya ca nirmālyaṃ caṇḍeśāya pradāpayetpāśupatenaiva śāstreṇa pīṭhaṃ prakṣālayet tataḥśaktibījaṃ cāṅkuraṃ ca madhye vai vinyasedbudhaḥ

sanskrit: āgneyādisamārabhya vidikṣu vinyasedbudhaḥpaścime paścimaṃ gātramuttare gātramuttarammadhyapādaṃ nyasetpaścāt svanāmādyena keśavamtṛtīyaṃ padmāsanaṃ nyasya caturthaṃ vimalaṃ nyasetkarṇikāṃ kesaraṃ caiva padmasyopari kalpayetśaktayaḥ kalpanīyāstu kesareṣu yathākramamvāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca kālī kalavikāriṇīmanonmanīṃ nyasenmadhye śaktiṃ vai karaṇātmikām* * * * * * * * citraṃ bimbaṃ nyasetkramātuparyupari vinyasya svanāmādyakṣareṇa casthāpayedvāmadevena aghoreṇa nirodhayetpādau pādyaṃ purā dadyāt āgatasya śivasya tuśuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ sphurantaṃ dīptatejasamjaṭāmakuṭadhāraṃ ca padmapatrāgatekṣaṇamsarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamsvarṇayajñopavītaṃ ca kaṭisūtrodarabandhanaiḥdivyāmbaradharaṃ devaṃ divyastraggandhalepanamsadyaṃ vāmamaghoraṃ ca tatpuruṣeśānameva casadyaṃ vai pādayornyasya svasvabījena vinyasetaghorasyābhicāṣṭābhiścaturbhiścaiva vaktrakampūrvaṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ caiva paścimaṃ cottaraṃ tathāpūrvaṃ ca dakṣiṇaṃ caiva paścimaṃ cottaraṃ tathāhṛdaye gale'ṃsayoścaiva nābhau ca jaṭhare nyasetliṅge gude ca ūrvośca jānunojaṅghayorapitrayodaśa kalā hyetā vāmamantreṇa vinyaset

sanskrit: sadyabījaṃ nyasedvatsa aṣṭasthāne tu vinyasetyathā dehe tathā deve agnau home tathaiva calalāṭe ceśvaraṃ dhyāyet varadaṃ sarvatomukhammūrdhni vai hṛdi madhye ca krameṇa parikalpayetmadhye vai śivatattvaṃ tu trīṇi pañcaṃ suvinyasetśikhāyāṃ tu śikhāṃ nyasya kavacaṃ stanamadhyataḥdaśa pañcasu netreṣu netramudrāṃ pradarśayetśivāstraṃ vinyasettatra bāhumātrapradeśataḥśivasya dakṣiṇe pārśve bāhumātrādanantaramaghośastraṃ pade deśe vinyasettu tṛtīyayāpañcamantraiśca mantrajño hṛdayena tu saṃyutamratnodakaṃ suvarṇāmbhaḥ puṣpodakaṃ yavodakamdvātriṃśat ṣoḍaśaṃ vāpi navakumbhathāpi vācakravartyupacāreṇa sugandhāmalakādibhiḥnālikerasya salilaṃ ikṣūdakamathāpi vācandanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ vāpi agaruṃ śaṅkhameva casudhūpyena ca gandhena guṇyaṣṭaphalamiṣyatearcayeddhṛdayenaiva droṇairvā karavīrakaiḥprathamāvāhane hyarghyaṃ pūjāṃ ceti pradāpayetāvāhane tu prathamaṃ sumukhārghyaṃ pradāpayetparāṅmukhaṃ visarjane ca hṛdārghyaṃ tu dāpayetliṅgamudrā padmamudrā mūlamudrā tathaiva capāśaṃ khaḍgaṃ dhanuścaiva nārācaṃ khaṇḍameva cadarśayeddhṛdayenaiva gandhapuṣpasamanvitampāyasaṃ yavakaṃ kṛsaraṃ haridrānnaṃ gulānnakam

sanskrit: pṛthak kuḍubasarpiśca trayaśca kadalīphalamgodadhiprasthaṃ tu prathamaṃ hṛdayena nivedayetpānīyaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ pūrvoktahṛdayena tubhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca peyaṃ ca lehyaṃ poṣyaṃ ca pañcadhāghṛtapūrairyogavarti pṛthukaṃ nālikerakamāmrapanasanāraṅgamātulaṅgaphalādibhiḥtarasīkaṃ ca payasā hasā phalameva canivedayitvā hṛditān lehya coṣyān sumedhyakāmsadyaṃ paścimataḥ pūjya vāmadevaṃ tu cottareīśānaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu pūjayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥnair-ṛtyāṃ tu śikhāṃ pūjya vāyavyaṃ kavacaṃ yajetmadhyame śivatattvaṃ tu pūjayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥmadhyame tu yajeddevaṃ śivaṃ paramakāraṇamsakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ devarūpaṃ viddhi sadāśivamparaṃ śivaṃ hi vijñeyaṃ śivātparataraṃ na caavasthātrayanirmuktaṃ turīyaṃ śivameva catvaṃ sākṣānmama rūpaṃ tu madhyaṃ cāpi mamāmbikāna śivārcanatulyo'sti dharmo'tra bhuvanatrayeiti kālottare śivārcanapaṭalo'ṣṭamaḥaṣṭamūrtiśca vijñeyā rudrādyekādaśa smṛtāḥgandharvāścāraṇāḥ siddhā yakṣā nāgāśca kinnarāḥṛṣayopsara(sa)ścaiva asurā dvādaśā matāḥananteśaśca sūkṣmaśca śivoktaścaikanetrakaḥpīṭhānte pūjayedetān prathamāvaraṇe guharudro bhūtastathā bhīmo mahāseno'ṣṭamo bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahādevaḥ śivorudraḥ śaṅkaro nīlalohitaḥkapālīśaśca vijñeyā rudrāstvekādaśa smṛtāḥgaṇeśvarān yajedbāhye ālayasya ṣaḍānanagaṇapatiśca bhṛṅgīśo subrahmaṇyo gaṇobhavetpañcamāvaraṇe vatsa dvādaśādityapūjanamlokaprakāśakaścaiva lokasākṣī trivikramaḥetān vai dvādaśādityān tadbāhye pūjayedbudhaḥcandraḥ sūryaśamātmā ca vasavaścāṣṭa pūjayetgadā triśūlaṃ cakraṃ ca padmaṃ ceti yathākramamprāṇaḥ prāṇeśajīveśau marutoṣṭāviti smṛtāḥcitraseno mahāsenaḥ sumitraḥ sumukhaḥ smṛtaḥekādaśe cāvaraṇe īśaṃ vai cāraṇānnyasetśāśvataḥ sarvagopuṣṭaḥ supuṣṭaścāṣṭamo mataḥmantrajño brahmavitprājño haṃsarāsiddhapūjitaḥtrayodaśe cāvaraṇe yakṣeśānaṣṭa pūjayetpūrṇabhadraśca vimalī ḍivikuṇḍimaṣva caananto vāsukiścaiva takṣakārkoṭakau tathācaturdaśe cāvaraṇe pūjayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥvirājaḥ kinnarajñaśca śūrasenaḥ pramardakaḥṣoḍaśe pūjayed vatsa aṣṭau vidyādharānapihayagrīvo mahājambhaḥ kālanemirmahābalaḥaṣṭādaśāvaraṇe tu ṛṣīnaṣṭa prapūjayetupamanyo ruruṃścaiva pūjyā vai gandhapuṣpakaiḥsumukhī sundarī caiva kaundakī kāmavardhanīviṃśatyāvaraṇe vatsa asurānaṣṭa pūjayet

sanskrit: devaśatrurindraśatrurviṣṇuśatrussukaṇṭakaḥśrīdevī dhāriṇī caiva durgācaiva sarasvatīprabhā sandhyā ca medhā ca svadhā svāhā vaṣaṭkṛtātrayoviṃśatyāvaraṇe rāśīn dvādaśa pūjayettrayoviṃśatyāvaraṇe grahānaṣṭau yajedbudhaḥcaturviṃśatyāvaraṇe rāśīn dvādaśa pūjayetkanyā tulāvṛścikaśca dhanurmakara eva capañcaviṃśatyāvaraṇe yajennakṣatra mātṛkāḥmṛgaśirārdvā punarvasuḥ puṣya āśleṣa eva camahā vai pūrva phalgunī uttarāphalgunīti casaptaviṃśatyāvaraṇe jyeṣṭādīn pūjayedguhaśravaṇaṃ śraviṣṭhā śatabhiṣak pūrvaproṣṭhapadāpi caaṣṭāviṃśatyāvaraṇe pramathendrāṣṭakaṃ yajetjihvāśikhaḥ śikhā jihvaḥ pādākṣaścākṣapādakaḥekatripañca saptairvā nava ṣoḍaśa eva vārudrabhūtamahātmāno hyaṣṭakoṭi sa tu vai bhuvidevagrahāśca kaumārāḥ ḍākinyaḥ pūtanāstathābhūtapīṭhe baliṃ dadyāt svanāmādyena sarvaśaḥbrāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathāvīrabhadreṇa sahitāḥ pūjayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥsarvāvaraṇabāhye tu kṣetrapālāṣṭa pūjayetsamudraghoṣo vāyughoṣaḥ analākṣaḥ pramardanaḥnīlajīmūtasaṃkāśāḥ anekāyudha hastakaiḥprākārasya tu bāhye tu kṣetrapālān prapūjayetgomayena lipettatra pādaṃ hastau ca kṣālayet

sanskrit: evaṃ vidhikrameṇaiva homaṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥyāvacchakti samādhissyāṣṭāṅgaṃ yogasaṃyutamprāsādaṃ tu japeddhīmān mānasaṃ ca samācaretyāvacchaktijapaṃ stotraṃ pradakṣiṇamathācaretprāsāde savyamārgaṃ tu * * * apavarjayetathavā ekaviṃśaṃ tu namaskāraṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ tu vāṛṣīṇāmaṣṭaguṇaṃ kuryāt manuṣyāṇāṃ trireva capurastāt triguṇaṃ kuryāt ṣaḍakṣaramanusmaranurasā śirasā caiva sā piśāca namastridhāhastābhyāṃ caiva vai vatsa namaskāroṣṭāṅga ucyatehṛdā puṣpodakaiścaiva nivedayettu pṛthakpṛthakcuvakodakena kusumaiḥ pādamūle nivedayetuttānau tu karau kṛtvā veṇibandhaṃ tu kārayetuttānau tu karau kṛtvā veṇibandhaṃ tu kārayetañjalī dvau prasāryātha kuñcitau dvau ṣaḍānanadakṣiṇa praṇataṃ kṛtvā prasāryaiva ṣaḍānanayā ca mudrā tathā vatsa dakṣiṇā ca dvijātiṣuuttānau tu karau kṛtvā samauśliṣṭau parasparamaṅguṣṭhau dvau prasāryātha surabhimudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥprasārya karaśākhāśca īṣatkuñcitameva hiuttānau tu karau kṛtvā karaśākhāsu parvasuuttānau tu karau kṛtvā aṅguṣṭhastarjanī ubhaughṛtamudrā dadhimudrā kṣīramudrā dadhistathādakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhatarjanyo īṣacchālyaṅguṣṭhameva capadmamudrā padāvāhyāmaṅguṣṭhau dvau tathaiva ca
