sanskrit: nirodhaṃ muṣṭinā vatsa sānnidhyaṃ padmamudrayāuttānau tu karau kṛtvā samauśliṣṭau samāpayetjapamudrā tu cordhvaṃ tu mantriṇā tāni nikṣipetmadhyamāṅguṣṭha saṃyogādrajatamudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥvajramāṇikya maratakamauktikamudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥubhau muṣṭiṃ prasāryātha akṣayaṃ mantramuktayāpaśumudrā bhavedeṣā padmapuṣpādireva cakaniṣṭhānāmikāmadhye aṅguṣṭhena tu pīṭhayetuttānau tu karau kṛtvā dvau dvau caiva prasādhinīnivedyamudrā bhavedeva naivedye caiva darśayetmudrā dakṣiṇaṃ cādya aṅguṣṭhau caiva bandhavatalpasattva piśācāśca sarpacūnādi lakṣaṇamvāmāṅguṣṭhena medhāvī kaniṣṭhāmūla saṃsthitaḥparadāreṣu sarveṣu saṃ * * * * * pravīaṅguṣṭhe madhyamau līno nidhimudrā kāmasādhanīsarvāsāmaṅgulīnāṃ tu samyageva tu pīḍayetyonimudrā umāprīti śrīprītiṃ padmamudrikāuttānau tu karau kṛtvā kaniṣṭhādīn muṣṭibandhayetkarāla * * * * * * * * ddhitau sāmāṅguṣṭhau tu ṣaṇmukhakarāṅgulīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ adhastāccalanaṃ bhavetuttānau tu karau kṛtvā madhyamau dvau prasārayetagnimudrā bhavedeṣā sarvaśatrūn dahedapivāyumudrā bhavedeṣā sarva * * * * * * kārayetaṅguṣṭhau tarjanī caiva kuṇḍalākāravadbhavetmadhyamā tarjanīcaiva prasārya śeṣāṃstu bandhayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jihvāṃ tu lālayeddhīmān ubhau hastau tu cālayetuttānau tu karau kṛtvā samāśliṣṭau parasparamkaraśākhā ūrdhvaṃ kṛtvā prāsāryāṅguṣṭhabandhayetuttānau tu samau kṛtvā samau śliṣṭau parasparamuttānau tu karau kṛtvā pṛṣṭhapāṇi talāvubhauvāṅmudrā tu bhavedeṣā sarvavāṅmayasādhinīaṇḍopasthānamudrā tu prajārthī darśayedguhagudamudrā bhavedeṣā viṇmūtrādi visarjayetāveṣṭanoddeṣṭanaṃ ca maraṇamudrāṃ pradarśayettadvatkarau tu kartavyaṃ mudrā tatra prakīrtitauahaṃkārasyeya mudrā svadehordhvaṃ tu darśayetaṅguṣṭhau bandhayedvidvān mṛdā caiva mahān bhavettarjanī * * * * * * * * * * * * mudrā prakīrtitāaṅguṣṭhau anyā sā mūle prakṛtimudrā prakīrtitā* * * * * * * * puruṣamudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥaṅguṣṭhādi kaniṣṭhāntaṃ prasārya mudrā anukramātśuddhavidyā śuddhakalā kaniṣṭhā tu prasāritāsadāśivaṃ śivamudrā pūrvameva prasāritārudraikādaśakān sarvān liṅgamudrāṃ tu darśayetnamaskāro gaṇeśasya vidyeśānāṃ tu śūlatāsaptamātragaṇānāṃ tu sve sve cāyudhaṃ darśayetasurān rākṣasān garuḍānapsaraścāraṇānapiviśeṣaṃ liṅgamudrā ca ṛṣipatnī ṛṣīnapiiti kālottare ayutatrayasaṃhitāyāṃ mudrālakṣaṇa paṭalastrayodaśaḥbrāhmaṇasya mahī śvetā raktāṃ vai kṣatriyasya tu

sanskrit: madhumā brāhmaṇī bhūmiḥ kaṣāyā kṣatriyasya tuājyagandhā tu viprasya raktagandhā nṛpasya tuvaṇagandhaṃ tathā svādaṃ etairjñātvā tu lakṣaṇaiḥhastamātraṃ khanedbhūmiṃ pāṃsumuddhṛtya pūrayetmadhyamā samapāṃsustu hīnā cāpyadhamā bhavetbhasmāṅgāra tuṣān keśān asthicāpyuddharedguhapañcaraktaṃ kṣipettatra mūlamantreṇa deśikaḥdarpaṇodarasaṃkāśaṃ caturaśraṃ samantataḥhimavaddhemakūṭe ca vindhye ca pāriyātraketeṣāṃ svāgnau ca kartavyaṃ tīrthe vā kārayedbudhaḥtayoḥ pārśve ca vā kuryāt sarayū gaṇḍakepi vāsārasvatī tīrake'pi dṛṣadvatyāśca tīrakekṣetratīre vārāṇasyāṃ vā badaryāśrama eva cadevadāruvane vāpi naimiśe puṣkare'pi vāpuṇyodyāne'tha goṣṭhe vā tatra yāgaṃ samārabhetdevālayasamīpe ca puṇyanadyāśca tīrakekūṭaṃ vā maṇḍapaṃ vāpi antastambha vivarjitamvitānenordhvamācchādya ghaṇṭācāmarabhūṣitamdivyabhūmisugandhāḍhyaṃ dhūpadīpasamanvitamśaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣaṃ brahmaghoṣasamanvitamdra(di)vyāntarikṣabhūmiṣṭha nimittānyupalakṣayetprāksūtraṃ prathamaṃ kuryāt paścime tu visārayetcaturaśraṃ samaṃ kṛtvā vartayetpadmamuttamamkhādirāḥ śaṅkavaḥ kuryāt cūtabilvakadambajāḥṣoḍaśāṅgulamutsedhaṃ tadardhaṃ nāhamucyate

sanskrit: yāvanmaṇḍalamātraṃ tu tāvadvinduṃ ca lāñchayetprathamaṃ karṇikāmadhyaṃ dvitīyaṃ kesarān guhaprativāraṇaṃ tato vartya pīcīnāṃ vartayettataḥupagaḥ śobhaṃ na tāvatyaḥ paścānmaṇḍalamālikhetpañcakraturajaḥ proktaṃ pañcaratnasamanvitampadmarāgasya cūrṇaṃ tu gairikeṣṭaka cūrṇakaiḥmaratakasya cūrṇena bilvapatrasya cūrṇakampītavarṇaṃ vijānīyāt pañcavarṇaṃ prakīrtitamśeṣāṃstu miśravarṇaistu lekhayenmaṇḍalaṃ budhaḥaṣṭapatraṃ likheddhīmān śvetena rajasā punaḥmūle kesarataḥ śuklamagraṃ vai hyaruṇena tuantare tu yamaṃ proktaṃ puṣṭinā pātayetpunaḥprativāraṇatrayaṃ lekhyamantaraṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ bhavetdvāraṃ caturhi saṃlekhya śomāṃścaikaṃ likhedbahiḥlekhayetprābalaṃ yacca vallijāti suśobhanāḥvitastimātraṃ dvāraṃ tu haritaṃ pītameva caaṣṭau dvādaśahastaṃ vā ṣoḍaśaṃ viṃśatistu vāṣoḍaśaṃ patramālikhya pītavarṇamathāpi vāyāvaddhastaṃ bhavetpadmaṃ tāvatpatraṃ likhetpunaḥyathārcane tathā bāhyasthā *?vāpi tathaiva caekāvaraṇamārabhya yāvadāvaraṇaṃ śatamtadvadvai maṇḍale pūjya vidhidṛṣṭena ṣaṇmukhaśivāyārdhaṃ nivedyātha śeṣārdhaṃ homayedbudhaḥpūrvaṃ vai dantakāṣṭhaṃ tu dvādaśāṅgulamātrakamaghorāstreṇa mantreṇa japitvā khādayedbudhaḥ

sanskrit: pañcagavyaṃ tato dadyāt īśānenābhimantritamdvātriṃśadagnikuṇḍaṃ vā ṣoḍaśaṃ dvādaśaṃ tu vāpūrvoktena vidhānena homakuṇḍaṃ tu kārayetbilvodumbaraśasyaṃ ca vaikaṅkati śamī tathāsamidājyacarūn lājān tilān mālīṃśca sarṣapāndaśaguṇaṃ homayed vatsa śivāya paramātmanegaṇeśān lokapālāṃśca guṇasaṃkhyāṃ tu homayetśiṣyāṃścādhivāsayettatra maṇḍalasya tu dakṣiṇesavastrān sāpidhānāṃśca sakūrcān sūtraveṣṭitāndarbhacaryāsamārūḍhaḥ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥsvapnastu prathame yāme parayatrayapākinaḥyāme tu paścime vatsa ṣāṇmāsātsiddhyati dhruvamaruṇodayavelāyāṃ saptāhāt siddhimāpnuyātmahodakaṃ tato snātvā pāraṃ gatvā vibuddhyatipadmaṃ vā cotpalaṃ vāpi nandyāvartaṃ ca mallikāmyastu paśyan svapnānte bhayaṃ vā dhenumeva vālabdhvā tu pratibuddhyeta kuṭuṃbaṃ tasya vardhatesahasralābhasteṣāṃ syāt suputrovāpi jāyatesvapneṣvagamyāgamanaṃ ca dhanyammahadarthamavāpnoti rājapūja bhaviṣyatikukkuṭaṃ vāpi svapnepi bhūmilābhaṃ vinirdiśetpuṣpite puṣpitaṃ kāryaṃ phalite phalitaṃ bhavetśāliṃ kṣetraṃ mahatpakvaṃ svapnānte yadi paśyatigandhaśāliṃ mahāśāliṃ kalamāśālimeva vāāyustasya vivardheta iti satyaṃ ṣaḍānana
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dhanadhānyasuputraiśca vardhate putrapautrakaiḥsurabhiṃ paśyan svapnānte savatsāṃ gāṃ subhāsitāmvānaraṃ vā jubīkaṃ vā sarpaṃ sadṛśyate bṛhatyastu paśyati svapnānte rājataṃ kanakāmapipādasyaiva śato lābhaḥ sahasraṃ bāhubhakṣaṇepuṣkareṇa tato yasya pāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutamprāsāde caiva yo bhūtvā sa mudrāṇāṃ tathaiva caādityamaṇḍalaṃ dṛśyate bhakṣyate'pi vādarśanaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ vāpi svapnānte candramaṇḍalamsurāṃ vā pibati svapne rudhiraṃ vā pibedyadirudhiranadyāṃ tu plavate rudhire plavate yadiamedhyadarśanaṃ vāpi bhakṣaṇaṃ lepanaṃ tu vābhakṣaṇaiḥ sahasralabhyaṃ tu svapnānte ca prasiddhyatidadhipāne rājyamavāpnoti takrapāne mahadbhayamyastu paśyati svapnānte mahāvyādhimavāpnuyātraktamālyadharā kṛṣṇā pādadeśe tu saṃsthitākharayuktarathārūḍhaṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśaṃ nayetraktavastradharo bhūtvā raktamālyānulepanāsvasthaścet vyādhimāpnoti vyādhito maraṇaṃ bhavetmāsānmaraṇamāpnoti evaṃ satyaṃ ṣaḍānanaśirasi vā svapnabhakṣaṃ vā * * * * * * * * * *dantāśca yasya cchidyante karatale patitā yadimātaraṃ pitaraṃ vāpi bandhūn putrān suhṛtamānmahāvyādhimavāpnoti arthahānimavāpnuyātyastu paśyati svapnānte tasya mṛtyurna saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ raktavarṇāṃ sumaṅgalīmphalāni sarvāṇi śastāni tālaphalaṃ tu varjayetkiṃśu kasya tu puṣpāṇi karavīraṃ tu varjayetdhurdhūraṃ varjayettatra śvetā ca girikarṇikāharitaṃ pītamadhyaphalaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ cādhamamucyatepakṣiṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ śuko haṃsaḥ praśasyatepaśūnāmapi sarveṣāṃ dhenurvṛṣamajau śubhāḥgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ gavyaṃ vastramābharaṇaṃ śubhamkodravamudgamarīcamapraśastaṃ ca dhātubhiḥdāḍimaṃ mātulaṅgaṃ vā panasāmraphalaṃ tu vābrahmaviṣṇuśivān vāpi guhaṃ vai lokapālakānyastu paśyati svapnānte dhanamāyuryaśo bhavetyastu paśyati svapnānte kuṭumbaṃ tasya vardhateyastu paśyati svapnānte rājapīḍāmavāpnuyātyastu paśyati svapnānte mahāvyādhimavāpnuyātvyādhiṃ vā cārthanāśaṃ vā pravāsaṃ vā bhaviṣyatipravāsaṃ bhavati tasya duḥkhaṃ vāpi bhaviṣyatiphalapuṣpānnapānādyaiḥ gṛhopakaraṇāni capāśena nigalenāpi badhyate rājaśāsanātsadyovyādhimavāpnoti kārāgṛhamavāpnuyātbhakṣaṇādduḥkhamāpnoti yavāgraṃ (gūṃ) vāpi pāyayetmahāvyādhimavāpnoti samudre vāpi majjatisadyo vyādhinā mucyante svastha eva naro bhavetpuṣṭe tu praharedvāme hastenaiva vivarjayetrumnādunnatamāruhya śvetasragdāmabhūṣitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prākāro pānakaṃ vāpi sabhāṃ vāṭālayaṃ tu vāgajaṃ turagayūthaṃ vā narayūthamathāpi vāduḥsvapnaṃ śrāvayedbāhyassusvapnaṃ grāhayennaraḥkṛṣṇaṃ ca goplavaṃ paśyetkanyakāṃ svapne tu bhakṣayetyastu paśyati svapnānte dhanadhānyakṣayo bhavetpurīṣāddhanakṣayaṃ vatsa mūtrāddhānyakṣayaṃ bhavethuṃkṛtvā buddhyati svapnānte āyuḥśrīkīrtivardhanam* * * * * * * * saṃyoge maithunaṃ śubhamiti kālottare svapnapaṭalaḥ pañcadaśaḥmudrāmalakṛtāsnātān kṛtaśauca jitendiyānathavā kārpāsikenāpi śitaślakṣṇena vāsasātasmātsarvaprayatnena śubhavastreṇa bandhayetśataparṇena puṣpaṃ tu tadardhenāpi kārayetīśānenaiva mantreṇa añjalau puṣpamākṣipetdhyātvā tu devadeveśaṃ kṣipetpuṣpaṃ samāhitaḥtanmantraṃ siddhyate tasya kurute vāpyanugrahamśiṣyasya śirasi kṣipya gandhādibhirathārcayetaghoraṃ hṛdaye nyasya guhyaṃ vāmaṃ tu vinyasethṛdaye hṛdaye nyasya trike śiraśśirasi vinyasetastraṃ hastapradeśeṣu netre netre tu vinyasetdevasya dakṣiṇe pārśve sthāpa vinyasetmantrādhvā ca padādhvā ca tatvādhvā bhuvanātmakaḥmantrādhvānaṃ nyasenmūrdhni padādhvānaṃ mukhe nyasetvarṇādhvānaṃ meḍhramūle kalādhvānaṃ pade nyasetpūrvadakṣiṇataścaiva paścimottara ūrdhvataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcamantraṃ nyasedvatsa vāgbhavādi pañcabhiḥsadyādibhiḥ pañcabhistu padapañcasu yojayetpraṇavādi padaṃ madhye namaskāraṃ niyojayetpṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva cavākpādapāṇipāyūpasthaścaiva tu pañca camano'haṃkāro ca mahān prakṛtiḥ puruṣastathākālāśca śuddhavidyāśca śuddhaḥ sadāśivaḥ paramaṣṭāviṃśa tu bhuvanāścatuṣṣaṣṭiṃ ca saṃharetkālāgniścāndhakārādi narakāneka viṃśatiḥkṣurādhārāsitālaṃ ca ja * * pu śītalena cakūṭaśālmalīkūpaṃ ca tilayantrekṣuyantrakampāṣāṇastastapta pāṃsu vai taraṇī ca tathaiva casutalaṃ mahātalaṃ cāpi rasātalamathoparimaharlokaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ janalokaṃ tathaiva cavidyādharāṇāṃ lokaṃ ca siddhacāraṇa lokakānindralokaṃ cāgnilokaṃ yamanir-ṛtilokakamīśānalokaṃ brahmalokaṃ viṣṇulokamataḥ paramśivottamasya lokaṃ tu ekanetrasya lokakamśrīkaṇṭhasya tu lokaṃ tu śikhaṇḍilokamataḥ paramgolokaṃ yogināṃ lokaṃ śuddhalokamataḥ paramlokānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ śivalokaṃ paraṃ viduḥnābhimūlātsamārabhya yāvaddhṛdayadeśikamvāgbhavaṃ madhyadehaṃ tu karṇikāyāṃ tu vinyasetkesareṣu ca sarveṣu svarān ṣoḍaśa vinyasetu ū yame tu vinyasya ṛ ṝ nirṛtikesare

sanskrit: o au ca saumyadeśe tu aṃ aḥ īśānagocareṭavargaṃ yamadale nyasya tavargaṃ nir-ṛtigocarepavargaṃ vāyudale nyasya bhavargaṃ tvīśa gośarenavatriṃśatkalā vatsa mūrdhādipādāntaramnivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyāśāntistathaiva canamo homākṣayā nidrā mṛtyurmāyā bhayājayādhṛtiḥ kāryā ca dhātrī ca grāmaṇī homanī tathānavatriṃśatkalā hyete devadevasya dhīmataḥvāmadevakalāpūrvaṃ paścātsvasthānake nyasetiti kālottare dīkṣāvidhāne ṣaḍadhvaḥ ṣoḍaśaḥpṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva camantrā vai mantrarūpāstu padāni padarūpakampañcabhūtātmakaṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvarajaṅgamamāgalāttejaḥ saṃnyasya āmūrdhno vāyuṃ vinyasetprayojakena sūkṣmeṇa yogadṛṣṭena mantravitviṣuvena tu yogena vinyasecchāśvate padetaṃ viditvā mahāsenaśvapacānapi dīkṣayetvṛthā pariśramaṃ tasya naiva tatphalamāpnuyāttattve tattveśamabhyarcya ṣaḍadhvā tu pṛthak pṛthakhṛdayena garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ ca homayetsamyagvai kalpayitvā tu pañcāśatāhutiṃ hunetṣaṣṭāhutiṃ ca hutvā tu arcayitvā ṣaḍānanaghṛtena saptamyā hutvā sīmantaṃ ca bhavedguhaastreṇa nāmakarmaṃ tu upaniṣkrāmaṇanetrataḥupanayanaṃ puruṣeṇaiva aghoreṇa vrataṃ kuru

sanskrit: astreṇaiveti hotavyamupa niṣkrāmaṇe śatamcaule tu triśataṃ juhuyāt upanayane catuḥśatammahānāndi mahāvrata upaniṣadgodānameva caśivavrataṃ tu saptamaṃ vratānāṃ pravaronmatamdehe vai śūdrajātistu analena tu ṣaṇmukhasākṣādvipratvamāpanne paścāddīkṣāṃ kuruṣva hiarcanaṃ tāḍanaṃ caiva ākarṣaṇaṃ sanniveśanamvedanaṃ ghaṭanaṃ caiva paśubhramaṇameva cahṛdayena tu kartavyaṃ sarvakarma ṣaḍānanamekhaloṣṇīṣakaṃ caiva kaupīnaṃ bhasma eva caaghoreṇa tu mantreṇa upavītaṃ ca dāpayetkaupīnaṃ vāmadevena bhasmamīśena dāpayetsuśvetaṃ brāhmaṇasyoktaṃ kṣaubhaṃ vai kṣatriyasya tukārpāsaṃ copavītaṃ tu viprasya tu ṣaḍānanakṛṣṇājinaṃ brāhmaṇasya nṛpasya vyāghrājinaṃ bhavetnābhiṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā ajinaṃ copavītakamtritayaṃ cādhivā kuryāt dvitīyaṃ copavītakamvaiśyasya śimāpatraṃ syāt daṇḍānvarṇakramāddadetgalamātraṃ vaiśyajāteḥ trayaṃ caitatprakalpayetstrīṇāṃ caiva tu sarvāsāṃ anugrahārthaṃ śivo bhavetupanayanaṃ tu dīkṣāyāṃ kārayettu ṣaḍānanadvijātistrīṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ śikhā caivopavītakamupanayanaṃ tu dīkṣāyāṃ tatkāle tu vivāhakamyāge caivāgnihotre ca mantrabrahmābhidhīyateagnīṣomādibhiryajñaiḥ yajamānastu patnibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: * * vrataṃ ca mantreṇa sarvayajñeṣu caiva hievaṃ vidhiṃ prakuryāttu vinā yajñakriyā kṛtāupavītaṃ vinā sarvaṃ strīṇāṃ yāgaṃ tu niṣphalamevaṃ vidhiṃ prakuryācca paścādyajñaṃ ca kārayetagniṣṭomaṃ prathamaṃ atyagniṣṭomameva capañcamaṃ vājayeyo'tha atirātraṃ ṣaṣṭha ucyatesadyādi pañcamantraiśca vyomavyāpi daśākṣaramaṣṭakā parvaṇiśrāddhaṃ śrāvaṇāgrāyaṇī tathāekaikaṃ ṣaṣṭirjuhuyāt bindumukhyayāhṛdayena tu mantreṇa ekaikaṃ triṃśatiṃ hunetsautrāmaṇī pauṇḍarīkā tritrāṇyenaṃ tathaiva caekaikaṃ dviśataṃ caiva ghṛtena payasā tataḥprāsādena tu mantreṇa homayedayutaṃ guhaṣoḍaśagṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā homayejjuhuyāttataḥprāyaścittaṃ tato juhuyāt īśānena tato hunetrasaspṛṣṭaṃ yathā tāmraṃ na bhūyastāmratāṃ vrajetapratarkyaṃ nirālambaṃ niṣkalaṃ śāntamavyayamvācyavācakarahitaṃ heyopādeyavarjitamśiṣyasyaiva tu vāgghore bhrūvikṣepau tu yojayetmucyate nātra saṃdeho bhrūṇaghno hi ṣaṇmukhaṃīśānena tu mantreṇa prāsādena samanvitamkeyūraiḥ karṇikaiścaiva kaṭakaiḥ kaṭisūtrakaiḥsvarṇāṅgulīyakaiścaiva citraiścāmarapiñchakaiḥanuḍuhairdohamahiṣaiḥ kṣaumavastrairanekaśaḥgṛhopaskaraṇaiścānya bhuktabhāṇḍaiḥ kaṭāhakaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hṛdayena tu mantreṇa puruṣeṇa nivedayetśālipiṣṭairvicitraiśca madhye padmaṃ samālikhetbhadraṃ suvinyasettatra gurustatra niveśayetīśānena tu mantreṇa pūjayeddeśikottamaḥkeyūraiḥ karṇikaiḥ hārairaghoreṇa tu pūjayetkaṭakairaṅgulyaiśca nūpuraiśca gajādibhiḥgṛhopaskaraṇaiścānyaiḥ hṛdayena tu dāpayetpraṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmāvaṣṭāṅgaṃ tribhirācaretcaturvarṇaśivajñānaṃ prāptamanyatsureśvaramdeśikastu tato vatsa male dve karṇadakṣiṇaiḥdharmārtha kāmamokṣāṃśca bhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ narādhipaācāryaṃ bhavane sarvaṃ svayaṃ nītvā tu bhaktitaḥvaiśyastu dhanamāpnoti śūdraḥ pāpātpramucyatecaṇḍayāgaṃ tataḥ kuryāt śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇāiti kālottare yogadīkṣāpaṭalassaptadaśaḥaṣṭapatraṃ likhetpadmaṃ karṇikākesarānvitamharitena likhedvatsa triratnaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śubhamvastrayugmena saṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādinārcayetmudgaṃ māṣaṃ kulutthaṃ ca śimbaṃ niṣpāvameva caraktaśāliṃ mahāśāliṃ gandhaśāliṃ tathaiva cakodravaṃ varjayitvā tu taṇḍulairvāpi vardhayetśiṃśukandaṃ bṛhatkandaṃ sūraṇasya tu kandakambṛhatīdvayaphalaṃ caiva kūśmāṇḍaṃ karkarīdvayampañcamaṃ rājamāṣasya meghanādaṃ punarbhavammarīcaṃ siddhārthakaṃ hiṅguṃ jīrakadvayasaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvātriṃśacca guṇaphalaṃ matsyamaṇḍī tadardhakamṣoḍaśaprastha mudgaṃ tu sarvamekatra vācayetcaṇḍasya mūlamantreṇa aṣṭottaraśataṃ hunetaṣṭamūrtīṃśca rudrāṃśca vasurudrādityakāmapividyādharāṃścāraṇāṃśca nāgān sāpsarapannagānlokapālān kṣetrapālān dvārapālāṃśca sarvataḥśakti caiva śivāṅgaṃ ca rudrāṇāṃ pañcaviṃśakaiḥācāryaṃ yajamānaṃ ca tadbandhūn sarvameva catatraiva bhojanaṃ kuryādācāryaḥ śiṣya saṃyutaḥbhojanānte caruṃ vatsa sarvavyādhiharaṃ paramsubhikṣaṃ gobahulamāyuṣyaṃ maṅgalaṃ mahatdīkṣānte yatnataḥ kuryāt yāgaṃ caṇḍeśvara sā tuiti kālottare dvādaśasahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ caṇḍeśvarayāgapaṭalo'ṣṭādaśaḥuttarāyaṇakāle tu śuklapakṣe śubhe dinemṛgākhye cottare caiva abhiṣekaṃ tu kārayetsiṃhe vā mithune vāpi abhiṣekaṃ nṛpasya tusomaśukrau budhe vāpi jīvavārastu śobhanāḥbudhodaye vā kartavyamabhiṣekaṃ nṛpastha tujīvo vā saptamasthāne'nyatra sthāne'thavā bhavettristhāna āyasthāne vā candraḥ śreṣṭho'bhiṣecanepālikāṣṭottaraśataṃ daśāṣṭā ca tathaiva canīvārayavaśālī ca tilaṃ vaiṇavameva caraktaśālī mahāśālī kalamāśālireva caekadroṇena vā mantrī prāse(sā)dena tu vāpayetgoṣṭhe vā nadītīre vā nadīsāgarasaṅgame

sanskrit: vṛttaṃ vā caturaśraṃ vā caturāyatameva vācatustoraṇasaṃyuktaṃ caturddhā(dvā)ra samāyutamnavadiggaja saṃyuktaṃ maṅgalāṅkuraśobhitamaṣṭamaṅgalasaṃyuktaṃ gandhapuṣpa samākulamaṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi catuṣṣaṣṭimathāpi vāpūrvoktalakṣaṇairyuktaṃ kuṇḍaiḥ sarvaiḥ suśobhanamsarvalakṣaṇa saṃpannaiḥ nābhrahīnaiḥ dvijottamaiḥhomaṃ kuryādyathā nāthāmācāryamatha saṃsthitaiḥekāśītiṃ catuḥṣaṣṭirdvātriṃśatṣoḍaśaṃ tu vāhaimarājatatāmrairvā pārthivairvā suśobhanaiḥāḍhakadvayasaṃpūrṇaiḥ dvitīyaikamathāpi vāsapallavayutaiḥ śubhraiḥ āmrapippalacandanaiḥpañcaviṃśaśca koṣṭhāni kārayitvā ṣaḍānanaathavārdhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā śatadroṇena śālinātadardhaṃ taṇḍulaṃ gṛhya padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhetmadhyage navame naiva koṇaṃ tatraiva vinyasetpuṣparāgaṃ śakranīlaṃ sūryakāntendu kāntakamaindre tu navake madhye svarṇaṃ tatraiva vinyasetsakāśaṃ vidulaṃ caiva indrādyaiśāna mantrataḥtālaṃ ca gandhakalaśaṃ saurāṣṭaṃ tairikaṃ tathāpūrvavadvinyaseddhīmān indrādyaiśāntameva cavaṭodumbaramaśvatthaṃ palāśatvacameva capūrvavadvinyasedvatsa indrādīśāntameva canadī nāgaviṣāṇotthaṃ varāhakuśamūlataḥpūrvavadvinyasedvatsa svasvamantreṇa mantravit
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karavīraṃ tathā śokaṃ nandyāvartaṃ ca mallikāvāyavyāṃ navake madhye karpūraṃ vinyasedbudhaḥsamālapatrakaṭukaṃ vāyavyāmaṣṭake nyasetviṣṇukrāntiḥ sahādevi indravallī tathaiva cabalā cātibalā caiva pūrvavadvinyasedbudhaḥnālikerasya salilaṃ haridrāmbhaḥ kuśāmbhasāsarvagandhodakaṃ caiva sarvapuṣpodakaṃ tathāgaṅgāyamunāmṛdaṃ ca sarasvatī mṛdameva cacūtapakvaphalāmbhaśca mātulaṅgaphalāmbhasādāḍimyāśca phalāmbhaśca tatha bilvaphalodakamsahasre pradhānakumbhe tu sthāpayettu vicakṣaṇaḥgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpamannena saha yojayetśeṣācchuddhodakaiḥ pūrya prāsādena pṛthagnyasetgandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpairdīpairarghyaiśca pūjayetpṛthak pṛthagyajedvatsa sugandhikusumaiḥ śubhaiḥvastra yugmena saṃchādya pṛthagevātha vā yajetpalāśakhadirāśvattha plakṣanyagrodhabilvakaiḥsamidhājya carūn lājān tilaśāliyavānapisahasre sahasraṃ hutenārdhena pañcaśataṃ hunetpratyekamaṣṭottaraśataṃ sthāpayetkumbhasaṃkhyayāadhyayanaṃ cāṣṭadikṣu ṛgyajuḥ sāmapāṭhakaiḥsāme paścime vatsa uttare'tharvapāṭhakaiḥdevamārādhya vidhivat gandhapuṣpādibhirmahatabhiṣekaṃ kārayettatra yena kena tu mantravitadhidārūja pīṭhe vā rājānaṃ sthāpya mantravit
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: veṇuvīṇāmṛdaṅgaiśca brahmaghoṣaiśca sarvataḥgośṛṅgeṇa samaṃ haimaṃ tatpātre madhyamaṃ phalampañcadroṇasusaṃpūrṇaṃ mahābhāṇḍaṃ suśobhanamviṃśat ṣoḍaśadhārā vā navadhārā ca pañca vātripādyāṃ caiva bhāṇḍaṃ ca sthāpayitvābhiṣecayetavicchinnābhiṣekaṃ tu śreṣṭhamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥśaṅkhe ca hemapātre ca madhyamaṃ phalamādiśetaruṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ ca pavanaṃ hi hiraṇyakambrahmasāma jyeṣṭhasāma brahadrathantarameva caamṛtarudraṃ mahārudraṃ pippalādamahastathākaumāraṃ ca tathā vatsa tryambakaṃ jātavedasamśiṣyaṃ vā kārayedevaṃ dīkṣitaṃ cāpi ṣaṇmukhādhanadhānyasamṛddhiṃ ca mṛtyunāśanameva caprāsādena tu vai vatsa ādyantaṃ yojayedbudhaḥpāde pāde tu medhāvī prāsādena vidhirbhavetathavā pañcabrahmeṇa prāsādena tu saṃpuṭetmahāmāyā lakṣmībījena prāsāde saṃpuṭīkṛteprāṇāntāntena matimān māntāntena tathaiva cacaturthena tu vai mantrī yaścaturthena caiva hidvitīyasya caturthaṃ tu māyānalasamanvitametairmantraistu mantrajño abhiṣekaṃ kārayennṛpamgrahaṇe viṣuve caiva ayane vāpi kārayetrohiṇyāṃ śravaṇe vāpi haste puṣye makhottareayutāyurmavedva tsa iti śāstrasya niścayaḥsomavāre ca saumye cābhiṣekaṃ samyagācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhṛgupauṣṇe cābhiṣekaṃ sadyomṛtyuvināśanamvṛṣabhe mithune caiva siṃhe ca makarepi camīnavṛścika tule meṣaṃ caiva tu varjayetmahābhiṣekavelāyāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanambhojanaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca ghṛtasnānaṃ śivasya tuvastradānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ kārayet tu vidhānataḥvidhinā caiva kartavyaṃ cakravartitvamāpnuyātmṛtyostu pañcakaṃ varjyaṃ putrapautravivardhanammantraṃ mahābhiṣekaṃ tu sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥcaturdaśa vidyātantrapārago deśikottamaḥabhiṣeke kṛte paścāt rājyaṃ cāpyaṃ va kuṇṭhayetkhajacandanakuṅkumaiḥ kastūrīkapilatrayaiḥsumuhūrte dine caiva sutithau ca sudhāntikebṛhaspatyudaye ādau nyasedvā sarvakāmadamśukrodaye tu makuṭaṃ vinyasenmūlamantrataḥbudhodaye makuṭaṃ nyasya jñānayogamavāpnuyātsarvaratnamayaṃ makuṭaṃ śātakumbhena kārayetpañcaratnamayaṃ makuṭaṃ trisahasreṇottamaṃ bhavetsahasreṇa kanyasaṃ vidyāt makuṭasya pramāṇakamardhādhikaṃ tritālaṃ vā tripradeśamayāpi vāvajraṃ maratakaṃ muktā sarvatraiva vibhūṣayetyadyadvayasā vipreṇa tattadāyurnṛpasya tuṣaḍakṣaraṃ sadā japtvā arpitaṃ maṇḍalaṃ smaretkarṇikārucakaṃ caiva keyūramakuṭaṃ tathāprāsādena tu mantreṇa pūjayeddeśikottamaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathopayogadravyāṇi gobhūmikāñcanādikamiti kālottare rājābhiṣekapaṭalaḥ ekonaviṃśatiḥ paṭalaḥnābheradhastātkandaṃ tu aṅkurāstatra nirgatāḥtiryagūrdhvamadhaiścaiva vyāpitaṃ taistu sarvataḥiḍā ca piṅgalā caiva suṣumnā ca tathaiva caalambuṣā kuhūścaiva śaṅkhinī pālinī tathāvikṛtirviṣamā mānyā haṃsinī viśvamālinīvāhinī dharaṇī caiva rasabhaimī rasakriyāsparśanāvaśikā caiva proktā dvātriṃśanāḍikānāgaḥ kūrmaśca kṛkaro devadatto dhanañjayaḥaṣṭāviṃśatikoṭyastu nāḍyastu vahate sadāprāṇāpānamayo prāṇā visa * * * * pūraṇaṃ pratiniśvāsocchvāsa kāśaiśca prāṇo jīvaṃ samāśritaḥvāyustejastathākāśaṃ tṛtīyaṃ jīva saṃsthitampuruṣo jīvaḥ prāṇaṃ ca trividhā dehapāragāḥrajasā sahasaṃyuktaṃ bhuñjate viṣayān pratijapadhyānaṃ samādhiśca jñānadevārcanaṃ tathāvedasiddhāntādhyayanaṃ yogaśāstrāṇi caiva hitaṭāka mudakaprayāgobhirvastrādi dānakampuruṣaḥ sattvassaṃyukto dharmajñānaṃ pravartatedāsīdāsamanahvāhamajaṃ mahiṣameva cavajraṃ maratakaṃ padmarāgaṃ mauktikavidrumaugṛhopaskaraṇānyāni kaṭāholūkhalādibhiḥrajato? guṇamevaṃ tu samāsātkathitaṃ tavacauryaṃ piśunatā caiva taskaropādhameva ca

sanskrit: sadā cānṛtavāditvaṃ godhānyaṃ bhūmicoratāniṣṭhuraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ devabrāhmaṇadūṣa?ṇambrahmaviṣṇu maheśāśca śakrāyāḥ sarvadevatāḥgandharvāścāraṇā yakṣā siddhavidyādharādayaḥpiśācabhūtavetālā śabarāśca pulindakāḥsagotrasiddhā munayaḥ siddhā vai saṃśitavratāḥaṅguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ maṇḍalatrayamadhyagamtadardhaṃ tu pramāṇaṃ tu tasyārdhaṃ pramāṇasaṃsthitamtasya madhye hyapānastu indrakopaka saṃnibhaḥudānastasya madhye tu tuṣārarajataprabhaḥnāgastasya ca madhye tu mārtāṇḍodayasaprabhaḥkṛkarastasya madhye tu kiñjalkasadṛśaprabhaḥdhanañjayastasya madhye gokṣīrasadṛśaprabhaḥapāno meḍhragudayoḥ muṇḍalyādau ca saṃsthitāḥkṛkarastu lalāṭe tu galakūrparapāṇiṣuvṛṣaṇau ūrujānū ca jaṅghe pṛṣṭhe ca bāhuṣujihvāyāṃ tālurandhre ca jaṭhare nābhipādayoḥsamānaḥ sarvamaṅgeṣu vyāpyate ca * * * *vaiśvānarasupākaṃ tu annapānādyabhakṣakaiḥadhonayati sarvaṃ tu apānastena kīrtitaḥvātaṃ pittaṃ ca śleṣmāṇaṃ trikopasānnipātakamāropāṃ bāhyayāgaṃ ca mahodaraṃ pāṇḍurogakamsvanayatyadharaṃ vajraṃ (kraṃ) gotratetra prakopanampādako pāyūpasthatvāpūrakaṃ recakaṃ tathāprītirvināśakathanaṃ jārdhakyaṃ ca jarāśca hi

sanskrit: samastagatigātrāṇi jvarakuṣṭhapramehakānadhikaṃ na kurute vāyuḥ sarvabhūta hiteṣu caudgāro nāga ityuktaḥ kūrma unmīlane sthitaḥdhanañjayasthito vākṣo mṛtasyāpi na muñcatijīvaḥ prāṇaḥ suṣumnāyāṃ calato sarvakālikealpavṛkṣe yā kumbāṃ cāpāna eva tu sañcaretmukhe nāse ca netre ca nāgaḥ kūrmastu sañcaretdevadatto dhanañjaya pādameḍhre ca sañcaretcakravatsaṃsthitā nāḍyaḥ teṣu madhyeṣu cānilaḥūrdhvādhaśca dvayodvāraṃ nāḍīcakraṃ prakīrtitamdve dve kaṭī bhavedvatsa iḍā piṅgalakāvapidakṣiṇe pañcaghaṭikā vāmake pañca caiva cadaśārapaṅkaje nityaṃ puruṣā ghaṭikādvayamuttaraṃ dakṣiṇe caiva vāmadakṣiṇasaṃsthitamsaṃkrāntirviṣuvaṃ caiva ahorātrādha(ya)nāni ca* * * traṃ bhaveddhikkā adhimāso vijṛmbhikāsaṃkrāntiḥ punaradhyaiva saṃsthānāt sthānameva tusuṣumnāmadhyeṣveṣaṅge eṣā saṃkrāntirucyatenābhigranthiṃ samāśritya vā dakṣiṇasaṃsthitaumūrdhnigranthiṃ samāśritya nāsāpuṭaviniḥsṛtauparavedikadehe tu paramātmani saṃviśetmadhyame ubhayoścaiva brahmarandhre tu viśritāsamāhṛtau nābhigranthau tu punarbhūgranthisaṃgataudarśanaṃ sarvavastūnāṃ punarvai madhyasaṃviśetvinirga * * sa * * punarbhūgranthisaṃgatau

sanskrit: punaḥśrotradvaye caiva gatvā caiva tu saṃviśetśaṅkhinī dvau mālinī tu kandamūlau samāśritauśaṅkhinmūrdhvamadhaścaiva ūrdhvaṃ nābhervinirgatāhlādinī mohinī caiva kampinī meghanī śubhākaṭigranthiṃ samāveśya jānugranthiṃ tu saṃgatauvikṛtirviṣamāmātyā haṃsinī viśvamālinīkaṭigranthau tu vāśliṣya jānugranthiṃ samāśritāgaginī ghoṣaṇī caiva tejinī rasavāhinīnābhigranthau tu saṃgatya hṛdayagranthisaṃgatādakṣiṇe tu kare sandhikūrparagranthisaṃgatāḥdharaṇī rasabhojī ca saṃkriyāśītavīryakānābhigranthiṃ samāśritya hṛdayagranthimāśritābāhukūrparagranthiṃ tu maṇigranthiṃ samāśritāsparśāvakāśikā caiva vāmadakṣiṇa pārśvagāḥmahānāḍī mahābaddhā dvātriṃśannāḍikāḥ parāḥaṣṭāviṃśatikoṭistu pradhānāste prakīrtitāḥromakūpeṣu sarveṣu nāḍyasteṣu prakīrtitāḥkṣetrajñaḥ puruṣaḥ svasthaḥ ajño bhogasamanvitaḥkṣetrajño jīvaprāṇaiśca sarvaprāṇiṣu sarvadāśuṣka patramivākāśe nīyate vāyunā yathāpatantyutpatate śānto vigrahe ca punaḥ punaḥśāśvataḥ puruṣaḥ sūkṣmo nirālambaḥ paraḥ śivaḥ* * * * candradale āgneye tu tathaiva cavaruṇe digdale caiva vāyavye tu tathaiva caevaṃ dvātriṃśadghaṭikā saṃcaretpuruṣo mahān

sanskrit: aṣṭabhāgaikabhāgaṃ tu dvātriṃśaccaratoḥ sadāparate tava mahāsena sendrāścaiva? palabhyatenavanāḍyaḥ sahasrāṃśaṃ carate teṣu nāḍiṣusarvajñaḥ sarvagaḥ śāntaḥ sarvadā sarvatomukhaḥparamātmā mahāhetu kṣetrajño hṛdi saṃsthitaḥmaraṇakāle tu vai vatsa nāḍīmadhye tu saṃsthitaḥityetadvāyavaṃ bṛndaṃ hitacakre pratiṣṭhitamjananamaraṇajaiḥ* * * * * krīḍate sarvatattvaiḥūrdhvaḥ prāṇo'pyadhaḥ prokta apāno rātrireva cadakṣiṇe cāśvayugmeṣu uttare caitrake viṣusamyaksaṃkramate deva saṃkrāntistena mu(u)cyateamāvāsyādito domāvāsī tena ucyatepañcadaśa * sau nityaṃ kalāpūrṇastu candramāḥkalāpūrṇe paurṇamāsī tantra vidbhirudāhṛtācandrādityau paurṇasevī va * * * * * syaṃ tusarvaṃ saṃhṛtya matimān prāṇānāṃ hṛdaye guhabhruvormadhye tu mūrdhau tu nayetprāṇaṃ tu buddhimānsadāśivapadaṃ gatvā na bhūyo janmacāpnuyātiti kālottare nāḍicakrapaṭalaḥ viṃśatiḥsvasthānarākṣanīmeṣaścaturbhāgopalakṣitaḥtriṭidvayaṃ kṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ tṛtīyaṃ kṣaṇikaṃ bhavettruṭirdvātriṃśatkalā jñeyā kalāṣṭaṃ karaṇaṃ bhavetatītānāgataṃ caiva vartamānaṃ tathaiva ca* * masti jñānavijñānaṃ mṛtyupañcakaṃ tathāaindramāgneyayāmyaṃ ca nair-ṛtaṃ vāruṇaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ūrdhvaṃ ca navamaṃ proktaṃ adhāśca daśamaṃ bhavettatsaṃkrāntau parikṣetaśvāsaṃ caiva ṣaḍānanaṣaṣṭyucchvāso bhavetprāṇaḥ ṣaṭprāṇo ghaṭikā bhavetpañcaghaṭikā bhavedvāme sarvāriṣṭavivarjitamaśītyāyurhavatyeva samyak jñānena vai budhaḥsaptati caiva āyuṣyaṃ śivena paribhāṣitamcarate muhurmuhurvatsa samāḥ ṣaṣṭiṃ sa jīvatipañcatriṃśatsa jīvettu iti śāstrasya niścayaḥtriṃśatsaṃvatsaraṃ jīvet hṛnnābhijaṭharāśritaḥsaptaviṃśatsaṃvatsaraṃ jīvatīti ṣaḍānanaṣaḍviṃśatsaṃvatsaraṃ tasya jīvitaṃ vai narasya tusārdhayugmaguṇāṃ vatānādityavasuṣoḍaśānstāste hāniśeṣāstiśidiguṣu guṇardhendavo jīvitasyāuttarāyaṇavāme tu tasya jyotirna dṛśyatedakṣiṇāyanavāme ca ūrdhvajyotistu dṛśyatevāme caiva adhojyotirna dṛśyate cārdha * * kevāmadakṣiṇatajjyotirdṛśyate brāhmike yadādakṣiṇe dakṣiṇe jyotirdṛśyate nārdharātrakedakṣiṇe cottare jyotirbāhye caiva na dṛśyategulphājjīvo na dṛśyeta pādayostu yadā naraḥkūrparasya adhobhāge japaṃ yasya na vidyatesamudradyoṇona śrāvyo yatra binduṃ na paśyativāyaso līyate mūrdhni śvāno vā yadi līyatepañcatriṃśacca ghaṭikā sa jīvati na saṃśayaḥdaṇḍena praharetpuruṣaḥ saptāhānmaraṇaṃ bhavet

sanskrit: āliṅganaṃ bhavetsvapne jāgre vā yadi paśyatirajasvalā coṣṭrarūḍhā vidhavāmuṇḍitaśśiraḥaṣṭahāni sa jīveta iti śāstrasya niścayaḥāliṅganaṃ bhavedyasya tasya mṛtyurna saṃśayaḥraktāmbaradharao bhūtvā raktamālyānulepanaḥūrdhvadīpaṃ ca paśyeta cañcalaṃ vāpi śāmyatiadhojyotirna paśyeta madhyadehe tu vai budhaḥyāmyādidigdale jyotiratasīkusumaprabhamnair-ṛtyāṃ digdale jyotiḥ rājāvartamaṇiprabhamvāruṇe digdale jyotirdṛśyate sphaṭikaprabhamvāyavyāṃ digdale jyotiḥ haridrārasasannibhammadhyāhne tu amāvāsyāṃ mahadbhāṇḍe jale guhatasya mṛtyurdhruvaṃ nityaṃ tripakṣānniścayaṃ bhavettasya mṛtyurna saṃdeho nātra kāryā vicāraṇāaṣṭādaśadinānmṛtyuriti śāstrasya nityaśaḥdhvayāpuruṣamāpaśyet trimāsānmaraṇaṃ bhavetṣaṇmāsānmṛtyumāpnoti saśivastaṃ na paśyatikabandhaṃ dṛśyate tasya trimāsānmaraṇaṃ bhavetjāgre vā yadi vā svapna trimāsaṃ tasya jīvitamśirasyupari gagane dṛśyate nararūpakāchinnanāsā kṛṣṇavarṇā pāśakhaḍgadharā mahatgagane dṛśyate vatsa pāśenaiva tu badhyatekṛṣṇaśvā tu suṣumnāgre praviśedgṛhameva vā* * * * vālipānaṃ bhaveccaiva muhurmuhuḥrathena karayuktena raktavastravṛtena ca

sanskrit: yadi vā yadi vā svapne sa pakṣānmaraṇaṃ bhavetakāmo bhūmikampaṃ vā daśāhānmaraṇaṃ bhavetyadi paśyenmadhyadehe dvidinena sa jīvatimadhyadehe yadā paśyet viśe * * * * * *śāstā svaraṃ vā śāstāraṃ hṛdaye madhyadehakekṛṣṇāṃ gavāṃ śṛṅgayordve gṛhītvā dhāvate yadikodaṇḍe śāśvatasthāne mūrdhānte dvādaśāṅgulemṛtyunāśritaṃ dhyānaṃ ca sāṃprataṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukhaprāsādaṃ candrabimbena saṃpuṭīkṛtya buddhimānvivatsareṇa vai vatsa mṛtyunāśanamuttamamindrakopanibhaṃ dhyāyet prāsādaṃ śaśibimbakambindunādaśikhākrāntaṃ ghaṭikā saptamā bhavetśaṅkhakundendudhavalaṃ prāsādaṃ madhyadehakedvātriṃśadvatsaraṃ dhyāyet ṣaṭsahasraṃ sa jīvatitasya madhye tu cātmānaṃ candrabimbena saṃpuṭetsa jīvetsaptasāhasraṃ vatsaraṃ tu ṣaḍānanaadhordhvaṃ candrabimbena sampuṭīkṛtya buddhimāncaturviṃśadvatsaraṃ tu sahasrāṣṭau sa jīvatitasya madhye tu cātmānaṃ caturthena tu saṃpuṭetnava sahasraṃ sa jīveta iti satyaṃ ṣaḍānanasa caturthena vai hanta bindunādasamanvitamsaptadaśa ghaṭikā dhyāyet ṣaḍviṃśati tu vatsarānhṛtpadme maṇḍale tatra kṣetrajñaṃ saṃpuṭennaraḥbinduyukto tu medhāvī saptaviṃśativatsarānayutaṃ dvisahasraṃ tu sa jīvennātra saṃśayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prāsādaṃ cintayedvatsa hṛdaye savyamadhyagamjapāsumasamaprakhyaṃ nityameva vicintayet* * * * * * * * ekacittena buddhimānpañcadaśa sahasraṃ tu sa jīvati ṣaḍānanaprāsādaṃ cintayettatra ṣoḍaśasvarabhūṣitamhomakūpeṣu sarveṣu kṛṣṇarūpaṃ vicintayetpalitastambhanaṃ hyetat vatsaraikonaviṃśatiayutadvayaṃ sa jīveta brahmacaryavrāte sthitamśatadalaṃ candrabimbena saṃpuṭīkṛtya buddhimānkālāgniśivaparyantamiti śvetaṃ vicintayetjarāmaraṇa nimuktamayutatrayaṃ sa jīvatiātmānaṃ tatra madhye tu prāsādāgre vicintayetcandrabimbāmṛtenaiva vigrahaṃ plāvayettataḥayutaṃ caturthakaṃ jīvet dviraṣṭavarṇakṛtiḥtasya madhye tu prāsādaṃ śaśinā saṃpuṭīkṛtamtena plāvitamātmānaṃ āpūryantaṃ vicintayetayutaṃ pañcakaṃ jīvennātra kārya vicāraṇāprāsādaṃ cintayedvidvān ātmānaṃ tasya madhyagamsravantamamṛtaṃ dhyāyet āpūrya plāvayedbudhaḥgokṣīradhavalaṃ saumyamāpādatalamadhyagamrecakaṃ tu parityajya pūrakaṃ tu sadābhyasetātmanāsikayābhyantaṃ jaṭharābhyantarāntakamtasya madhye tu cātmānaṃ śaśinā saṃpuṭīkṛtamkhamadhye kurucātmānaṃ ātmamadhye tu khaṃ kurusākṣānmṛtyuñjayo yogo mahāpralayaṃ sa jīvati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: samarasī bhāvayedyogī tena mṛtyuvināśanamsamarasaṃ bhāvayogī mṛtyunāśanamtasya madhye tu cātmānaṃ satataṃ bhāvayedbudhaḥmṛtyuñjayaṃ paraṃ hyetat ambaratvamavāpnuyātsamarasībhāvayogena mṛtyunāśanamuttamammadhyadehe tu satataṃ samarasaṃ bhāvayedbudhaḥculukāṃ vā pibetprātaḥ somāmṛtajaloṣitamsvareṇa peṣayeccandraḥ candramadhye śivaṃ bhavetrecakaṃ pūrakaṃ tyajya kumbhakaṃ tu samabhyaset?akāraṃ mūrdhni vinyasya ākāraṃ tu lalāṭakoṛ ṝ sā?mādvaye nyasya ḷ ḹ gaṇḍaṃdvaye nyasetaṃ aḥ dantadvaye nyasya * *? taṃ vinyasedbudhaḥṭavargaṃ dakṣiṇe pārśva?mavargaṃ vāmapādakehakāraṃ hṛdaye nyasya makāraṃ nābhideśataḥlakāraṃ māṃsadeśe tu vakāraṃ medadeśakesakāraṃ śuklamityuktaṃ hakāraṃ meḍhradeśataḥbinduyuktena sarvaṃ tu nyasedetā nanukramātsarvakarmasu medhāvī mātṛkāṃ nyasya tattvataḥiti kālottare ayutakṣayasaṃhitāyāṃ kālacakrapaṭalaḥ ekaviṃśatiḥsarvavyāpivaraṃ? śubhraṃ vayasaḥ sthāpanaṃ paramkaliyuge * * *? tu śāstrokta tu samārabhetkṛtayuge siddhimāpnoti śāstroktaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥnaimiśe puṣkare vāpi kurukṣetre sukhapradeaṣṭabhāse prabhāse vā devadāruvane'pi vāhimavaddhemakūṭe ca niṣedhe nīlaparvate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīśailesvāmiśaile vā godāvaryāṃ sarasvatausindhusarastīre vā sarasvatyāstaṭepi vābrāhmaṇasya mahīśvetā raktabhūmistu bhūpateḥviprasya ghṛtagandhātu raktagandhā nṛpasya tuvarṇaṃ gandhaṃ rasaṃ jñātvā yogaveśma samārabhetyogasthānāni sarvāṇi vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥtribhūmiṃ vā dvibhūmiṃ vā ekabhūmimathāpi vākavāṭārgalasaṃyuktaṃ prākārairdīrghakairyutamnālikeraiḥ kamukaiśca puṃnāgavakulairyutamgāvo vaseyuḥ saptāhaṃ mapatirdaśabhirnavauttare tu jalagrāmaṃ paścime padmamaṇḍapambarbaraiśca pulindaiśca kirātaiśca vivarjitam* sti? tvāsanaṃ baddhā nāḍīśodhanamārabhettālusthā calajihvā ca saṃvṛtāsyaḥ suniścayaḥpraṇipatya śivaṃ śāntaṃ yogīndraḥ śaśiśekharamnāsāgre śaśabhṛdbimbaṃvat jyotsnājālavitānitampañcākṛtyātha niṣkramya iḍayā varmaṇā sahayaddvitīyaṃ binduyuktaṃ trikoṇe analāyutepūrvavatpūrayennāḍyā prāṇaṃ dakṣiṇayā guhatricatuḥ savanaṃ māsaṃ pakṣaṃ vai māsamabhyasetīṣadvaiśeṣikopāyaṃ mānasapraṇavena camāsatrikaṃ triṣavaṇeṣvanayā śuddhirīritājñānābhivyaktirityetacchinnaṃ tacchuddhisūcakam* * * na? samānastu vyāno'thodāna eva caeteṣāṃ vijayaṃ vatsa * * * * * * rṇakān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nīlavarṇapratīkāśaṃ rephādi bindusaṃyutamrecakaṃ pūrvakaṃ caiva kumbhakaṃ tu sadābhyasetkumbhakastu catuṣṣaṣṭidivasaḥ śiva saṃyutam* * * * samabhyasya dviguṇaṃ punarācaretpañcame vatsaremantrī catuṣṣaṣṭiguṇaṃ bhavetmarūdvijayamārgeṇa vikalpaṃ keśavena cagatyāgatiprayogo'yaṃ pūrvavatkramaśo'paramuktaḥ kramāddvivarṣo'yaṃ keśavenānuvarṇitamvi * *? jānugulphaṃ ca ubhau sandhiśca pṛṣṭhasau* *? tu saṃyuktaḥ pūrakādīn sa pūrvavata * * kaṃ? śavo'pyevamabhyāsaḥ parigīyateiti recakaḥ prasthānaḥ? pūrake haṃsasaṃśriyāthṛnnābhiḥ sarvasiddhisthaḥ kaṭikūrparajānukaḥsaumyanbī?jasamopetaṃ prāsādaṃ bindusaṃyutamanārataḥ kriyāyogāt recakaḥ pūrvayoḥ kramāthṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhye karṇayorakṣayorapiprasādena tu saṃyuktaḥ anilāttu tṛtīyakaḥkarayorubhayoścaiva kakṣayorubhayorapibhṛṅgavarṇaṃ udānastu yakārasthottaradvayamna? kukṣiśca pṛṣṭhaśca sarvāṅgasarvasandhiṣupūrvatpūrakaṃ caiva recakaṃ kumbhakaṃ tu vāyakārādicaturthaṃ tu bhāntameva tu pañcamamprāsādena tu devena nāthādivijayaṃ kurupratilomakramaṃ kuryāt keśavasya tu dhīmataḥsarvavāyujayamicchet vidyābhyāsaprayogataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: udānamānīya tatraiva vyānena tu samanvitamkṛkaraṃ devadattaṃ ca dhanañjaya kṛṣyatattvavitkarṇatālumukhaṃ * * * * * * * * * *kṛtvā kuryāttadūrdhvaṃ vai sarvaśaktiṃ nayetpunaḥtato nayecchivapadaṃ śāśvataṃ mokṣamavyayampūrakaṃ recakaṃ caiva kumbhako'pyadhare paraḥnāsāmukhairbrahmarandhraiḥ yadvāyuṃ pūrayedihadeśakalādyavacchinnaṃ kartavyo vijitātmanākumbhakaṃ tu sa vijñeyaḥ sparśayoge tu saptamamkarṇahṛjjaṭhara nābhigalemeḍhre ca māmuni?kumbhakāttriguṇaḥ vatsa ṣaḍguṇaṃ navaguṇaṃ tu vāapāmātpūrakastadvat kumbhakasthaṃ tirodhanātvānaprasthaścārdanokta rūpamakumbhaḥ prakīrtitaḥapānādūrdhvamākṛṣya hṛdayādiṣu dhāraṇamaṅguṣṭhādi ca mūrdhāntaṃ pūrvoktasthānamāgataḥdehaṃ vāsāntaraṃ vyāptaṃ nirvāṇe tu layaṃ gataḥevaṃ vai sarvavāyūnāṃ vijayopāyasaṃgrahaḥprāsādena tu kūṭena pūrayitvā tu kumbhakamsamā? pracchadanaṃ pūrvaṃ aṃ kiṃcitsparśaṃ tu koṣṭhakenirvāṇe jīrṇasparśaṃ tu keśavena tu varṇitamvānaraccha * *?muktaṃ * * * * * * * * * tam?api vordhvaṃ samutkṛṣya nābhideśe tu dhāraṇamyavargamuttarācāre ravargamīśānacārakekramātsañcintya vai vatsa āpūrya kumbhakena caśivaṃ nayetpunarvatsa ? nirupadravavaibhavam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti kālottare sparśayoge daśavāyucakradhyānapaṭalo dvāviṃśattamaḥmadhyadehe tu cittaṃ tu śive paramakāraṇekapālarandhre reca * * * * * gameva caprāsādaṃ cintayennābhau nādabindusamanvitampūrakaḥ tu iḍāyāṃ vā suṣumnāyāṃ tu pūrayetsaṃcintya manasā yuktaṃ dvārodghāṭanamuttamamhṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūmadhya suṣumnāyāṃ nayecchivamudghāṭita śikhadvāraḥ prāsādena tu śaktiḥparakāyaṃ praveśāyopāyaṃ yatnena cābhyasetguṇatrayasamopeto jīvo'haṃ sa svarūpadhṛkmakāraṃ madhyadehe tu nādabindurvirodhasa(taḥ)ciddehaṃ sarvaśuklaṃ tu varṇenaiva samāyutambrahmagranthiṃ vinirbhidya gacchedvāyupurāttataḥtatra sthitvā samastāni svasvasthāne niveśayetnāgaḥ kūrmastathā proktaḥ kṛkaro devadattakaḥśrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣījihvā ghrāṇaścaiva tu pañcamaḥvākpādau pāṇipāyūvā upasthaścaiva tu pañcamaḥmanobuddhirahaṃkāro mahānantaścatuṣṭayametena dehayogena pūrvavanmodate vaśīniti praveśanavidhiḥ mṛtadehasya ṣaṇmukhapūrvoktadvāraṃ niṣkramya śaktibījapussarammahāmāyena nirgacchet pūrvoktapayabījataḥmaṇḍalāśrayamadhye tu hṛtsaroruhakarṇikamyāvadvigata ceṣṭastu tāvadeva nirodhayetindriyāṇi samastāni prāṇādikacatuṣṭayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dehāntena vinirmukto saṃvibhaktendriyaḥ kramāt* * * * vai vatsa sahasradehaṃ viśedbudhaḥiti kālottare sparśayogavidhāne mṛtakāryajīvakāryapradhānaṃ nāma trayoviṃśatiḥ paṭalaḥmahāyogaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmārthasādhanampadmamadhye praviśyaitatprāsādākhyaṃ śivaṃ padamśaśāṅkamaṇḍalaṃ tatra kiñciddhīnaṃ vicintayetkṛśānumaṇḍalaṃ pūrvaṃ trikoṇaṃ bījamantrataḥagnibimbatrayaṃ hīnaṃ sūryamaṇḍalamuttamamtasyopariṣṭātpuruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśaka saṃyutammāṇikkavatprabhādivyaṃ kiñcidbhṛṅga samaprabhamīśvarākhyaṃ tu tattattvaṃ tenedaṃ preryate jagatvidyāśaktiṃ tu tāmāhuḥ tatparaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥtiṣṭhetsamabhyasaṃstāvaṃ niruddhāśeṣavṛddhikāniti sākṣātkṛtāśeṣaḥ sargasaṃhārakārakaḥraśmyahaḥ śuklapakṣa ṣaṇmāsottaravatsarānete dvādaśādityāstu rudraikādaśa īśvaraḥīśvarasya mahāśaktirmanonmanī parāvarātena nītaṃ śivaṃ gacchedvigatāśeṣa kalmaṣaḥsarvajñaṃ satyasaṃkalpaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇamjitāśeṣāmarudvṛttaiḥ mokṣopāyastu varṇitaḥanena yāti nirvāṇaṃ mṛtyurdehe vyavasthitaḥsvecchayānirgato dehāt muktiṃ yāti yathānaraḥtṛtīyavargamantrasthamatho vahnimaruddhṛtamvinyasya nābhau bījeśaṃ hṛdinyasya tathā paramvarṇaṃ varṇeśvaraṃ paścādarvāk śirasi vinyaset

sanskrit: prāsādena tu saṃyuktaṃ pavitrairaṅgasaṃyutammanoyātyamahībhāvaṃ tato nirvāṇamāpnuyātmṛtyuñjayamidaṃ yogaṃ madhye dehe tu bhāvayetśivasya parato dhyāyet paścimadvāramuttamamsarvajñaṃ sarvakartāraṃ sarvato'kṣi śiromukhamjyotirūpaṃ paraṃ divyamaṣṭadigīśasaṃyutammṛtyuñjayaṃ paraṃ hyetat ṣaṇmāsābhyāsayogataḥathavā * * * * * * * brahmaṇaḥ padamkṣaṇātprāpnoti tatsthānaṃ yattannirvāṇa saṃjñitam* * * * * rāmantrī śivaṃ tatsthaika mānasaḥdhāraṇā śivatattvādau vṛttirodhaṃ careṣu tatsvarūpeṇaiva śūnyaṃ tat samādhiryoga ucyateuktasthi * sanāsīno virecya pavanaṃ śanaiḥpādāṅguṣṭhe ciraṃ ruddhvā manastatraiva saṃsthitaḥūrau ca meḍhre nābhau ca iti karṇe tu dhārayetghaṭikārdhaṃ kramādūrdhvaṃ śive yāmastu saṃsthitaḥabhyasedvatsaraṃ caika mayutāyurbhaviṣyatipādāṅguṣṭhāntamānīya madhyadehe tu saṃsthitaḥpūrvoktasthānayogena dhāraṇā ghaṭikā bhavetityuktā dhāraṇā divyā mṛtyunāśanameva hiataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dhāraṇāṃ mokṣadāyinīmūrdhvādhastiryagapyeva jagadvyāptaṃ carācarambhuvanānāṃ saptakaṃ vāpi prakṣipetpiṇḍamadhyameānīya śanakaiścittadvīpārṇavanagairyutamānīya taṃ kṣipeccetaḥ piṇḍasye paramātmani
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: maṇḍalatrayamadhye tu manasparśaṃ tu tatra tusarvajñatvamavāpnoti sarvagaṃ śivamāpnuyātbrahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraḥ śiva eva cahṛtsaroruhamadhyastho brahmā dhyātaścaturmukhaḥcaturmukhaścaturbāhuḥ sṛṣṭikāraṇamuttamamaiśvaryeṇā dharmeṇa varadābhayapāṇināhaṃsārūḍhastathā rādhaṃ mṛtjñānagranthibhedanamviśeṣayogasaṃsiddhirvividhā yogasaṃbhavambindumatpṛṣṭhanādena hṛdi dhyātastriśūladhṛkkhaḍgaṃ paraśuṃ kālāgniṃ sabhujaṅgasamānagaḥaiśvaryādiguṇopetaṃ hṛdi dhyānaguṇāṣṭakammṛtyuñjayamavāpnoti sadā sadbhāvabhāvitaḥsaṃvatsarakṛtātpāpāt śivalokamavāpnuyātiti kālottare sparśayoga dhāraṇāmārge kālāgnirudrabrahmadhyānaścaturviṃśati paṭalaḥyamaniyamau cāsanaṃ prāṇāyāmastathaiva caetadaṣṭāṅgamuddiṣṭaṃ sparśayogaṃ vidurbudhāḥpratyāhārātsamādhyantamantaraṅgamudāhṛtamdayā jñānaṃ svarūpāṇāṃ antaraṅgaṃ vibhāgataḥśaucaṃ santoṣaśca tapaḥsvādhyāyeśvarapūjaneniyamaṃ daśadhā proktaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu pūjitamāsanaṃ viṃśati proktaṃ tantre'smin vijaye śubhesūciṃ vai ekapādaṃ tu kukkuṭaṃ vīrameva cadaṇḍaṃ vidaṇḍaṃ gokarṇaṃ siṃhāsanamataḥ paramāsanaṃ viṃśatiḥ proktaṃ vāñcitaikaṃ samabhyasetyathā kākādibhāṇḍānāṃ tripāde samyagāsthitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasmātsarvaprayatnena āsanaṃ sarvamabhyasetsarvavedaphalaṃ caiva sarvayajñaphalaṃ ca yatprāṇāyāmena vai vatsa śivārcanaphalaṃ bhavettasyopari sukhāsīnaḥ prāṅmukho vāpyudaṅmukhaḥnivāte nirbhaye gehe kṛmikīṭādivarjitenāsāgradṛksamāsīnā diśaścā navalokayandakṣiṇaṃ pūrayitvā tu vāmenaiva tu recayetpūrvavatpūrayeddhīmān vāmena tu samāhitaḥdakṣiṇe piṅgale caiva recayetsarvameva hināḍīśuddhimavāpnoti granthistridoṣa varjitampūrvaṃ ṣoḍaśamātraṃ tu pūrayedudarādbudhaḥrecayenmūrdhnivāyuṃ ca dvātriṃśaṃ mātrayā guhaṣoḍaśa prāṇāyāmaistu nityaṃ ṣoḍaśameva caprāṇādivijayaṃ paścāt bījaṃ varṇaṃ ca sāragamrakāraṃ cāpānamevaṃ tu sphuraddhṛdayasaprabhampakāraṃ udāna ityuktaṃ vāruṇaṃ śaṅkhasannibhamhṛnnābhināsikarṇaśca pādāṅguṣṭhaṃ tu saṃsthitamapānameḍhrapāyū ca ūrū vaṃ kṣaṇajānunīvyānaśrotrau ca cakṣuśca dhyānayorgaladeśataḥudānaḥ sarvasiddhisthaḥ pādau hastau ca cāṅgulīdvāsaptati sahasrāṇi nāḍimārgeṣu saṃsthitaḥsamānaprāṇa ekaṃ tu jīvastau * * meva hipūrvavatpūrayitvātu kumbhakaṃ pūrvavadbhavetkodaṇḍa dvayamadhye tu brahmarandhre tu śaktimatsadāśivaṃ śivaṃ paścāt tayordevena deśikaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sṛṣṭimārgaṃ nayetpaścāt śivaścaiva tu yāmakebindorvai caturghaṭikā nāde caiva trayaṃ bhavetraśmirardhaghaṭikena tadardhaṃ śaktigocarehṛdaye śivārdhaṃ kurvīta prāṇāyāmena deśikaḥbahiraṅge prasādaṃ tu prāṇāyāmaṃ tu ṣaṇmukhaprasaraṃ tu pravakṣyāmi sopānaṃ dhāraṇasya tupādāṅguṣṭhe ciraṃ rudhya ghaṭikātrayameva hitato gulphaṃ tu savye tu savyaṃ caivāpasavyakejaṅghayoścaiva madhye tu upavinmūle tu rodhayetghaṭikāṣṭakaṃ niroddhavyaṃ parakumbhakasaṃsthitamdvārasaṃkhyāṃ niroddhavyaṃ prāsādena tu deśikaḥsamyaṅnirodhayennityaṃ manomārutasaktayāpunarvai kuṇḍalīmadhye nābhimadhye tu kuṇḍalīprāsādena tu bījena rodhayet * * nantataḥaṣmīlaṃ plahagulphaṃ ca vātarogāṃśca nāśayetaśītirvātajādrogāt pratyāhāreṇa nāśayetprāsādayetsamastaṃ ca ghaṭikaikādaśe sthitaḥkaṇṭha(rṇa)kūpaṃ nirudhyātha sarvamākṛṣya yogavāndvādaśaṃ ghaṭikaṃ vāpi tadardhaṃ vā nirodhayettālurandhre niroddhavyamanilaṃ marutā yutamsarvadvāra pradhānastu prāsādaṃ ca tṛtīyakamsarvavyādhiharaṃ hyetat pittaṃ śleṣmaṃ ca vātajamsadā tatsarvamākṛṣya kodaṇḍadvayamadhyagamcaturdaśaghaṭikāṃ vatsa tadarhdaṃ vā nirodhayetsarvajñatvamavāpnoti vedaśāstrāṇi vindati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: suṣumnāgre rodhayetpaścāt ākṛṣya sparśanaṃ tataḥyāmatrayaṃ nirodhyaṃ tu ākṛṣyākṛṣya mantravitsapatnastambhamevaṃ tu mṛtyunāśanameva canirodhya plāvayedamṛtaiśśanaiśanaiḥ śivacandrakaunirodhayettataḥ sarvān śivacandreṇa saṃyamīsarvaṃ niruddhya matimān amṛtatvena plāvayetrahasyametadākhyātaṃ pratyāhāraṃ sudurlabhammṛte jīve ca sarvaṃ tu tajjanātsaṃpraveśanamāpādatalaparyantaṃ kādināditrayena tunādasthāne caraṃ rodhya ghaṭikā caika viṃśatiḥmahānādaśivenaiva śaśinā ca samanvitampunaḥ sadā ca vai vatsa āyuṣyaṃ sarvavāyubhiḥpunarāpyāyayedvatsa śivaścakreṇa haṃsadaḥevaṃ pūrve pratyāhāraṃ sukhaṃ vāyujayaṃ bhavetiḍayā piṅgalā caiva pūrakaṃ tu krameṇa tatiti kālottare pratyāhārapaṭalaḥ pañcaviṃśatitamaḥsaha saubhāgyamāpnoti dhanamāyurbalaṃ śriyamcatvāriṃ bahiraṅgāni atyajya ca yathāvidhipṛthivyādipañcavaktraṃ dhārayetpūrvameva hipṛthivīṃ dhārayedvatsa trikālaṃ vā dvikālakamśabdasparśaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥmṛtyuñjayamavāpnoti sarvaiśvaryasamṛddhidamgokṣīraṃ dhavalaṃ saumyaṃ śaṅkhakundasamaprabhamadhomukhamamṛtaṃ dhyāyet dhyāyeccaivaṃ tato guhapūrvāttu dviguṇaṃ vatsa dhyānaṃ samyagvyavasthitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva kṛttimaṃ vimatāśamamśabdasparśaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca rasaṃ caiva caturguṇamāgneyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ dhyāyet trikoṇaṃ svastikairyutamṣaṣṭame daśasaṃyuktaṃ binduyuktaṃ ṣaḍānanaśabdasparśaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca agnibimbaṃ vicintayetrecakaṃ pūrvavatkuryāt anilaṃ manasā jayettatkṣaṇānnaśyate vatsa siṃhasyeva yathā gajaḥgabhasti daivataṃ vatsa dviguṇena samanvitambinduśekharamārūḍhaṃ kaṇṭhakūpe tu dhyāyayetiḍāyāṃ piṅgalāyāṃ tu suṣumnāyāṃ ca pūrayetevaṃ vai dhyāyayedvatsa sarvavāyujayaṃ bhavethṛtsaroruhajaṃ ye tu ākāśaṃ mecakaprabhamparameśvaraṃ cādhidaivaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇamdhyāyedvyomaṃ śiromadhye śivādhāraṃ sunirmalampūrvavatpūrakaṃ kuryāt kumbhakaṃ recakaṃ tathāmahācakraṃ punardhyāyet sarvadevairanuṣṭhitammahāpadmamidaṃ vatsa śivapadmaṃ suśobhanamkesarāṣṭottaraśataṃ pṛthagdevaṃ prakalpayetvasavaścāṣṭa te caiva aṣṭau caiva gaṇeśvarānrudramātṛgaṇānāṃ ca yakṣavidyādharāstathāmarudgaṇāḥ pitṛgaṇāḥ kinnarāpsarasastathānāgāśca vividhāścaiva nakṣatragraharāśayaḥdevakanyā ṛṣikanyā bhūtā vai kṣetrapālakāḥmahābāhyena vinyasya triguṇīkṛtya veṣṭayetvyañjanāni ca sarvaṃ tu gamyakaṃ * * * * * *
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: * * * * * * sūkṣma bāhyābhyantara saṃsthitamsakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ suptaṃ suṣuptaṃ tu sadāśivambinduṃ tu vai śivaṃ vidyāt turīyaṃ parikīrtitamvācyavācakarahitaṃ heyopādenaśūnyakamkāraṇaṃ sarvadevānāṃ akṣarakṣaravarjitamsusaṃvedyahitaṃ brahma kumārī strīsukhaṃ sadāghaṭo niyatinākāśaṃ tadvajjīvo nabhopamamprāṇaṃ vinā sa jīveti tvagvinā sparśaṃ tu vindatipāṇirnāsti sagṛhṇāti pādo nāsti sa gacchatimeḍhraṃ vināpi cānandaṃ sarvameva hi nityaśaḥahaṃkāraṃ vinā vatsa ahaṃkṛtaḥ svayameva caprakṛtiṃ vinā mahādevo jagatsarvaṃ prajāyatecara * * * de sarvaṃ joṣate bhuñjate'pi cagacchati svaṃ nṛtyati ca gāyate plavate'pi saḥota protena vai vatsa paripūrṇena vai sadādehe śūnyapadaṃ dhyātvā mokṣayiṣyasi ṣaṇmukhakhaśūnyaṃ śaktiśūnyaṃ ca nāstiśūnyaṃ ca vai guhabrahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca sarvaśūnyaṃ ca bhāvayettvamahaṃ śūnyamevaṃ hi sarvāṃ nāstīti bhāvataḥnirbījamidaṃ samādhirdṛśyate tu ṣaḍānanapuṣpeṣu gandhavannityaṃ tile tailamiva sthitamguruvaktraprasādena labhyate sarvatomukhadhyānaṃ dhāraṇarahitaṃ japahomavivarjitamyasya kālaśca sthānaṃ ca āsanāni ca ṣaṇmukha* * * * ñca tīrthaṃ ca na snānaṃ śaucameva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na varṇaṃ navabījaṃ ca sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ na caiḍā ca piṅgalā caiva suṣumnāprāṇireva caaṣṭāviṃśatkoṭirūpakūpe saṃcarate sadāyogasūrya * * * * * * * * * * * yajyotirūpaṃ paraṃ tattvametatprota vyavasthitamaśarīraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayetakārādikṣakārāntaṃ mantraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryutamavaśyaṃ pūrvadale vyasya śeṣānvai kramaśo nyasethutabhuṅmaṇḍalaṃ vatsa trikoṇaṃ yaddvitīyakamtasya madhye sūryabimbaṃ japākusumasannibhamkiñciddhīnamagnibimbāt sūryamaṇḍalamuttamamsūryabimbāddhīnadharaṃ candrabimbamanuttamammaṇḍalatrayamadhye tu puruṣaṃ pañca viṃśakamaṅguṣṭhamātraṃ sadṛśaṃ rājāvarta maṇiprabhamdrutacāmīkaraprakhyaṃ hṛdbījaṃ tu trirabhyasetvidyudarkanibhābhāsaṃ sūkṣmarūpaṃ tu cintayetsaptaviṃśakadevaṃ hi dhyāyetsatatamīśvaramsarvajñaṃ sarvagaṃ śāntaṃ yogigamyaṃ parāparamdhyānamātreṇa vai vatsa gacchenmokṣamanāmayamcaturbhujaṃ dvinetraṃ ca śaṅkhacakragadādharamvāgbhavaṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ tu dhyāyennityaṃ sayantritamtasya dakṣiṇapārśve tu caturmukhaṃ caturbhujamkamaṇḍaluṃ cākṣasūtraṃ dadhānaṃ sṛṣṭikāraṇamviṣṇuṃ sattvaguṇopetaṃ nārāyaṇamanāmayambrahmāṇaṃ cintayedvatsa sarvavṛttinirodhanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: indramagniṃ yamaṃ varuṇaṃ somaṃ gandharvaṃ tathāpūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ caiva sarvavṛttinirodhanamcakravartī cāṣṭamūrti rudraikādaśa eva cadhyāyedravyagramanasā tattatpadamavāpnuyāttadardhamātraṃ nirhāsaṃ rūpaśūnyaṃ tu bhāvayetathavā samarasībhāvaṃ samādhistena cocyatesadāśivamahaṃ bhūtvā na kiñcidapi cintayettiryaggataṃ paraṃ tattvamahameva tu tadbhavetmadhye caiva tu vai vatsa sākṣācchivamanāmayamjāgratsvapnavihīnaṃ tu suṣuptaṃ ca vivarjayetśivākāśaṃ paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvatomukhamguhāśayamanādiṃ ca sarvadvandvavivarjitamsūkṣmaṃ śivaṃ kāraṇamapratarkyamanāmayamaśarīrātmakaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayetsaroruhamadhye tu sūryakoṭisamaprabhamtat vai madhye tu cātmānaṃ kuru nityaṃ ṣaḍānanaeṣa mṛtyuñjayo yogaḥ samarasībhāvamāśritaḥtālurandhre paraṃ jñānaṃ vidyutpāvaka sa prabhamguṇasaṃkhyā smarennityaṃ mṛtyunāśanamuttamambhuvanāni sapta tatraiva prakṣipya śivamadhyagecakṣuṣe dṛśyate yogassaptalokān samucchrayaḥbrahmarandhre tu medhāvī bhū saṃkhyāṃ tu vimiśrayettanmadhye śivarūpaṃ tu sphuratsaudāminīprabhamtatra kṛtvā tu cātmānaṃ ṣaṭkauśike tu vigraheitthaṃ bhūsaṃkhyamāse tu vatsaratrayabhāvanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasyordhve caturaṅgulye raśmisaṃjñā tu golakeamṛtaṃ cintayetprājñaḥ anantaścākṣayoḥ śivamaśarīraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayetjyotsnāsaṃkhyākalakṣetra * kadambasya golakeśivamadhye kuru cātmānaṃ śivamātmānvitam kuruṣaṇmāsābhyāsayogena mṛtyunāśanamuttamamtanmadhye tu paraṃ brahma śivaṃ paramanāyakamaśarīraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayetnādaṃ maheśvaraṃ tattvaṃ golakaṃ paramaṃ padamtanmadhye kuru cātmānaṃ ātmamadhye tu taṃ kurukoṭilakṣaṃ sa jīveta śivena paribhāṣitamsaptamaṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ śivaṃ paramanāyakamsavyāśrayamacintyaṃ ca sarvajñaṃ sarvatomukhamprabhuśakti jñānaśaktiṃ ca vidyāśaktinirāmayamteṣāṃ madhye śivaṃ sūkṣmaṃ sarvakāraṇakāraṇamaśarīraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiñcidapi cintayetmahāpralayasahasraṃ tu sa jīvati na saṃśayaḥnābheradhastātprādeśaṃ madhye deśaṃ prakīrtitamūrudvayāttu cordhve tu tuṭībhaṭṭībhavādayaḥcatuśśaktiṃ nyasettatra madhye śivaṃ kṣipetsamarasībhāvayogena abhyasetsatataṃ sukhīiti kālottare dvādaśasahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ saptaviṃśatiḥ paṭalaḥmantrādhvā ca padādhvā ca tattvādhvā bhuvanātmakammantrādhvānaṃ pṛthakcaiva sāṃprataṃ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukhaniyutāni catuṣṣaṣṭī vāmadevādbahirgatāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trikoṭilakṣaṃ vai vatsa aghorācca vinirgataḥtatpuruṣādviniṣkrāntaṃ mantrabhedaṃ tataḥ śṛṇuīśānasya mukhājjātamana * * * jātakamananteśasya mantrastu ayutaṃ parikīrtitamekanetre caturayutaṃ ekarudraṃ tu pañcamamśikhaṇḍyayaśītyayutaṃ ca cakravartīstu mantrakānaṣṭamūrtestu mantrāṇi pṛthaklakṣaṃ ṣaḍaṣṭakamādityā dvādaśalakṣaṃ tu vasūnāmaṣṭalakṣakamdaśa vai lokapālānāṃ ayutatrayameva casiddhacāraṇayakṣādyaistadardhaṃ parikīrtitamṛṣayaḥ pitṛbhūtāni tadardhaṃ parikīrtitamasurā rākṣasāścaiva yātudhānāḥ piśācakāḥevaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ mantrajālaṃ ṣaḍānanaprāsādasaṃbhavāḥ sarve vāṅmayaṃ ca carācaramprabodha hṛdimantraśca sahasrākṣaradevatāḥnādamukhyaṃ prasādaṃ ca kṣurikaṃ pāśupatāstrakamrudraikādaśamantraśca ādityavastumantrakāḥsaptamātṛgaṇā mantrāḥ tattanmantreṣu coddhṛtāḥīśānamukhaniṣkrāntaṃ mantrajālaṃ sudurlabhamekāśīti padaṃ hyetat mantrarājaṃ tvanuttamamsahasrākṣaradevaṃ tu vāmadevādvinirgatamsarvavaśyakaraṃ mantraṃ navagrantheṣu pūjitamlakṣatrayaṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ trisahasrapadaṃ bhavetsaptabhairavatantre ca catuṣṣaṣṭigulatantrakeīśānasya tu mantrāṇi karmayogyaṃ vadāmyaham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sahasrākṣaradevastu jātaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ mahatrudragāyatrīmantro'yaṃ mahāpātakanāśanamtatpuruṣāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi | tannorudraḥ pracodayāt | tatpuruṣameva hitrisandhyāyāṃ japedvatsa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavetsarvataśśarva sarvebhyo namaste astu viśvarūpebhyaḥkarṇikā kaṭakaṃ caiva keyūrodarabandhanaiḥaghoreṇa pradātavyaṃ sarvakarmāṇi buddhimānābhicārādikarmāṇi japādeva pramucyateaghoramaṣṭottaraṃ japtvā sadya eva pramucyateśivasthāpanamantraṃ tu saptamantrapradhānakamrudraikādaśakān sarve vāmadevena sthāpayetśaktikarmāṇi sarvaṃ tu vaśyādyākarṣaṇādikamvāmadevāya namo jyeṣṭhāya namo rudrāya namaḥ | kālāya namaḥ | kalavikaraṇāya namo balavikaraṇāya namo balapramathanāya namaḥ | sarvabhūtadamanāya namo manonmanāya namaḥsarvamantrādhikaṃ vatsa gṛhapraveśe japedguhaāvāhanādikaṃ karma sarvamaṅgalameva casarvābharaṇabhūṣeṇa kṛṣiḥ kāle tu vai japetpitṛkāryeṣu sarveṣu sadyojātaṃ japennaraḥaghoraṃ aṣṭakalā vatsa puruṣaṃ tu catuḥkalāḥsarvamantrāṇi vai vatsa puruṣaṃ tu catuṣkalāḥpratiṣṭhākāle sarvamantrān yojayetsusamāhitaḥiti kālottare mantrādhvāpaṭalo'ṣṭāviṃśatitamaḥlakṣakoṭisahasraṃ tu śivapadaṃ saṃprakīrtitamtatpadeṣu viniṣkānte padaiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśaducyateśodhayenmūrdhni dehe ca śivaṃ gacchedanāmayamtatpadeṣu viniṣkrāntaṃ ṣaṇṇavatīti prakīrtitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: catuṣpadeṣu saṃśodhya gacchecchivamanāmayamtatpadeṣu viniṣkrāntaṃ ekāśītiprakīrtitamtatpadaṃ kramaśaḥ śodhya gacchecchivamanāmayamtatpadeṣu viniṣkrāntaṃ mantraṃ daśapadaṃ punaḥtrayodaśapadaṃ śodhya gacchecchivamanāmayamtatpadeṣu viniṣkrāntaṃ dvātriṃśatpadamucyatesadyojātapadaṃ cāṣṭau śodhayitvā padaṃ vrajettatpadeṣu viniṣkrāntaṃ hṛdayādiṣaḍaṅgataḥnetramastraṃ ca vijñeyaṃ śodhayitvā śivaṃ vrajettatpadeṣu viniṣkrāntaṃ bījamukhyatrayaṃ viduḥbījatrayaṃ samāśodhya gacchecchivamanāmayamtatpadeṣu viniṣkrāntamiha pāśupatāstrakamvasavaścāṣṭasaṃbhūtāḥ padalakṣaṃ prakīrtitamkṣurikābījaṃ saṃśodhya gacchecchivamanāmayamtatpadeṣu viniṣkrāntaṃ hṛllekhāpadamantrakamsaptamātṛgaṇājjātaṃ catuṣṣaṣṭisahasrakamhṛllekhāṃ śodhayitvā tu gacchecchivamanāmayamtatpadeṣu samudbhūtamaghorāstraṃ sudurlabhamsaṃhārarūparudrastu kālāgniriti saṃjñitamrudrastamoguṇaḥ proktaḥ triguṇaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥsarve vedāśca śāstrāṇi vidyāsthānaṃ caturdaśasiddhāntatantramāptaṃ ca praṇavena tu nirguṇaḥprāsādaṃ praṇavaṃ caiva śodhayedvidhipūrvakamdvau bījau śodhamānena gacchecchivāmanāmayamjāgratsvapnaṃ tu brahmā syāt suṣuptirviṣṇurucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥbrahmaṇo hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ kaṇṭhe viṣṇuḥ prakīrtitaḥnāsāgre tu śivaṃ vidyāt tasmāttena parātparamtrimātraśca dvimātraśca ekamātrastathaiva caetā eva trayo lokāḥ trayodevāstrayo'gnayaḥsavanatrayaṃ ca śaktiśca ātmatritayameva cabhūlokaśca bhuvarlokaḥ svargo lokastridhā bhavetāhavanīyaṃ gārhapatyaṃ dakṣiṇāgnitrayaṃ bhavetdharmārthau cārthakāmau ca trivargāḥ parikīrtitāḥagnimaṇḍalaṃ prathamaṃ dvitīyaṃ sūryamaṇḍalamprātassavanamadhyāhnaṃ tṛtīyaṃ savanatrayamātmā caivāntarātmā ca paramātmatrayaṃ bhavetetattrayaṃ samastaśca prāsādaśca vinirgatamgandharvāḥ siddhavidyādharā yakṣaścāpsara(sa)stathāasurā rākṣasāścaiva yātudhānāḥ piśācakāḥeteṣāṃ samyak śodhayet śivāṅgacodanāmayāmkramādvai ekahīnāstu piśācāntāḥ prakīrtitāḥdīkṣākāle tu śiṣyasya dehe saṃrodhayedguhaiti kālottare pañcādhvāpaṭalaḥ ekonaviṃśatitamaḥśivaṃ padamavāpnoti samyak jñātvā vicakṣaṇaḥśrotraṃ tvakcakṣurjihvā ca ghrāṇaṃ caiva tu pañcamaḥśabdasparśaśca rūpaṃ ca rasogandhaśca pañcamaḥrāgovidyā kamalā māyā niyatirvṛddhigraheśvaraḥmaheśassadāśivaścaiva ṣaṭtriṃśattattvameva catriguṇogniravijñeyo vāyurdviguṇa ucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥtejo vai pācanaṃ jñeyaṃ vyūhanaṃ vāyurucyateśrotraṃ śṛṇoti vai vatsa tvakcaiva sparśanaṃ bhavetghrāṇaṃ gandhaṃ vijānīyādviṣayāḥ parikīrtitāḥpādābhyāṃ caiva gacchanti pāyurutsargameva hiśabdo dhvanirvijānīyāt ākāśāttu prajāyateśītatanmātrakaścāpassarvalokasya jīvanamyatkaṭhinaṃ tatpṛthivī yaddravaṃ salilaṃ hi tatyatsuṣiraṃ tadākāśaṃ devādhāraḥ prakīrtitaḥprakṛtermahān samutpannaḥ puruṣātprakṛtirbhavetṣaḍviṃśaka viṣṇu * * * * * * * * * *rāgo māyā ca vidyā ca kañcukatrayamucyatekālā niyatirvigraheśo jñānaśakteḥ samudbhavāḥśivaśakteḥ samutpannāḥ sarvalokasya mohakāḥśivasya pralayetvasti na jātaṃ vai ṣaḍānanaahaṃ saṃhāramekaṃ tu guṇatrayasamanvitaḥtamaḥsaṃhāra evaṃ tu mayā sarvaṃ prakīrtitammūrdhyā(rdhā)dipādaparyantaṃ śiṣyadehe tu yojayetpratiṣṭhākāle liṅgasya yojayedvidhipūrvakamabhāgye vinyaseddhīmān saubhāgyamatulaṃ bhavetṣaḍadhyānaṃ nyasetkumbhe snānaṃ kuryātṣaḍānanaiti kālottare dvādaśasahasrasaṃhitāyāṃ tattvādhvapaṭalaḥ triṃśatitamaḥrbhāvābhavau vā tu hinā parasyaḥlapāmi tatprāvaraṇopamārgamye cānyāni yatissakālagaṇayanmāyāprabuddhaḥ śivaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti kālottare ekatriṃśatpaṭalaḥsarvasiddhimavāpnoti sadyaḥ pratyayamuttamambindornādaḥ samutpannaḥ nādācchaktirajāyatakalābhyo vyañjanaṃ jātaṃ vāgbhavānalavāgbhavetsakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ śūnyaṃ kalāḍhyaṃ kamalaṃ kṛtamśivāṣṭabhedaṃ vai vatsa hakāre saṃprajāyatekālī caiva tu vijñeyā kalavikaraṇī tathāsarvabhūtadamanī manonmanī grīve vyavasthitāḥbrāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathāuṣādikoṭyaṃ vanyattantu gale sthitāḥākāre viṣṇudaivatyaṃ koṭiśaktisamanvitamikāraṃ sarvarakṣā ca bindumastakabhūṣitambindumastakamākrāntaṃ sarvavaśyakaraṃ parambindumastakamārūḍhaṃ rājavaśyakaraṃ parampuruṣaṃ vaiśyamūkāraṃ bindumastakabhūṣitambindumastakamārūḍhaṃ puruṣavaśyamidaṃ parampārāvatanibhaṃ caiva ṣaḍvarṇaṃ saṃprakīrtitamsarvarakṣā sarvavaśyaṃ viṣanāśanameva cabindumastakamākrāntaṃ aśītirvātanāśanamjvarakuṣṭhaviṣaśleṣmaṃ sarvāpasmāranāśanambindumastakamākrāntaṃ aśītirvātanāśanambindumastakamārūḍhaṃ drutacāmīkaraprabhamsarvarakṣākaraṃ caiva binduyuktaṃ tu vai guhaokāraṃ śikhaṇḍirūpaṃ tu binduyuktaṃ sadaṅkakamśuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ divyarūpamanāmayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śvetapaṅkajamadhye tu adhomukhaṃ vicintayedbudhaḥokāraṃ raktavarṇaṃ tu maheśaṃ paramaṃ mahatakāraṃ paramaṃ tattvaṃ bhavarūpaṃ mahānapiakāramanantarūpaṃ tu śuddhasphaṭika sannibhamnirviṣaṃ vā sumanasā sadaṣṭaṃ vā sujinā apiṣoḍaśasvaramevaṃ tu sākṣāccandrakalā mahatplāvinī śītavīryā ca uṣṇaghnā mṛtyunāśinītuṣārādarvāk jyotsnāyā mṛtasaṃjīvanī parāviśvarūpā ṣoḍaśakalā visargāntā prakīrtitāviṣasaṃhāraṇaṃ sarvaṃ sarvasṛṣṭipravartanamsthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva kṛtrimaṃ viṣanāśanamgajakarṇaṃ gajānanaṃ gajahastaṃ trilocanamśvetapadmopariṣṭāttu sarvabhakṣapriyaṃ sadācaturbhujaṃ trinetraṃ tu śūlaṃ paraśudhāriṇamghakāraṃ bhūmidaivatyaṃ dvibhujaṃ bhṛṅgasannibhamcakāraṃ muṇḍirūpaṃ tu kālameghasamaprabhamśiromālādharaṃ raudraṃ sarvāsuravimardanambhujaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryuktaṃ triṇetraṃ bhūmirupiṇamkapālaṃ śūladhanuṣī cakraṃ vajraṃ paraśvayamaṅkuśaṃ bhiṇḍipālaṃ ca parighaṃ ca śubhaṃkaramjakāraṃ jṛmbhalaṃ vidyādyanadevo na saṃśayaḥsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvaratnopaśobhitamculakodakena nityaṃ tu jalaṃ spṛṣṭvā tu tarpayetsākṣādamṛtīśarūpaṃ tu jhakāraṃ paramākṣarambinduśekharamārūḍhaṃ nādaśakti samanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japākusumasaprakhyaṃ kvacidindra dhanuṣprabhamkvacidvai ekapādaṃ tu kvacidvai ekanetrakamlakṣeṇa japamātreṇa japetpuruṣa vartatelokavaśyaṃ rājavaśyaṃ puruṣavaśyaṃ tathaiva caviṣasaṃhāraṇaṃ caiva daṣṭaṃ vāsukināpi vāḹkāraṃ koddalīrūpaṃ bhṛṅgavarṇaṃ trilocanamasabhyaṃ pratikaraṃ vatsa nagnaṃ nṛtyena tuṣyatiṭakāraṃ viśvarūpaṃ tu dvibhujaṃ tu trinetrakamcandrasākṣāt ṭhakāraṃ tu śuddhakundendu sa prabhamsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ ekāvartaṃ tathaiva cadhyānamātrānmahāsena viṣasthāvarajaṅgamamviṣastobhaṃ tu dīrgheṇa hrasvena viṣanāśanamḍakāraṃ yamarūpaṃ tu dvinetraṃ dvibhujaṃ paramjapellakṣaśatenaiva mṛtyuñjayamavāpnuyātsaprahastaṃ bhīmarūpaṃ mahiṣārūḍhamuttamamekāraṃ mṛtyurūpaṃ tu atikṛṣṇaṃ sulocanamraktamālyāmbaradharaṃ ghoradaṃṣṭraṃ bhayāvahamjapellakṣatrayeṇaiva binduyuktena ṣaṇmukhaḥiti kālottare varṇādhvavidhāne dvātriṃśatiḥ paṭalaḥtriṇetraṃ ca trivargaṃ ca trividhaṃ cāyudhatrayamsmṛtimātreṇa vai vatsa mahānidhiṃ prapaśyaticaturbhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca śūlaṃ paraśudhāriṇamdakāraṃ durgārūpaṃ tu śyāmavarṇaṃ trilocanamjapena siddhimāpnoti saṃgrāme vijayaṃ bhavet* * * * tripādaṃ tu sarvaratnavibhūṣitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japeddvādaśavarṣeṇa nidhidvayaṃ ca paśyatiprātaśca śvetavarṇaṃ tu madhyāhne śyāmamucyatepakāraṃ parjanyarūpaṃ tu adhiśvetaṃ caturbhujamghṛtena payasā homa ma* * * subhikṣakamādi huṃkāra saṃyuktaṃ mahāpāśupataṃ paramayutaṃ japenmahāsena saṃgrāme vijayī bhavetaṣṭādaśabhujaṃ dīptaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ dvilocanamjapellakṣatrayeṇaiva mṛtyunāśanamuttamamkapālapāṇī rudrastu vāsudevaṃ tu vāmakedvādaśabhujaṃ spatanetraṃ sitaṃ raktaṃ tu śyāmakamdharmārthau ca kāmaśca smṛtimātreṇa sādhayetpralayānalavarṇaṃ tu sahasraśīrṣameva casahasrodarabāhuśca sahasrāyudha eva caamṛteśaṃ savyarekhāṃ tu bindurūpaṃ paraṃ śivamaghorāstraṃ visargeṇa sarvaśatrūṃśca nāśayetdaśabhujaṃ triṇetraṃ ca kālameghasamaprabhamvāmarekhā pralayānilaṃ trailokyaṃ mohanaṃ paramniyuta pakṣeṇa vai vatsa manojavatvamāpnuyātpralayāgniṃ dakṣiṇe rekhā vāme'gniṃ pralayaṃ bhavetbrahmādistambaparyantaṃ binduyuktena saṃharetsākṣātpṛthivīrūpaṃ tu dvinetraṃ bāhucaturthakamdakṣiṇe rudrarekhā tu vāme caiva janārdanaḥbinduṃ sadāśivaṃ vidyāt sarvakāmaphalapradamsākṣādamṛtarūpaṃ tu vāyurūpaṃ ṣaḍānanavāme amṛtarūpaṃ tu varuṇaṃ dakṣiṇarūpakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ayutena viṣanāśaṃ tu sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca yatsākṣādvai lakṣmīrūpaṃ tu śaṅkaraṃ kiñjalka sa prabhamjayā ca vijayā caiva ajitācāparājitāmāyāgnibindusaṃyuktaṃ japellakṣatrayaṃ sudhīḥṣakāraṃ dvādaśādityaṃ raktavarṇāstrilocanāḥvai kartano vivasvāṃśca mārtāṇḍo bhāskaro raviḥādityaśca tathā sūryaścāṃśupālī divākaraḥsākṣātsarasvatī rūpaṃ sakāraṃ śuklavarṇakamgāyatrī caiva sāvitrī vāgīśī medhayā sahāsākṣādṛmṛtarūpaṃ tu jīvarūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥayutaṃ jīvenna saṃdeho binduyuktaṃ ṣaḍānananiyutaṃ japena vai vatsa caturvedāṃśca vindatibalavikaraṇī balapramathanī sarvabhūtadamanī manonmanīhakāre sarvamutpannaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaramdravyaṃ guṇaṃ ca karma ca sāmānyaṃ ca viśeṣakamna vinā rudrabhedaṃ tu nāsāgre vasate jagatna vinā jāyate jantuḥ na vinā labhate jagatna vinā paśyate janturna vinā śṛṇu te jagatna vinā jighrate janturna vinotsargaṃkaro mahānjñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jagatsarvaṃ ro(o)taṃ protaṃ ca sarvaśaḥśuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ daśabāhuṃ triṇetrakambinduyuktena vai vatsa japellakṣaṃ suyantritaḥlakāraṃ pṛthivī jñeyā bhūmidevī na saṃśayaḥjapedvai bhūmilābhaṃ tu ayutena ṣaḍānanakṣarate ca jagatsarvaṃ kṣakāraṃ parikīrtitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bindunāda samāyuktaṃ trayodaśa samanvitamnārasiṃhamidaṃ proktaṃ śatrunāśanamuttamamlakṣatrayeṇa vai vatsa trailokyavijayaṃ bhavetśiṣyadehe nyasedvarṇān bindunādasamanvitānavyagreṇa nyaseddehe mokṣaṃ gacchenna saṃśayaḥiti kālottare varṇādhvapaṭalastrayastriṃśatitamaḥūrdhvavaktraṃ ca pūrvaṃ tu dakṣiṇaṃ paścimottaramīśānasya kalāpaṃ ca pañcamūrdhasu vinyasetūrdhvavaktraṃ ca pañcaitat pañcavaktreṣu vinyasetśāntyatītakalāḥ pañca oṃkārādinamontakampṛṣṭhe hyurasi mantrajñaḥ tvaghorasya kalāṃ nyasetgudasthāne ca liṅge ca ūrdhvaoścajānunostathāvāmadevakalāṃ vatsa trayodaśasthānake nyasetdhṛtiḥ kāryā ca dhātrī ca brāhmaṇī mohinī tathāaṣṭasthānena vai vatsa sadyojātakalāṃ nyasetaṣṭasthāneṣu sadyena kramedvai vinyasedguhaśiṣyadehe tu medhāvī dīkṣākāle tu vinyasetavaśyaṃ mokṣamāpnoti aihike siddhimeva caiti śrīkālottare kalādhvapaṭalaścaturtriṃśatitamaḥmukhamekaṃ samārabhya yāvadvai ṣoḍaśaṃ mukhacāturvarṇaṃ tu rudrākṣaṃ tattajjātestu siddhidamvaiśyastu dhārayetpītaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ śūdrastu dhārayetkṛmidaṣṭācchinnā bhinnāśca kaṇṭhakodbhinnameva caviparītadvāramevaṃ tu mukhamevaṃ ca varjayetekaṃ vāpi dvayaṃ vāpi trayaṃ vāpi caturthakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvādaśaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ vāpi viṃśadvā pañcaviṃśakamcatvāriṃśacca vai vatsa pañcāśat ṣaṣṭimeva cadviśataṃ pañcaśataṃ vāpi sahasraṃ vāpi dhārayetkalpakoṭisahasrāṇi rudraloke mahīyateetatsahasraphalaṃ jñeyaṃ sahasrarudrākṣadhāraṇātrudro rudrākṣadānena bhavatīti kimadbhutamyathāvidhirdīkṣayitvā paścānmantreṇa dhārayetaghoreṇa galedhāryamaghoreṇa hṛdirdharetvyomavyāpīti mantreṇa śatārdhamālāṃ ca dhārayetprāsādenaiva mantreṇa rudrākṣaṃ sapta dhārayetprāsāde naiva mantreṇa rudrākṣaṃ sarvameva hipatradīpaiḥ śataṃ jñeyaṃ padmākṣaistu sahasrakamraktacandanapālāśaiḥ śvetacandanadārujaiḥtāmrajākṣaiścatvāriṃśat pañcāśadrajatākṣakaiḥaṅgulyā tu japedvatsa dāridryaṃ vyādhimāpnuyātmeruṃ pradakṣiṇī kṛtya japaṃ kuryātsamāsataḥaṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi kuryādvai cākṣasūtrakamaṅguṣṭhā madhyamā caiva sarvavaśyeṣṭa vai japetkaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhayogena vidveṣoccāṭanamāraṇaiḥdharmārthakāmamokṣaṃ ca arthaputrānavāpnuyātdāsīrdāsāṃścānaḍuhaṃ bhūmiṃ vastraṃ kalatrakamakṣasūtraṃ vinā vatsa japaṃ sarvaṃ ca varjayeteka mukhaṃ tu rudrākṣaṃ paraṃ brahmaśivaṃ bhavettrimukhaṃ cāgnidaivatyaṃ māheśaṃ ca ṣaḍānanasākṣātsadāśivaṃ viddhi pitāmahaṃ ṣaḍānana
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nārāyaṇaṃ ca vai vatsa kecidāhurmanīṣiṇaḥsaptamukhaṃ hi rudrākṣaṃ sahasrāṃśurdivākaraḥaṣṭau cakravarti mahāprītimavāpnuyātaṣṭamukhaṃ tu rudrākṣaṃ umeśo nātra saṃśayaḥdurgāmaṣṭā ca gāyatrī sāvitrī ca śacī tathādaśamukhaṃ tu rudrākṣaṃ yamarūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥekādaśamukhaṃ vatsa rudrākṣamindradaivatamrudrākṣaṃ dvādaśamukhaṃ mahāviṣṇusvarūpakamviṣṇusāyujyamāpnoti imaṃ kāmaṃ labhennaraḥmatsyaḥ kūrmādimūrtistu keśavādistu dvādaśatrayodaśamukhaṃ cākṣaṃ kāmarūpaṃ ṣaḍānanacaturdaśamukhaṃ cākṣaṃ rudranetraṃ sudurlabhamsarvavyādhiharaṃ vatsa sadārogyamavāpnuyātsākṣādvai candrarūpaṃ tu varuṇarūpaṃ na saṃśayaḥgandharvāpsaraso nāgāṃścāraṇān siddhakinnarānkālavañcanamevaṃ tu apamṛtyuvināśanamrudrākṣadhāraṇānnityaṃ sarvopadravanāśanamtrayastriṃśatsurāścaiva prītiṃ yāttyabhidhāraṇātvajraṃ maratakaṃ caiva vaiḍūryaṃ ca pravālakamrudrākṣasṛjena saha dhārayedviṣanāśanamjvaragrahapiśācāśca mehaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ bhagajvaramupavītena saṃchādya rudrākṣaṃ tu dvijātibhiḥkeyūrakaṭake caiva udarabandhe tu bandhayetapamṛtyuvināśaṃ ca āyuśca kīrtivardhanamviprāṇāṃ sarvakāle tu dhārayenmantrasaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rudrākṣaṃ dhārayennityaṃ sadā vijayamāpnuyātvaiśyasya tu praśastaṃ hi rudrākṣaṃ dhārayettataḥśuśrūṣaṇe trayāṇāṃ ca kṛṣikāle tu dhārayettakṣakaiḥ śilpibhiḥ sparśāt bījamukhyena homayetvyomavyāpibhirmantraistu prāsādena tu kṣālayetrudrākṣaṃ dhārayetpaścāt trimukhaṃ vā caturmukhampūrvoktalakṣaṇairyuktaṃ ekaṃ vāpi ca dhārayetyadvatsa cālayenmālāṃ tatsarvaṃ japameva hiyāvattu cālayenmālāṃ tajjapaṃ syāt ṣaḍānanapañcabrahmajapāccākṣaiḥ lakṣaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavetrudrākṣamālayā japyaṃ sadya eva ca siddhyatiśāvasūtakayorvatsa rudrākṣaṃ parivarjayetmaithune varjayennityaṃ snātvā caiva tu dhārayetśleṣmātakaṃ vakaṃ caiva varjayettu prayatnataḥgrahaṇe viṣuve caiva ayane saṃkrāntikepi vāarcane homakāle ca svajanmadivase tathāiti kālottare ayutatrayasaṃhitāyāṃ rudrākṣadhāraṇavidhiḥ paṭalaḥ pañcatriṃśatitamaḥsarvapāpaharaṃ caiva sarvasiddhikaraṃ paramgrahabhūtavināśaṃ ca jvarakuṣṭhādināśanamdvādaśa puṣpaṃ dvādaśadhūpaṃ dvādaśadīpaṃ dvādaśa arghyamdvādaśa homaṃ dvādaśavipre dīkṣāyutairlakṣaṇayuktāndvādaśa yaṣṭirdvādaśa śastirdvādaśayugmaṃ dvādaśasūkṣmamdvādaśakāṣṭhaṃ pāduga(ka)yugmaṃ pāyasamannaṃ saghṛtamannametatsūtrasya vyākhyānaṃ tattvataḥ śṛṇu ṣaṇmukhamahādevaḥ sthāṇuḥ śivaḥ paśupatiścogra eva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ete dvādaśanāmānaḥ māsādvādaśa nāmataḥmārgaśīrṣaṃ ca puṣyaṃ ca māghaphālgunacaitrakāḥāśviyujaṃ kārtikaścaiva māsā dvādaśa mu(u)cyatebinduśekharamārūḍhaṃ prāsādena tu saṃyutammantrā dvādaśamevoktaṃ śivenodāhṛtaṃ purācandanaṃ kuṅkumaṃ caiva jātītakkolakārakampūtikeśaṃ ca kuṣṭhaṃ ca gandhā dvādaśakīrtitāḥkaravīraṃ nandikāvartaṃ śokaṃ vyāhatameva cakundakuṣṭhaṃ sajjarasaṃ lopyacandanavānaramkṛṇirdvādaśamevāhuḥ dūmayogyaṃ ṣaḍānanatriphalātrayajātiṃ ca khaḍgaṃ lohaṃ ca candanamkapilāyāghṛtaṃ yojyamajāghṛtaṃ vā yojayetkalamāśālinīvārā godhūmayava vaiṣṇavīmkuśataṇḍulapuṣpaṃ ca gandhaṃ kṣīraṃ ca sarṣapammārgaśīrṣamāsādi arghyaṃ dvādaśa yojayetkuśodakaṃ caiva gośṛṅgo gośṛṅgodakameva cadvādaśaṃ godadhiṃ caiva krameṇaiva tu bhakṣayetratnaśāliṃ mahāśāliṃ kalamāśālimeva cakuḍakatrayamannaṃ ca dvitīyekaṃ tu cāḍhakamkuḍubaṃ ghṛtamevoktaṃ tadardhaṃ khaṇḍamucyatemāse māse nivedyaṃ syāt tattanmantreṇa deśikaḥbilvodakaṃ ca śāmī ca bilvaṃ candanakadambakamkapitthamayahīdantakāṣṭhamiha dvādaśamāsevidyeśvarāṣṭahomaṃ ca homaṃ dvādaśakīrtitambilvodumbara śāmī ca vai kaṅkatamayāni ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: māse māse tu hotavyaṃ ekaikaṃ tu pṛthak pṛthakācāryaḥ śivahomaṃ tu teṣāṃ tu dviguṇaṃ bhavethomānte snānaṃ kurvīta dvādaśāṣṭamīkeṣu cavāmamantreṇa prāsādaṃ vījamukhyasamanvitamsamidhājya caruṃ lājāṃstilaśāliṃ ca sarvapānprāsādanāmamantreṇa bījamukhyaiḥ prakāśayethomaṃ pūrve tu matimān pūjayedṛtvijaḥ pṛthakhemāṅgulīyakaṃ caiva chatraṃ pādukameva cauṣṇīvaṃ phalakaṃ caiva yathā śakti ca dakṣiṇāmkeyūrairupavītaiśca kaṭakaiḥ kaṭisūtrakaiḥpāyasaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ ghṛtena tu pariplutamharidrāmagnivarṇāṃ ca pītavarṇāṃ suśobhanāmśatakumbhanibhāṃ kapilāṃ śivāya dvādaśaṃ bhavetmahāpūjā prakartavyā brahmaṇaścaiva homayetsaptāhaṃ triyahaṃ vāpi utsavaṃ kārayedbudhaḥnānājanapadākīrṇaṃ nānācchatrasamanvitamgrāmaṃ vā nagaraṃ vāpi nattanaṃ kheṭakaṃ tu vāśrīkaṇṭhanāthaṃ sasutaṃ somaṃ rathena vāhayetlājāsaktu samāyuktaṃ śālyannaṃ droṇabhājanamcatuṣpathe tripathe caiva dvipathaikapathe kṣipetaṣṭottaraśataiḥ kalaśairekāśītimathāpi vāpañcaviṃśaiḥ ṣoḍaśairvāṃ snapanaṃ kārayedguhacūrṇa * * * * * * kṛtvā * * * * * *mahābhiṣekadravyāṇi kathitaṃ pūrvameva hiavabhṛtaṃ kārayetpaścāt nadīsnānaṃ viśeṣataḥ

sanskrit: kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ vrataṃ bhaktyā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇuśaraṇāgataghātī ca miśraviśrambhaghātakaḥkṛṣṇāṣṭamī vratenaiva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavetarbudamaptoryāmagnikharvaṃ vā vājapeyakamprayutamukthyaphalaṃ caiva niyutāgniṣṭomameva caśatasahasrastrīyāgaṃ koṭiśyenaphalaṃ bhavetnikhilameṣāṃ kratuphalamagnicicchataphalaṃ bhavetsarveṣāṃ karmakārāṇāṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ tu yatkṛtamsvayaṃ sāyujyamāpnoti tasya nāśā(ga)manaṃ punaḥśivabhaktāya dātavyaṃ śivena kathitaṃ purādevaiśca sevitaṃ toyaṃ kṣitau tīrthaṃ taducyatemṛtānāṃ teṣu sarveṣu śivakṣetreṣu dehināmarcanaṃ ca japadhyānaṃ samādhisthānameva caaṣṭa ṣaṣṭimahāsthānaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu sāṃpratamgokarṇaṃ bhadrakarṇaṃ ca suvarṇākṣo'tidīptavānsthānāṣṭakamidaṃ jñeyaṃ rudrakṣetraṃ mahodayamca kalaṃ ca dviraṇḍaṃ ca mākoṭaṃ maṇḍaleśvaramaṭṭahāsaṃ ca vijñeyaṃ pavitrāṣṭakamudāhṛtamtathā caiva kurukṣetraṃ nākhalo nakhalastathāetadguhyāṣṭakaṃ nāma sarvapāpapramocanamśrīparvataṃ hariścandraṃ mahākālavanaṃ tathāvāraṇāsī vaidyanāthaṃ aṣṭamaṃ parikīrtitamsantārya sapitṝn sarvān śaivaṃ yāti padaṃ mahatāṣāḍhī daṇḍimuṇḍī ca bhārabhūtilakulīśvaramkailāso mandaraṃ caiva meruṃ vai nīlaparvataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: parvatāṣṭakamevaṃ tu svayaṃbhusthānaṃ śivasya tuvirajā varuṇā gollā jayanti koṭivarṣakamśuddhāṣṭakamidaṃ kṣetraṃ śivasāyujyakārakammāheśvarī māhiricchatraṃ puṇḍravardhanameva cadehināṃ tatra pañcakaṃ śivaṃ sāyujyakārakamcatvāraṃ tu anaupamya mahākṣetraṃ sudurlabhamtamassamādhiṃ ca japaṃ dānaṃ devārcanaṃ tu yatdevālayaṃ prapāṃ caivaṃ sabhāsthānaṃ maṭhastathāgodānaṃ gajadānaṃ ca kanyādānaṃ hiraṇyakamdāsidānaṃ rathadānaṃ ca vidyādānaṃ tathaiva capratiśraya pradānaṃ ca mantradānaṃ ca ṣoḍaśaśivabhaktāya śāntāya sadā śūdrānnavarjinetadanantaphalaṃ dāturbhavatīti kramādbhutamśrotriyāya daridrāya āhitāgnitapasvinedhanadhānyasupūrṇa ca śivāya bhuktapātrakānpacanasthālījalabhāṇḍaṃ darvīpānīya pātrakamupadhānaṃ kambalaṃ ca bahistaraṇameva caniṣṭhīvanapātraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dhārameva cakarakaṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ caiva śūlaṃ ca karakāṇi caetān sarvān samāpādya svajanmadivase guhana tadvaktumahaṃ śaktaḥ phalaṃ yutāṃ śatairapisopi yāgaphalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥtatphalaṃ labhate vatsa śubhagrahaṃ tu na saṃśayaḥiti kālottare aṣṭa ṣaṣṭisthānapaṭalaḥ saptatriṃśatitamaḥkhaṇḍaṃ vā sphuṭitaṃ vāpi tīrṇaṃ vā kulaparyayāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtvā saṃsthāpayedanyaṃ pūrvavatparikalpayetdvātriṃśacca tadardhaṃ vasubhirvedasaṃkhyayāmahāpūjāvidhiṃ kuryāt kalaśaiśca sahasrakaiḥnava karma prakartavyaṃ yathoktaṃ pūrvavatkramātkiṅgena vihite netuḥ pratiṣṭhāmantrāhutaṃ bhavetpīṭhake pūrṇajīrṇe tu śaktimantraṃ ghṛtāhutiḥananteśa sahasraṃ tu triguṇaṃ pratyekamucyateaṣṭādaśagaṇānāṃ tu pratyekaṃ tu daśāhutiḥpunaḥ saṃskārakarmaṃ tu pūrvavat śilpinā vidhiḥbaliliṅgapade caiva prāyaścittavidhiṃ śṛṇughṛtāhutisahasreṇa astrarājeti mantrataḥteṣāṃ vidhipradeśe tu pramādātpavanaṃ tathātattanmantrāhutiṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sahasrāhutirucyateastrāṇāṃ ca tadardhe tu homayettadghṛtāhutiḥpatite tu yathāsthāne evaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥaṣṭadikṣutathā kṛtvā atha sahasrāṣṭamucyateaṣṭadikṣu hutaṃ kṛtvā aṣṭāṅgaṃ mantramucyategrāmādhidevatā pārśve patane tatra pūjitamśāntihomaṃ tathā kuryāt bahurūpeṇa mantrataḥmūlabimbe punaḥ pūjya pūrvoktaṃ tu tathā vidhiḥsahasreṇa ghṛtaṃ hutvā taccheṣaṃ pūrvavatkramātrājakṣobhabhayaṃ caiva rājarāṣṭraṃ samākulamagnikāryavihīne tu prāyaścittavidhiṃ śṛṇuekāhe agnibījaṃ tu aghorāstraṃ śataṃ japetpunarutpādanaṃ cāgneḥ paścānnityaṃ samārabhet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yatsahasraṃ ghṛtaṃ hutvā paścānnityaṃ samārabhetdaśāhe agnijīrṇe tu ekāhādi ca varṣakaiḥpañcaviṃśatikumbhaistu snānaṃ kuryānmaheśvaramagnikāryavihīne tu śivamantrāhutirbhavetevaṃ vidhiṃ punaḥ kuryāt pañcāhāntaṃ praśasyateardhamāsavihīne tu agnikārye dinaṃ pratipunarutthāpanaṃ cāgneḥ nityaṃ karmavidhiṃ tathāpaścādviṃśāhutiṃ kuryāt tantroktaṃ pūrvavatkramātṣaṇmāsaṃ cāgnihīne tu pūrvoktadviguṇena tuvarṣahīnaṃ tathācāgniḥ daśalakṣaṃ tu homayetnityārcana vihīne tu pūrvoktaṃ tu caretkramātnityotsavavihīnaṃ tu prāyaścittavidhiṃ śṛṇupañcaviṃśatikumbhaistu snānaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥdinaṃ vṛddhikaraṃ kṛtvā śa diśettu dinaṃ prati* * * * * tatkuryāt paścānnityaṃ samārabhetghṛtāhutiṃ sahasraṃ tu kṛtvā paścātsupūjayethaviṣāhutihīne tu ghṛtāhutisahasrakamgandhājyadhūpahīne tu pādyamācamanārghyakamastramantraśataṃ hutvā saṃpūrṇa dravyamucyateaghorāstreṇa mantreṇa hutvā caiva sahasrakamhṛdayena tu mantreṇa trisahasraṃ ghṛtāhutiḥanena vidhinā samyak prāyaścittaṃ vidhiṃ śṛṇuaghorāstreṇa mantreṇa lakṣahomaṃ tathaiva casa prāṇaṃ tataḥ paścāttataḥ śuddhiḥ praśasyatecaṇḍālasparśane kuryāt sarvabhāṇḍavivarjitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jalasaṃprokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā paścāddevārcanaṃ kramātiti kālottare prāyaścittapaṭalo'ṣṭātriṃśatitamaḥuttarāyaṇakāle tu śuklapakṣe śubhe dinepuṣyamāse janmadine tulābhāraṃ kuruṣvihacaitre svajanmanakṣatre vaiśākhe vā svajanmanihaste ca śravaṇe vāpi uttaratraya eva vāuttaraproṣṭhe vā kuryāt bhādrapade ca vā bhavetśanirohiṇyāṃ vā kuryāt mṛgāhve somavārakebhaumāśvine vā kuryāt vārayoge tu vā bhavetsūryagrahaṇe śreṣṭhaṃ tu tulābhāraṃ vidurbudhāḥpunarvai siddhayoge tu punarvai viṣuvā bhavetrātrirvā tu mahāsena somagrahaṇaṃ tu varjayetmithune karkaṭe vāpi tulābhāraṃ praśasyatesāligrāme vaidyanāthe gaṅgādvāre tu vā bhavetgokarṇe bhadrakarṇe vā mahendre śrīparvate'pi vāsvāmi śailendraśrīkoṭe kailāse himavindhyakerāmeśvare setubandhe maṣṭre ca puruṣottamepuṇye devālaye vāpi mahataḥ sarasastaṭecandanaṃ khadiraṃ caiva madhūko devadāru caviṃśatpañcādhikaścaiva nimīśo śoka eva caaṣṭahastapramāṇaṃ tu tulāstambho vidhīyateardhādhikaṃ hastamātraṃ bhūmau saṃveśayedbudhaḥuttaraṃ tayoḥ śikharaṃ ṣaḍhastamatiśobhanamdakṣiṇottarataḥ stambhaṃ samaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ nāhaṃ suvrataṃ ślakṣṇamuttamam

sanskrit: bakārasya trikartavyaṃ dṛḍhaṃ samyakpratārayettayorvai kuṇḍalaṃ samyak tathaivottarameva hiagrācca caturaṅgulyāt baddhaṃ kṛṣṇāya ṣaṇmukhaśakyaṃ sāśaṃ bakārasya samyagbaddhvā tu buddhimānpañcaprādeśavistāraṃ sudṛḍhaṃ vartulaṃ bhavettriśatena phalenaiva ekaikādhāramucyatetulā pratyaya evaṃ syāt tulābhāre tu śobhanampūrvaṃ saṃveśya mantrajñaḥ prāsādena ṣaḍānanajāmbūnadaṃ śātakumbhaṃ rathakāñcanameva casuvarṇaṃ kāñcanamayaṃ kurvātmake tuṃ vinyasetdaśaniṣkaṃ ca niṣkaṃ vā suvarṇe cādhikaṃ bhavetmadhyaṃ pañcāśādhikaṃ kanyasaṃ daśaniṣkakamprācyāṃ caiva tu āgneyyāṃ bahuvṛcau homameva tupaścime caiva vāyavye sāmagena homamārabhetdeśiko madhyame juhuyāt dhanadasyaiva tu pūrvataḥviṣṇusūktaṃ rudrasūktaṃ brahmajajñānameva catriyambakaṃ haṃsaśuciḥ tripadaṃ jātavedasambrahmasāma jyeṣṭhasāma bṛhadrathantarameva cabahiḥ pavamānaṃ juhuyāt viṣṇusāma ca homayetnārāyaṇaṃ brahmaśilāṃ atharvaśirasastathāpippalādairbārhaspatyaṃ āṅgīrasaṃ sauravaiṣṇavamṛtvijānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ vyāhṛtiṃ ca śataṃ hunetpratyekamaṣṭasāhasraṃ samidhaḥ pṛthageva tubilvodumbaraśāmī ca apāmārgamudāhṛtampañcaghaṭikā trighaṭikā dvighaṭikā vāpi dhārayet

sanskrit: prāsādaṃ tu japettāvatdyāvadāropaṇaṃ nṛpaḥbrahmaghoṣaiḥ puṣkalaistu jayaśabdairatharvabhiḥvīṇākinnara śabdaiśca gītanṛttādiśobhanaiḥsamidājyacaruṃ lājaṃ tilaṃ śāliṃ ca sarṣapānsahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā yathāśakti dakṣiṇāṃ dadetdvijānāṃ vedaviduṣāṃ daridraśrotriyārthināmvidyānuṣṭhānusāreṇa śānto dāntāya dāpayetgobhūmikāñcanai * rdhaissvarṇa yajñopavītakaiḥaṅgulīyairanekaiśca pūjayedṛtvijaḥ pṛthaktatropayoga dravyāṇi deśikāya pradāpayetevaṃ śāstroktamārgeṇa tulābhāraṃ tu kārayetyāvattadromasaṃkhyā tu kanakaṃ yāvatphalamtāvadrudrapure vatsa tāvadviṣṇupure vasettāvatsvarge vaseddhīmān devastrī parivāritaḥveda vedāṅgatattvajño yogatattva parāyaṇaḥjñānādvairāgyamāpnoti vairāgyādyogamāpnuyāttulābhāreṇa vai vatsa iha loke sukhī bhavetapamṛtyuśataṃ jitvā dīrghamāyuravāpnuyātśaraṇāgataghātī ca mitrahāmātṛhā tathāghṛtasnānaṃ śive kuryānmahadarcanameva casarvadaivatapūjā ca tasminnahani kārayetsamyagjñātvā darśayettu tulābhāraṃ samāhitaḥparicārakastulābhāre śāṭhyamātsarya varjitaḥiti kālottare tulābhārapaṭalaḥ ekonacatvāriṃśatvidhinā hiraṇyagarbheṇa devayonivinirgatāḥ

sanskrit: mantreṇa svarabījaṃ tu umākṣetramudāhṛtampūrvoktasthānakāle tu hiraṇyagarbhaṃ praveśayetsuvarṇaṃ cādhamaṃ viddhi dīnāraṃ śātakumbhavatṣaṭcatvāriṃśatsahasrairuttamaṃ hi ṣaḍānanadvādaśasahasreṇādhamaṃ hiraṇyagarbhamudāhṛtamaṣṭāviṃśatsahasreṇa ūrdhvapātraṃ tu kārayetdaśasahasreṇādhaḥpātraṃ kārayenmadhyagarbhakammadhyamaṃ garbhamityāhuḥ śivena paribhāṣitamsaptasahasreṇordhvapātraṃ samyakkṛtvā ṣaḍānanasaṃpūrṇaṃ candravadanaṃ dvinetraṃ cārulocanampṛthu nitambaṃ kurvīta kambugrīvaṃ tu subhruvamsarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamcaturbhujaṃ dvinetraṃ tu śaṅkhacakragadādharamnavamālādharaṃ devaṃ śārṅgāyudhadharaṃ parampītavastradharaṃ devaṃ hārakeyūrabhūṣitamadhaḥpātre mahālakṣmīṃ padmakiñjalkasaprabhāmcārucāmīkaracchāyāṃ sarojakarapallavāmpītonnatastanāṃ śubhrāṃ kuṇḍalābhyāmalaṃkṛtāmanimnasnigdhakeśāntāṃ kiñcitprahasitānanāmathavā siṃharūpaṃ tu hiraṇyagarbhaṃ tu kārayetgajarūpaṃ vā prakartavyaṃ hiraṇyagarbhaṃ samāviśetdyāvāpṛthivyorviśvarūpaṃ * sadyaṃ tu kārayetcandrasūryagrahaṇe ayane viṣuve'pi vāpuruṣasyāsīnamātraṃ tu hiraṇyagarbhaṃ tu kārayetathavā prādeśavistāraṃ kuryāttālādhikaṃ tu vā
