sanskrit: etatkālādhikaṃ kuryāt ūrdhvapātraṃ ṣaḍānanasukhaṃ pra * * * kuryātpādau hastau tu vānalamsamyagāpūrayitvā tu brahmajajñānakena tudaśāsyāṃ putrānādhe hi garbhādhānantu homayetprajāvajjīvaputrābhyāṃ iti prajāpatermatamhaviṣā homayeccheṣaṃ pālāśedhmaṃ tu kārayetekaviṃśatkuśān śamīn udumbaraphalāni cadhṛte dadāmi madhunā ghṛteneti ghṛtaṃ madhutairmantraiśca hunedvatsa śatamaṣṭottaraṃ hunetpratyekamaṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu dardhaṃ vāṣṭaśataṃ tu vānāmadheyaṃ daśamyāṃ tu dvādaśyāṃ vāpi kārayethavatāsvarmaśarmaghoṣānyantaṃ prayoktavyam (?)oṣadhe trāyasvainamiti * * * * * * *mantrayogaṃ prakartavyaṃ etairmantraistu chedanamna pakvātkeśavacanacchedanaṃ tu ca kārayetṣoḍaśairdvādaśairvipraiḥ navavipraiśca homayetpṛthagaṣṭottarasāhasraṃ aṣṭottaraśataṃ tu vāgarbhāṣṭame vā kartavyaṃ śrutidṛṣṭena karmaṇāpitraiḥ pañcabhirdadyāt dīptāgniṃ tatra mantrakaiḥpuruṣasūktairviṣṇusūktaiḥ rudrasūktaiśca homayetjalapradānaṃ yatkiñcittatsarvaṃ brahmayajñakamtribhirmahādyādiveda * * vṛttañca juhuyāteka eva ghaṭikāṃ ca pratyekaṃ ṣoḍaśa kriyāevaṃ hi viprairbhuktvā tu tatkāle viprabhojanampuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra ādāvante ca ṣaṇmukha

sanskrit: siṃhe mukhaṃ gṛhītvā tu tadāsyena viniṣkrametbrahmaṇā brahmagarbhe tu svasvatyā iti niṣkrametvaiśyaśūdrairna kartavyaṃ vibhavai sati vai guhaaṣṭādaśasu dharmeṣu etarāyaṇasūtrakekālottare mahāśāstre hiraṇyagarbhaṃ pradarśitampuṇyāhaṃ jayaśabdaiśca śaṅkhatūryaravaiḥ śubhaiḥbhūṇamiśrāyadātavyaṃ hiraṇyagarbhaṃ jalena tuṛtvijaḥ pūjayettatra gobhūmikāñcanādibhiḥaśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyāyutasya tuhiraṇyagarbheṇa vai vatsa sarvavyādhiharaṃ bhavetiti kālottare hiraṇyagarbhapaṭalaścatvāriṃśatitamaḥsarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ tiladānaṃ praśasyatekārayeddeśiko dhīmān vedaśāstra viśāradaḥūrdhvabāhuḥ svayaṃ samyagyajamānasya deśikaḥvrīhipāṣāṇa nirmuktān kṛmikīṭādivarjitānpañcagavyena saṃprokṣya garbhamālāṃ prakīrya casayojātena mantreṇa deśiko mūrtiyaiḥ sahaparitaḥ puṣpamālābhiḥ phalairnānāvidhairapiaṣṭalohasamākīrṇaṃ vidadyāttilaparvatampañcaite mūrtayaḥ pūjyāḥ pañcabhiḥ brahmabhiḥ śubhaiḥvāmadevena mantreṇa viṣṇumuttarabhāgataḥīśvaraṃ pūrvadigbhāge vaktramantreṇa cārcayetsauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi pratimāṃ kārayet pṛthakdakṣiṇābhiranekābhirācāryaṃ pūjayecchuciḥsomādi tu tataḥ kuryāt sadyojātādibhiḥ kramāt

sanskrit: lokapālāṃstu saṃpūjya svadikṣu vidhinā guhatasmāttamarcayeddevaṃ tilaparvatarupiṇamśivabhaktāya yuktāya vedānāṃ pāradṛśvaneyastvevaṃ vidhinā vatsa dadāti tilaparvatamgavāṃ śatasahasrasya dattasya phalamaśnutemucyate pātakaiścānyaiḥ dehānte tu śivaṃ vrajetgobhūmikāñcanairvastrairgehopaskaraṇādibhiḥkalaśaiḥ snāpayitvā tu samabhyarcya yathāvidhimahādevo harorudraḥ śaṅkaronīlalohitaḥkapālīśaśca vijñeyaḥ varuṇādidaśāstvimekṛṣṇājinena saṃpūjya tilānāṃ ṣoḍaśāḍhakaiḥśobhitaṃ puṣpamālābhiḥ phalaiḥ puṣpairalaṃkṛtamśivabhaktāya dāntāya śrotriyāya dvijanmaneāyuḥ śrīvijayaṃ kītimanubhūya śivaṃ vrajetiti kālottare tilaparvatapaṭalaḥ ekacatvāriṃśatitamaḥdānānāmuttamaṃ dānaṃ pṛthivī sarvakāmikāmdevāsuramanuṣyāṃśca yakṣa kiṃ puruṣādayaḥsarvaṃ pṛthivīdānena sarvataḥ phalamāpnuyātsarvaṃ dātunna śaktatvāt tadupāyaḥ sudurlabhaḥcarācarasya dānaphalaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥlakṣa * * * kartavyaṃ pṛthvīdānaṃ narottamaiḥhiraṇyena madhyamaṃ kuryāt svarṇakāñcanakanyasamdravyatyāga * * ṣaṇṇāṃ hemajāmbūnadādayaḥkṣayañcayānnityagena eṣāmanyatamena catrisahasreṇa mahāmeruḥ kanyasaṃ hi ṣaḍānana

sanskrit: jambūdvīpasya madhye tu mahāmeruṃ kārayettataḥṛkṣasahyamayaṃ cāpi śrīśailaṃ svāmiparvataḥmahāmeruṃ caturdikṣu kārayettatra pāragaḥsindhuśoṇā paścimamukhā gaṅgādīṃścaturo nadīndvṛṣadvihivajrahaṃsīplāvanī paścimāmukhāḥsupārśvā ca catuśśailā mahāmeroḥ pūrvadakṣiṇataḥevaṃ dviguṇato vṛddhyāpyuttaraṃ hyuttarottaramkapilāśvasahasraṃ ca kanyādānaṃ tathaiva casamastapāpanirmuktaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥiti kālottare pṛthvīdānapaṭalo dvicatvāriṃśatprāsādalakṣaṇañcaiva pratimālakṣaṇaṃ tathāsarvadeva pratiṣṭhā ca rūpaṃ varṇaṃ ca bījakamgrāme vā nagare vāpi pattane kheṭakepi vāsarvametatpravakṣyāmi samāsācchṛṇu sāṃpratamviśīrṇabhūmyā divanapradeśeviceratu stoyanidhānamadhyeviśālāṃ bhrukuṭiṃ lalāṭepadmodbhavaṃ sa smitamevamāhanārāyaṇaṃ cakragadādihastamniṣṭhārthayuktaṃ vacanaṃ saroṣamtatrotthitaṃ kimapi nāma tayoḥ purastātkrodhārthaḥ parimokṣa eva sahasā kaṃ cāvayorāgatauśanairūrdhvamadhaścaiva yāsyā va upalakṣayetsamāgatau tatra punaḥ kṣaṇenanihitamarehi jagattvayā vibhāti

sanskrit: samaśca śarkarābhiśca nistṛṇaṃ vigatodakambhūmissā vāyavī yatra talliṅgaścābhicārakamtasmātsarvaprayatnena vāyavyaṃ na prayojayetśaṅkhāvadātā kumudaprabhā ca kumbhīndradantadyutisannikāśāḥnakṣatramāsaṃ ca caturthaṃ yojyamnanu trayaṃ tu śūdrasya na yogyaṃ hi kadācanakṣatraliṅgaṃ tu viprāṇāṃ yogyamevaṃ ṣaḍānanaanulomaṃ prakartavyaṃ pratilomaṃ na kārayetiti kālottare catuścatvāriṃśatpaṭalaḥmahendro malaye sahye śrīśailaḥ svāmiparvatebhuktimatpāriyātre ca govardhanagirāvapikulaparvate tu vai vatsa uttamaṃ liṅgamādiśetvajreṇa liṅgaṃ kṛtvā tu rudro madhye'rcayetsadāindranīlamayaṃ liṅgaṃ viṣṇurarcayate sadābrahmābhyarcayate nityaṃ liṅgaṃ śailamayaṃ śubhamśakro'pi devarājendraḥ padmarāgeṇa cārcayetkṛtāśanaṃ cāgnimayaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayate sadāyamopi dharmarājaśca liṅgaṃ nīlamayaṃ śubhamkṛṣṇāya samayaṃ liṅgaṃ rākṣasendraṃ prapūjayetsphaṭikāddhikṛtaṃ liṅgaṃ varuṇo'rcayate sadāsaptarāgamayaṃ liṅgaṃ īśāno'rcayate sadāmaratakena liṅgena pārvatī pūjayetsadārājatena tu liṅgena lakṣmīḥ pūjayate sadādurgā pūjayate liṅgaṃ mahānīlamayaṃ śubhamśacīkā ca mayaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayedgandhapuṣpakaiḥ

sanskrit: vasavaḥ kāsyakaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayanti vidhānataḥtāmraliṅgaṃ sadākālaṃ bhaktyā pūjya divākaraḥaśvibhyāṃ pārthivaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥliṅgaṃ hemamayaṃ kāntaṃ dhanado'rcayate sadāviśve devā mahātmāno raupyaliṅgaṃ sadārcayetpāṃsuliṅgaṃ sadākālaṃ marutaḥ pūjayanti vaipitṛgaṇājalaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayanti vidhānataḥtrapusīsamayaṃ liṅgaṃ asurāḥ pūjayanti vaiṛṣīyāmapi sarveṣāṃ agniliṅgaṃ sadārcitamnāgaliṅgamayaṃ nityaṃ piśācāḥ pūjayanti hibhūtānāmapi sarveṣāṃ agniliṅgaṃ sadārcitammedhā prajñā ca śuddhā ca śruti smṛtiruṣā prabhādaraliṅgena nityaṃ hi pūjayitvā vidhānataḥgandharvāścāraṇā yakṣā siddhāvidyādharādayaḥyajanātpadamāptaṃ hi nityamevaṃ ṣaḍānanavidhānenārcanānnityaṃ tatpatnītvamavāpnuyuḥtena saktajanānnityaṃ sarasvatītvamavāpnuyuḥevaṃ devāḥ sagandharvā piśācoragarākṣasāḥvāsukistakṣakaścaiva kārkoṭaḥ śaṅkhapālakaḥpravālakamayaṃ liṅgaṃ pūjayanti vidhānataḥmeruśca mandaraścaiva kailāso himavān giriḥśrīparvataśca mainākaḥ svāmi parvata eva camahāśailamayaṃ liṅgaṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ sadājambuśākakuśa krauñca śālmalīgomedhapuṣkaramtena saṃpūjanānnityaṃ dvīparājatvameva hi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: siddhavidyādharā yakṣā gāruḍāḥ pūjayanti caiti vijñāya yatnena pūjanīyaḥ sadāśivaḥiti kālottare liṅgakalpe pañcacatvāriṃśatpaṭalaḥiti kālottare liṅgakalpe sirāvivarādidoṣapaṭalaḥ pañcacatvāriṃśatiti kālottare liṅgalakṣaṇaṃ saptacatvāriṃśatpaṭalaḥuttarāyaṇakāle tu śuklapakṣe śubhe dineuttaratrayame vāhuḥ pratiṣṭhāyāmadhivāsanevārayoge siddhayoge cādhivāsanamucyatesaptamyāṃ vā daśamyāṃ vā dvādaśyāṃ vā trayodaśīprāsādasyātha purato maṇḍapatrātidūrataḥcamurdvāra samāyuktaṃ catustoraṇa bhūṣitamtanmadhye kuṭṭimaṃ kuryāddṛḍhaṃ taddvayameva catadardhaṃ taṇḍule naiva padmamaṣṭadalaṃ likhetprāsārya kambalaṃ tatra paristaraṇaṃ tathoparihṛdā hi sarvakarmāṇi bījamukhyaistribhiryutaiḥvāmadevena mantreṇa prāsādena tu saṃyutaḥsakṛjjaptvā tu vai vatsa śayane śāyayecchivamkalaśān sthāpayettatra haimarājataśulpajānathavā tāmrajaṃ kumbhaṃ āḍhakairnavapūritamtadardhaṃ vā kṣipeddhīmān praśānte na tu vidyayāvastrayugmena matimān śivaṃ vastrāṇi mantrataḥantanteśaṃ pūrvakalaśe pañcaratnodakaṃ kṣipetśivottamaṃ paścimakalaśe ekanetraṃ tu cottareaiśānyāmekarudraṃ tu kaṣāyaṃ tatra vinyasetśrīkaṇṭhakalaśe nair-ṛtyāṃ yavapuṣpodakaṃ nyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00248 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pṛthagvai vastrayugmena pūjayitvā samantataḥkalaśānnyastvā vidhānena paścāddhomaṃ samārabhetviśeṣeṣu ca kartavyaṃ caturaśraṃ sarvakuṇḍakamcaturaśraṃ bhavetpūrvaṃ āgneyyāṃ tu trikoṇakamvāruṇyāṃ vartulaṃ kuṇḍaṃ vāyavyāṃ pañcakoṇakamcaturaśre vāstuhomaṃ ca vāstuvidyāviśāradaḥhārakeyūrakaṭakairūpavītāṅgulīyakaiḥaindrāṃ? caiva tu āgneyyāṃ vastrato homamārabhetvāruṇyāṃ caiva vāyavyāṃ sāmago homamārabhetśirasi sthānamācāryo dviguṇaṃ homamārabhetpalāśakhadirāśvattha plakṣanyagrodha eva cajātīvakularājārka kadambaṃ cūtameva cadviprādeśaṃ bhavedidhmaṃ samidvai tālamātrataḥmathitāgniṃ viśeṣāttu śrotriyasya gṛhepi vāgarbhādhānādikarmāṇi kārayettatra pāragaḥsruvaṃ darvīssruvā caiva valabhṛttaṇḍulaṃ ghaṣamkūrcarājaṃ tilaṃ caiva sarṣapaṃ śāliveṇavamcandrarūpāṇi vai vatsa sādhayetsarvameva hisaṃskṛtya vidhivaccāgnimṛtvijebhyaḥ pradāpayetpūrve tatpuruṣaṃ mantraṃ imā rudreti homayetdakṣiṇe tu aghorantu parito rudreṇa homayetpaścime sadyamantreṇa agna āyāhi vai guhasaumyāyāṃ vāmadevena śanno devīrabhiṣṭayenavacatvārimantreṇa vāstuhomantu kārayetprāsādahomamaṣṭāyurbījamukhyena homayet

sanskrit: haṃsaśuciṃ śannavargaṃ annasūktaṃ jātavedasamsaptahotā daśahotā rudraikādaśa eva cabrahmasāma samajyeṣṭhāt sāmaṃ vikarṇaṃ rudrasāmakamnīlarudraṃ mahārudraṃ atharvaśirasaṃ tathāājyena homavidhinā svasvaśākhāparairdvijaiḥsāvitryā vyāhṛtibhiḥ pratyekaṃ śataṃ homayetvyomavyāpiñcāṣṭa mūrtimaṣṭavidyeśvaraiḥ sahagandharvāpsarasaḥ siddhān nāgān kiṃ puruṣānapividyādharān yātudhānān śatapañcāśadardhakānaṣṭa sapta ca ṣaṭpañca catvārastraya eva caevaṃ hutvā vidhānena pūrṇāhutimathācaretghṛtaṃ hutvā spṛśenmūrdhni lājaṃ hutvā tu cendriyamtilān hutvā divi praśyaśāliṃ hutvodaraṃ spṛśetyavaṃ hutvorusaṃgṛhya sakṛcchreṇa tu ṣaṇmukhabījamukhena saṃyuktaṃ spṛśetprasṛtamudrayāpratisaraṃ bandhayettatra padmasūtreṇa mukhyayāviprānekādaśān bhojya tatkāle pāyasaṃ guhadiśābaliṃ dāpayeddhi * * * * * * * *rātrau homaṃ prakartavyaṃ prabhāte sthāpanaṃ bhavetiti kālottare adhivāsanapaṭalo'ṣṭācatvāriṃśatgarbhagehaṃ sūtrayitvā aṣṭadikṣu yathā vidhigarbhagehasya pūrve tu dvāraṃ samyakprakalpayetekaṃ madhye tu taṃ kṛtvā tribhāgaṃ kusumākaramkalhārapatravatkuryāt haṃsinī puṣpavadbhavetupānaṃ jagatīṃ kuryānmekhalātrayameva ca
